e: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。
Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。
a.m..t: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。

e: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
我们不得不将车弃在雪地里。
Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。
abandon.t: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

e: Everyone using the pool must abide by its rules.
所有使用泳池的人都必须遵守泳池规定。
Companies should abide by environmental regulations even when doing so increases their production costs.
企业应遵守环保法规，即使这样做会增加生产成本。
abide.t: 表示遵守用abide by；表示忍受常用cannot abide。

e: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。
Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。
ability.t: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

e: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。
With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。
able.t: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

e: The mechanic noticed an abnormal noise from the engine.
修理工注意到发动机发出异常响声。
Regular medical screening can detect abnormal changes before they develop into conditions that require complex treatment.
定期医学筛查可以在异常变化发展为需要复杂治疗的疾病之前发现它们。
abnormal.t: 常用于医学或异常现象，不宜随意用来评价人。

e: Our library has abolished fines for returning books late.
我们的图书馆已经取消了逾期还书罚款。
Some economists argue that governments should abolish subsidies that encourage excessive consumption of fossil fuels.
一些经济学家主张，政府应废除鼓励过度消耗化石燃料的补贴。
abolish.t: 常接法律、制度或惯例，不用于取消普通预约。

e: The exhibition celebrates aboriginal cultures from several different regions.
这个展览展示并赞颂了几个不同地区的原住民文化。
Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.
保护原住民语言需要持续的资金支持，并与使用这些语言的社区密切合作。
aboriginal.t: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

e: Wildflowers abound in the fields behind our house each spring.
每年春天，我们屋后的田野里都开满野花。
Opportunities for renewable energy development abound in regions with consistent sunshine and strong coastal winds.
在日照稳定且沿海风力强劲的地区，可再生能源的发展机会十分丰富。
abound.t: 不及物动词；某地充满某物用abound in/with。

e: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。
Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。
about.t: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

e: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。
Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。
above.t: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

e: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
出版社为较年幼的读者推出了这部小说的删节版。
Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
出版社经常删节经典小说，使阅读经验有限的学生更容易读懂。
abridge.t: 删去部分内容但保留主干，不等同于写摘要。

e: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。
Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。
abroad.t: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。

e: The bus came to an abrupt stop outside our house.
公交车在我们家门外突然停了下来。
Abrupt changes in government policy can create uncertainty for businesses and discourage long-term investment.
政府政策的突然变化可能给企业带来不确定性，并抑制长期投资。
abrupt.t: 形容变化指“突然的”；形容语气或态度指“生硬的”。

e: Her absence from dinner worried the whole family.
她没来吃晚饭，让全家人都很担心。
In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。
absence.t: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

e: Lina was absent from class because she felt ill.
莉娜因身体不适没有来上课。
Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
经常缺课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的学习进度。
absent.t: 表示缺席某场合用absent from，不用absent in。

e: The room fell into absolute silence when she entered.
她一进来，房间里就变得鸦雀无声。
Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。
absolute.t: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

e: She uses toys to explain abstract ideas to children.
她用玩具向孩子们解释抽象概念。
Reading the abstract helps researchers decide whether a study is relevant to their own work.
阅读摘要有助于研究人员判断一项研究是否与自己的工作相关。
abstract.t: 形容词和名词重音在首音节；动词重音在后。

e: It seems absurd to drive when the shop is so close.
商店这么近还要开车去，似乎太不合理了。
It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
不提高服务质量或降低出行成本，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是不合理的。
absurd.t: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

e: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。
An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.
丰富的自然资源并不一定能保证可持续的经济增长或生活水平的提高。
abundance.t: 常用an abundance of＋名词，或in abundance。

e: Fresh fruit is abundant here during the summer.
这里夏天有充足的新鲜水果。
Regions with abundant sunlight have considerable potential to generate affordable electricity from solar energy.
阳光充足的地区具有利用太阳能生产廉价电力的巨大潜力。
abundant.t: abundant强调数量充足；名词搭配an abundance of。

e: The school praised her academic progress this year.
学校表扬了她今年在学业上的进步。
Universities should support students' emotional wellbeing rather than focusing exclusively on academic achievement and examination results.
大学应关注学生的心理健康，而不是只重视学业成就和考试成绩。
academic.t: 作名词指大学教师或研究者，通常不指大学生。

e: She attends a dance academy near the station.
她在车站附近的一所舞蹈学校上学。
A well-funded arts academy can provide talented young people with training they could not otherwise afford.
一所资金充足的艺术学院可以为有才华的年轻人提供他们原本负担不起的培训。
academy.t: 常指专业培训院校或学术机构，不一定是大学。

e: The landlord finally acceded to our request for repairs.
房东终于答应了我们提出的维修要求。
Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。
accede.t: 正式用语，通常接to；勿与exceed（超过）混淆。

e: The bus accelerated as it left the village.
公共汽车驶离村庄时加快了速度。
Investment in public transport can accelerate the transition towards cleaner and more efficient urban travel.
投资公共交通可以加快向更清洁、更高效的城市出行方式转型。
accelerate.t: 既可指车辆加速，也可指进程加快；可及物或不及物。

e: Her accent reminds me of my neighbours back home.
她的口音让我想起家乡的邻居。
Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.
教师应尊重不同口音，同时帮助学习者练就清晰的发音，以便有效开展国际交流。
accent.t: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

e: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。
Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。
accept.t: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

e: These shoes are acceptable for work, but trainers aren't.
这双鞋适合上班穿，但运动鞋不行。
Governments must establish acceptable limits for industrial emissions to protect public health and nearby ecosystems.
政府必须为工业排放设定可接受的限值，以保护公众健康和周边生态系统。
acceptable.t: acceptable表示达到要求，不等于优秀。

e: Her acceptance of the invitation made us all smile.
她接受了邀请，我们都露出了笑容。
Public acceptance of renewable energy projects often increases when local communities share in the economic benefits.
当当地社区能够分享经济收益时，公众对可再生能源项目的认可度往往会提高。
acceptance.t: 通常不可数；acceptance of后接接受的事物。

e: Guests have access to the pool until sunset.
客人在日落前都可以使用游泳池。
Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。
access.t: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

e: The garden is accessible through a small wooden gate.
穿过一扇小木门就能进入花园。
Public libraries should provide digital resources that are accessible to users with a wide range of abilities.
公共图书馆应提供各种能力水平的用户都能使用的数字资源。
accessible.t: 常用accessible to sb；易懂的内容也可用此词。

e: This small camera accessory keeps my photos steady.
这个小巧的相机配件能让我拍照时保持稳定。
Consumers often replace electronic accessories unnecessarily, increasing waste and demand for raw materials worldwide.
消费者常常在没有必要的情况下更换电子配件，增加了废弃物和全球对原材料的需求。
accessory.t: 配件常用复数accessories；从犯后常接to。

e: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。
Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。
accident.t: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

e: Her first film won acclaim at the local festival.
她的首部电影在当地电影节上赢得了赞誉。
The new public library has received widespread acclaim for its accessible design and sustainable construction.
这座新公共图书馆因其无障碍设计和可持续建筑方式而广受赞誉。
acclaim.t: 名词通常不可数；动词常用be acclaimed as被誉为。

e: We found cheap accommodation near the beach last summer.
去年夏天，我们在海滩附近找到了便宜的住处。
Universities should provide affordable accommodation so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds can study without excessive financial pressure.
大学应提供价格可负担的住宿，让家境困难的学生能够在不过度承受经济压力的情况下学习。
accommodation.t: 英式英语中表住宿通常不可数；注意双c、双m。

e: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
明天姐姐会陪我去诊所。
Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
城市扩张应配合公共交通投资，以防止交通拥堵并改善就业可达性。
accompany.t: 直接接人作宾语，不说accompany with someone。

e: We accomplished everything before the guests arrived for dinner.
客人来吃晚饭前，我们把所有事情都办好了。
Students can accomplish more when teachers provide clear goals and regular feedback on their progress.
教师提供明确目标并定期反馈学习进展时，学生能取得更多成果。
accomplish.t: 及物动词，直接接任务或目标，不接不定式。

e: The two clubs reached an accord over sharing equipment.
两家俱乐部就共用器材达成了协议。
An international accord on emissions could encourage countries to adopt cleaner technologies and protect vulnerable ecosystems.
一项关于排放的国际协议可以鼓励各国采用更清洁的技术，并保护脆弱的生态系统。
accord.t: of your own accord意为自愿地，无需别人要求。

e: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this evening.
据天气预报，今晚会下雨。
Public funding should be distributed according to local needs rather than the political influence of individual regions.
公共资金应按当地需求分配，而不应取决于各地区的政治影响力。
according.t: 通常用according to，不单独作形容词。

e: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
据天气预报，今天下午会下雨。
According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。
according to.t: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

e: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
天气预报说有雨，所以我们相应地穿好了衣服。
Schools should identify individual learning needs and adjust their teaching methods accordingly to support every student.
学校应识别每个学生的学习需求，并相应调整教学方法，以支持所有学生。
accordingly.t: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。

e: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
我在当地银行开了一个储蓄账户。
Transport costs account for a substantial share of household spending, particularly in areas with limited public services.
交通费用占家庭支出的很大一部分，在公共服务有限的地区尤其如此。
account.t: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。

e: The accountant checked our expenses before we opened the café.
咖啡馆开业前，会计核查了我们的各项开支。
Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.
聘用合格的会计师有助于小企业准确处理税务，并作出更好的财务决策。
accountant.t: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。

e: My sister studies accounting and helps with our shop's finances.
我姐姐学会计，也帮忙处理我们店里的财务。
Accurate accounting enables businesses to monitor costs, meet legal requirements, and make informed financial decisions.
准确的会计核算使企业能够监控成本、符合法律要求，并作出有依据的财务决策。
accounting.t: 表示会计工作或学科时不可数；会计师是 accountant。

e: Please check the accuracy of these measurements before cutting.
裁剪之前，请检查这些测量数据是否准确。
The accuracy of climate predictions depends partly on the quality of data collected over long periods.
气候预测的准确性部分取决于长期收集的数据质量。
accuracy.t: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是accurate。

e: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
这台厨房秤的精度足以用来做面包。
Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。
accurate.t: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

e: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
我慢慢让自己习惯了开窗睡觉。
Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
学校可以定期布置需要共同承担责任的任务，让学生习惯合作。
accustom.t: accustom oneself to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

e: My legs ache after walking up all those stairs.
爬完那么多级楼梯后，我的双腿酸痛。
Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.
经常背痛的办公室职员可能会受益于可调节办公桌和更频繁的活动休息。
ache.t: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。

e: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
通过每天练习，她终于实现了自己的游泳目标。
Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。
achieve.t: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

e: Finishing my first long hike felt like a real achievement.
完成第一次长途徒步让我觉得很有成就感。
Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。
achievement.t: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

e: The acid in lemon juice can help remove stains.
柠檬汁中的酸有助于去除污渍。
Acid rain can damage forests and reduce the ability of lakes to support aquatic life.
酸雨会破坏森林，并削弱湖泊维持水生生物生存的能力。
acid.t: acid可作名词或形容词；acidic常指呈酸性的。

e: Please acquaint yourself with the kitchen before you start cooking.
开始做饭前，请先熟悉一下厨房。
Universities should acquaint new students with available support services to help them adjust to campus life.
大学应让新生了解可用的支持服务，帮助他们适应校园生活。
acquaint.t: 较正式，常用acquaint sb/oneself with sth。

e: An acquaintance from my yoga class waved at me.
瑜伽课上认识的一位熟人向我挥了挥手。
Even a basic acquaintance with local customs can help international students adapt more easily to life abroad.
即使只是对当地习俗略有了解，也能帮助国际学生更轻松地适应海外生活。
acquaintance.t: 指熟人时可数；表示了解时常接with。

e: We acquired a secondhand table for our tiny kitchen.
我们为狭小的厨房添置了一张二手桌子。
Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。
acquire.t: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

e: Daily conversations helped with her acquisition of new vocabulary.
日常交谈帮助她掌握了新词汇。
Early exposure to varied speech can support language acquisition and strengthen children's ability to communicate effectively.
尽早接触多样的语言表达能促进语言习得，增强儿童有效沟通的能力。
acquisition.t: 习得过程通常不可数；收购交易或购得物可数。

e: Their vegetable garden covers almost an acre behind the house.
他们屋后的菜园占地近一英亩。
Protecting each acre of wetland helps preserve wildlife habitats and reduces the risk of local flooding.
保护每一英亩湿地都有助于维护野生动物栖息地，并降低当地发生洪灾的风险。
acre.t: 面积单位：1英亩约4047平方米，不等于一公顷。

e: The acrobat balanced on one hand above the soft mat.
杂技演员在软垫上方用单手支撑身体，保持平衡。
Training as an acrobat requires sustained physical discipline, making injury prevention an essential part of professional education.
杂技演员的训练需要长期严格的身体训练，因此伤害预防是专业教育中不可或缺的一部分。
acrobat.t: acrobat指演员；acrobatics指杂技表演或技巧。

e: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。
Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。
across.t: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

e: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。
Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。
act.t: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

e: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。
Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。
action.t: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

e: Press this button to activate the outdoor lights.
按这个按钮就能打开室外的灯。
Smart sensors can activate ventilation systems automatically when indoor air quality falls below acceptable levels.
当室内空气质量降至可接受水平以下时，智能传感器可以自动启动通风系统。
activate.t: 强调使设备或系统开始运作；反义词为deactivate。

e: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。
Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。
active.t: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

e: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。
Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.
经常进行体育活动可以改善心理健康，并降低患多种慢性疾病的风险。
activity.t: 具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。

e: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。
Professional actors can help students develop communication skills through drama workshops that encourage teamwork and creative expression.
专业演员可以通过鼓励团队合作和创意表达的戏剧工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通能力。
actor.t: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。

e: The actress waved to the crowd outside the theatre.
那位女演员向剧院外的人群挥手。
A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.
一位成功的女演员可以鼓励年轻人探索表演艺术领域的职业道路。
actress.t: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

e: The actual bill was much lower than we expected.
实际账单金额比我们预想的低得多。
Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。
actual.t: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

e: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
我以为这汤很辣，其实是甜的。
Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.
虽然在线课程似乎很方便，但有些学生实际上通过面对面交流学得更好。
The village faced an acute water shortage last summer.
去年夏天，这个村庄面临严重缺水。
An acute shortage of affordable housing forces many young workers to live far from their workplaces.
经济适用住房的严重短缺迫使许多年轻劳动者住在远离工作地点的地方。
An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。
Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。
ad.t: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

e: Our cat quickly adapted to life in the new flat.
我们的猫很快适应了新公寓里的生活。
Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。
adapt.t: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

e: Our adaptation to the colder weather took several weeks.
我们花了几个星期才适应较冷的天气。
Climate adaptation requires governments to improve flood defences and support communities facing increasingly frequent extreme weather.
适应气候变化需要政府改善防洪设施，并支持面临日益频繁的极端天气的社区。
adaptation.t: 适应某事用adaptation to；改编自用adaptation of。

e: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。
Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。
add.t: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

e: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。
The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。
addition.t: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。

e: We need an additional chair for our guest tonight.
今晚有客人来，我们需要再加一把椅子。
Universities should provide additional financial support for students who cannot afford essential learning materials.
大学应为无力购买必要学习资料的学生提供额外的经济支持。
additional.t: 通常放在名词前；additional costs指额外费用。

e: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。
Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。
address.t: 美音动词读/əˈdres/；address问题不等于已解决。

e: My sister is adept at fixing old bicycles.
我姐姐很擅长修理旧自行车。
Teachers who are adept at using digital tools can adapt lessons to meet a wider range of learning needs.
擅长使用数字工具的教师能够调整课程，以满足更多样的学习需求。
adept.t: 常用be adept at doing，表示擅长做某事。

e: This small heater provides adequate warmth for my bedroom.
这台小取暖器足以让我的卧室保持暖和。
Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。
adequate.t: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

e: Everyone must adhere to the rules in this pool.
每个人都必须遵守这个游泳池的规定。
Researchers must adhere to strict ethical standards when collecting personal information from participants in health studies.
研究人员在收集健康研究参与者的个人信息时，必须遵守严格的伦理标准。
adhere.t: 两种常见义都用adhere to；to是介词。

e: We booked adjacent rooms so the children could stay nearby.
我们订了相邻的房间，孩子们就能住在旁边。
Residents in areas adjacent to the airport often experience high levels of noise pollution.
机场邻近地区的居民经常受到严重的噪声污染。
adjacent.t: 表示“与……相邻”用 adjacent to。

e: Our garden adjoins a quiet park with tall oak trees.
我们的花园紧挨着一座长着高大橡树的安静公园。
Residential areas that adjoin industrial sites may require additional measures to protect residents from noise and pollution.
与工业区相邻的住宅区可能需要额外措施，以保护居民免受噪声和污染影响。
adjoin.t: adjoin后直接接地点，不加to；强调直接相邻。

e: A small adjustment to the seat made cycling easier.
稍微调整座椅后，骑车变得更轻松了。
Moving to a new country often requires considerable adjustment to unfamiliar social customs and daily routines.
移居国外往往需要花不少功夫适应陌生的社会习俗和日常生活方式。
adjustment.t: 表示改动或适应时，常用 adjustment to。

e: The nurse administered the medicine before I went home.
我回家前，护士给我用了药。
Local authorities administer housing programmes designed to provide affordable accommodation for families on low incomes.
地方政府负责管理住房项目，为低收入家庭提供负担得起的住所。
administer.t: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。

e: She handles the administration for our local sports club.
她负责我们当地体育俱乐部的行政工作。
Efficient administration allows public hospitals to allocate resources fairly and respond more quickly to patients' needs.
高效的行政管理使公立医院能够公平分配资源，更快地回应患者需求。
administration.t: 指管理工作时通常不可数；指一届政府时可数。

e: My sister handles administrative tasks at a local clinic.
我姐姐在当地一家诊所处理行政事务。
Reducing administrative costs could allow schools to spend more money on teaching materials and student support.
降低行政成本可以让学校将更多资金用于教材和学生支持服务。
administrative.t: 指机构的行政管理，不等于政府本身。

e: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。
People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。
admire.t: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

e: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
这家博物馆周日免费开放。
University admission should reflect academic potential rather than simply rewarding access to expensive private education.
大学录取应看重学术潜力，而非仅仅让能接受昂贵私立教育的人获益。
admission.t: 进入某处用admission to；承认某事用admission of。

e: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
我承认我忘了给你的植物浇水。
Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。
admit.t: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

e: The club offers cooking classes for adolescents after school.
这个俱乐部为青少年开设课后烹饪班。
Regular physical activity can improve adolescent mental health and support the development of lasting social connections.
定期运动可以改善青少年的心理健康，并帮助他们建立持久的社会联系。
adolescent.t: 既可作名词也可作形容词；比 teenager 更正式。

e: We adopted a simpler way to organise our shopping.
我们采用了一种更简单的方法来安排购物。
Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。
adopt.t: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

e: My grandparents adore spending quiet afternoons in their garden.
我的祖父母非常喜欢在花园里度过宁静的下午。
Although many visitors adore historic neighbourhoods, excessive tourism can disrupt the daily lives of residents.
虽然许多游客非常喜爱历史街区，但过度旅游可能扰乱居民的日常生活。
adore.t: 语气比like强；后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

e: Fresh flowers adorned every table at the family celebration.
家庭庆典上，每张桌子都用鲜花装点。
Public artworks adorn many urban spaces, making neighbourhoods more attractive and encouraging residents to explore their surroundings.
公共艺术作品装点着许多城市空间，使街区更具吸引力，并鼓励居民探索周边环境。
adorn.t: 用adorn A with B表示“用B装饰A”。

e: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。
Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。
adult.t: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

e: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。
Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。
advance.t: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

e: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。
Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。
advanced.t: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

e: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
你的长手臂让你在游泳时更有优势。
One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。
advantage.t: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

e: Booking early was advantageous because we got cheaper tickets.
提前预订很划算，因为我们买到了更便宜的票。
Flexible working arrangements can be advantageous to employers by improving staff satisfaction and reducing employee turnover.
灵活的工作安排能提高员工满意度、减少人员流失，从而使雇主受益。
advantageous.t: 常用be advantageous to sb表示对某人有利。

e: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.
智能手机的出现改变了我们拍照的方式。
The advent of affordable renewable energy has encouraged governments to reconsider their dependence on fossil fuels.
价格可负担的可再生能源的出现，促使各国政府重新审视对化石燃料的依赖。
advent.t: 常用the advent of，指重要新事物的出现。

e: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。
Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。
adventure.t: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。

e: Our ferry was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
由于天气恶劣，我们的渡轮航班取消了。
Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can have adverse effects on residents' sleep and mental health.
长期接触交通噪声可能对居民的睡眠和心理健康产生不良影响。
adverse.t: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

e: The bakery advertises its fresh bread on local radio.
这家面包店在当地电台为自家的新鲜面包做广告。
Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。
advertise.t: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

e: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。
Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。
advertisement.t: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

e: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。
Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。
advice.t: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

e: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
医生建议我休息几天。
Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
学校应在学生选择进修科目之前，就职业选择向他们提供建议。
advise.t: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。

e: Our neighbours advocate planting more trees along the street.
我们的邻居主张在街边多种些树。
Many health professionals advocate regular physical activity as an affordable way to prevent chronic disease.
许多医疗专业人士提倡定期运动，认为这是预防慢性病的一种经济实惠的方法。
advocate.t: 名词末尾读/kət/；动词可接动名词，不接to do。

e: The aerial photograph showed our house beside the river.
这张航拍照片拍出了我们河边的房子。
Aerial surveys allow researchers to monitor forest loss across remote regions without disturbing wildlife.
航空调查让研究人员能够监测偏远地区的森林流失，而不惊扰野生动物。
aerial.t: 作“天线”主要用于英式英语；美式常用antenna。

e: The aeroplane flew low over the sandy beach.
飞机低空飞过沙滩上方。
Travelling by aeroplane connects distant communities, but its environmental impact has encouraged debate about alternative transport.
乘飞机出行连接了相隔遥远的社区，但其环境影响引发了对替代交通方式的讨论。
aeroplane.t: 英式用aeroplane，美式用airplane；口语常用plane。

e: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
这些木架让这个房间更有美感。
Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
城市规划者应同时考虑公共空间的实用功能和审美品质。
The family picnic was a cheerful affair despite the rain.
尽管下着雨，这次家庭野餐仍然很欢乐。
Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。
affair.t: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

e: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
喝太多咖啡会影响你的睡眠质量。
Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。
affect.t: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

e: Our cat shows affection by rubbing against our legs.
我们家的猫会蹭我们的腿来表达亲昵。
Children who receive consistent affection from caregivers often develop greater emotional security and stronger social relationships.
持续得到照护者关爱的儿童，往往会形成更强的情感安全感和更稳固的社会关系。
affection.t: 通常不可数；对某人的喜爱用affection for。

e: Our local cycling club is affiliated with a national organisation.
我们当地的自行车俱乐部隶属于一个全国性组织。
Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
小型研究机构常与大学建立隶属关系，以获得使用专业设备和借助学术专长的机会。
affiliate.t: 名词词尾读 /ət/，动词词尾读 /eɪt/。

e: Both parents affirmed their support for her career choice.
父母双方都明确表示支持她的职业选择。
Schools should affirm the value of cultural diversity by ensuring that teaching materials reflect different backgrounds and experiences.
学校应确保教材体现不同的背景与经历，以肯定文化多样性的价值。
affirm.t: affirm语气正式，强调明确肯定；可接that从句。

e: Seasonal allergies afflict my brother whenever the flowers bloom.
每到鲜花盛开时，季节性过敏就让我的哥哥备受困扰。
Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.
缺水问题持续困扰农村社区，限制农业生产，并加重当地家庭的负担。
afflict.t: 常用被动be afflicted with，后接疾病或困境。

e: We cannot afford a new sofa this month.
我们这个月买不起新沙发。
Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。
afford.t: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

e: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
那只小狗害怕吵闹的吸尘器。
Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
有些员工不敢反映职场问题，因为他们担心失去工作。
afraid.t: 通常作表语，不放名词前；用afraid of或afraid to do。

e: My cousin returned from Africa with beautiful handmade baskets.
我的表亲从非洲回来，带回了漂亮的手工编织篮子。
Investment in renewable energy across Africa could expand electricity access while supporting sustainable economic development.
在非洲各地投资可再生能源可以扩大电力覆盖范围，同时支持经济的可持续发展。
africa.t: 洲名首字母大写，通常不加冠词；非洲不是国家。

e: We spotted several African elephants beside a muddy waterhole.
我们在一个泥泞的水塘边发现了几头非洲象。
Many African countries are investing in solar energy to improve electricity access in remote rural communities.
许多非洲国家正投资太阳能，以改善偏远农村社区的电力供应。
african.t: 首字母须大写；表示来自非洲，不限定肤色。

e: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。
After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。
after.t: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

e: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。
Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。
afternoon.t: 泛指下午用in；具体某天下午用on。

e: We watched a film and discussed the ending afterward.
我们看了一部电影，之后讨论了结局。
Students who review new material shortly afterward are more likely to remember it over the long term.
学生学习新内容后若及时复习，就更有可能长期记住它。
We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。
Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。
afterwards.t: 是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

e: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？
If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.
如果城市不解决交通拥堵的成因，同样的交通问题就会再次出现。
again.t: again表示重复；again and again强调反复多次。

e: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。
Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。
against.t: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

e: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。
age.t: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

e: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店。
A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。
agency.t: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。

e: The travel agent found us a cheaper flight home.
旅行代理人为我们找到了更便宜的回程航班。
Local community groups can act as agents of change by encouraging residents to adopt more sustainable habits.
当地社区团体可以鼓励居民养成更可持续的生活习惯，从而推动变革。
agent.t: agent不只指特工；cleaning agent中的agent指剂。

e: The aggressive dog growled whenever anyone approached its gate.
每当有人靠近大门，那只凶悍的狗就会低吼。
Aggressive marketing campaigns may increase sales, but they can also encourage unnecessary consumption and household debt.
强势营销活动可能提高销量，但也可能助长不必要的消费和家庭负债。
aggressive.t: 形容行为常含贬义；商业语境可指强势进取。

e: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。
Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。
ago.t: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。

e: I agonized over which course to choose all weekend.
整个周末，我都在为选哪门课而纠结。
Many graduates agonize over whether to pursue further education or enter an increasingly competitive job market.
许多毕业生为继续深造还是进入竞争日益激烈的就业市场而苦恼。
I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。
Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。
agree.t: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

e: We spent an agreeable afternoon chatting in the garden.
我们在花园里聊天，度过了一个愉快的下午。
Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.
如果管理者解释好处并回应员工的顾虑，员工可能会更愿意接受组织变革。
agreeable.t: be agreeable to sth表示愿意接受某事，语气较正式。

e: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
我们就共用厨房达成了协议。
International agreements on carbon emissions are more effective when participating countries establish clear targets and monitor progress.
当参与国设定明确目标并监督进展时，关于碳排放的国际协定会更加有效。
agreement.t: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

e: The museum displays agricultural tools used by local farmers.
博物馆展出了当地农民使用过的农具。
Modern agricultural practices can increase food production, but excessive chemical use may damage soil and water quality.
现代农业生产方式可以提高粮食产量，但过量使用化学品可能损害土壤和水质。
Many families here earn their living through agriculture.
这里许多家庭靠农业谋生。
Sustainable agriculture can protect soil quality while providing enough food for a growing global population.
可持续农业既能保护土壤质量，又能为不断增长的全球人口提供充足的食物。
Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
一直往前走，直到走到那座小桥。
Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.
城市需要提前规划，确保交通网络能满足人口增长带来的需求。
ahead.t: ahead是副词；后接人或事物时用ahead of。

e: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
志愿者为村子送来了食物和医疗援助。
International aid can improve access to clean water, but lasting progress also requires investment in local infrastructure.
国际援助可以改善清洁用水的获取条件，但持久进步还需要对当地基础设施进行投资。
aid.t: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

e: The pharmacist suggested a remedy for my stomach ailment.
药剂师为我的胃部不适推荐了一种药。
Treating minor ailments at local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals and improve access to healthcare.
在社区诊所治疗小病能减轻医院压力，并让人们更方便地获得医疗服务。
ailment.t: 可数名词，通常指小病，常搭配 minor。

e: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。
The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。
aim.t: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

e: I opened the window to let fresh air in.
我打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
Improving air quality in cities requires cleaner transport and stricter controls on industrial emissions.
改善城市空气质量需要更清洁的交通方式，以及对工业排放更严格的管控。
air.t: 表示空气时不可数；an air of表示“带有某种气质”。

e: Please turn on the air-conditioning before the guests arrive.
请在客人到来之前打开空调。
Greater reliance on air-conditioning during heatwaves can place considerable pressure on urban electricity supplies.
热浪期间对空调依赖加深，可能给城市电力供应带来很大压力。
air-conditioning.t: 不可数；一台空调机用an air conditioner。

e: A small aircraft flew low over the fields.
一架小型飞机低空飞过田野。
Developing more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption, although growing passenger demand may limit the environmental benefits.
研发效率更高的飞机可以降低燃料消耗，但不断增长的旅客需求可能限制其环境效益。
The airline sent us new tickets after cancelling our flight.
航班取消后，航空公司给我们发了新机票。
Airlines can lower their environmental impact by investing in more efficient aircraft and reducing unnecessary flights.
航空公司可以通过投资更高效的飞机并减少不必要的航班来降低环境影响。
airline.t: airline指航空公司；具体航班用flight。

e: We sent the parcel by airmail yesterday morning.
我们昨天上午通过航空邮递寄出了包裹。
Although digital communication dominates international business, airmail remains useful for sending original documents overseas.
尽管数字通信主导着国际商务，航空邮递在向海外寄送文件原件方面仍然有用。
airmail.t: 表示寄送方式用by airmail，不加冠词。

e: We watched the airplane disappear behind a white cloud.
我们看着飞机消失在一朵白云后面。
Travelling by airplane connects remote communities to essential services, although it also contributes to carbon emissions.
乘飞机出行让偏远社区能够获得必要服务，但也会增加碳排放。
airplane.t: airplane常用于美式英语，英式通常用aeroplane。

e: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。
Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.
扩建机场可能促进旅游业，但也可能加重附近居民受到的噪声污染。
airport.t: 在机场通常用at the airport；航站楼是terminal。

e: Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
请不要把包放在过道上。
Wider supermarket aisles can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make shopping more comfortable for everyone.
更宽的超市通道能方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让所有人购物时更加舒适。
aisle.t: s不发音，与isle同音；aisle seat是靠过道座位。

e: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。
Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。
alarm.t: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

e: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。
Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。
This restaurant serves fresh juice but does not sell alcohol.
这家餐馆供应鲜榨果汁，但不卖酒。
Public health campaigns should explain how excessive alcohol consumption can damage both physical and mental health.
公共卫生宣传应解释过量饮酒如何损害身心健康。
alcohol.t: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。

e: The waiter asked whether we wanted any alcoholic drinks.
服务员问我们是否需要含酒精的饮品。
Clear information about alcoholic beverages can help consumers understand health risks and make more informed choices.
关于酒精饮品的清晰信息可以帮助消费者了解健康风险，并作出更明智的选择。
alcoholic.t: 指人时宜用person with alcohol dependence，更尊重。

e: Under the microscope, the tiny green alga looked beautiful.
在显微镜下，这个微小的绿藻显得很美。
Researchers are investigating whether this freshwater alga can remove pollutants from wastewater while producing material suitable for biofuel.
研究人员正在探索这种淡水藻能否在去除废水污染物的同时，产生适合制造生物燃料的原料。
alga.t: alga是单数，复数为algae；整体谈藻类常用复数。

e: The city's constant noise felt alien after our quiet village.
住惯了安静的村庄后，城市持续不断的噪声让我们感到很陌生。
Teaching methods that seem alien to international students may require careful explanation and additional support from university staff.
对于国际学生感到陌生的教学方法，大学教职员工可能需要仔细解释并提供额外支持。
alien.t: 称外国人为alien有疏离感；通常用foreign national。

e: His constant complaints alienated even his closest friends.
他不停地抱怨，连最亲近的朋友都疏远了他。
Public transport policies may alienate residents if local authorities fail to explain their benefits clearly.
如果地方政府未能清楚解释公共交通政策的好处，这些政策可能会失去居民的支持。
alienate.t: 常指使人疏远或失去支持，不表示挪用。

e: Joining a local choir eased her sense of alienation.
加入当地合唱团缓解了她的疏离感。
Rapid urban development can deepen residents' alienation when familiar neighbourhoods are replaced by anonymous apartment blocks.
当熟悉的街区被缺乏特色的公寓楼取代时，快速的城市开发可能加深居民的疏离感。
alienation.t: 日常多指疏离感；哲学、社会学中可指异化。

e: The candles were still alight when we arrived.
我们到达时，蜡烛还燃着。
Passengers should wait until the bus has stopped completely before they alight from the vehicle.
乘客应等公交车完全停稳后再下车。
alight.t: 形容词通常作表语；下车用alight from。

e: The mechanic checked the alignment of my front wheels.
修理工检查了我的前轮定位。
Closer alignment between school curricula and workplace needs could improve employment prospects for young graduates.
学校课程与职场需求更加协调，有助于改善年轻毕业生的就业前景。
alignment.t: in alignment with可指位置对齐或目标一致。

e: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。
Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。
alike.t: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

e: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。
Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。
alive.t: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

e: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
所有孩子都带了水果来野餐。
Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.
政府应确保所有公民无论收入如何，都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。
all.t: all可接复数或不可数名词；every接单数可数名词。

e: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
尽管移居国外，他仍忠于家乡的俱乐部。
Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.
政治立场上的忠诚会影响选民如何解读经济政策，以及如何评价当选官员的表现。
allegiance.t: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

e: I am allergic to cats, so I keep my distance.
我对猫过敏，所以会和猫保持距离。
Restaurants should provide accurate ingredient information to protect customers who are allergic to common foods.
餐馆应提供准确的配料信息，以保护对常见食物过敏的顾客。
allergic.t: 说对某物过敏用be allergic to，不用allergic with。

e: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
我哥哥对花生和核桃过敏。
Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
学校应制定明确流程，为出现严重食物过敏反应的儿童提供帮助。
allergy.t: 常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

e: A warm bath helped alleviate the ache in my shoulders.
洗个热水澡帮助缓解了我的肩膀酸痛。
Expanding affordable housing could alleviate pressure on low-income families and reduce the risk of homelessness.
增加可负担住房可以减轻低收入家庭的压力，并降低无家可归的风险。
alleviate.t: 直接接痛苦或问题；表示减轻，不一定彻底消除。

e: The two clubs formed an alliance to save the pool.
这两家俱乐部结成联盟，力图保住游泳池。
An international alliance can help countries coordinate their responses to environmental threats that cross national borders.
国际联盟可以帮助各国协调应对跨越国界的环境威胁。
alliance.t: 常用form an alliance with，表示“与……结盟”。

e: We allocated one cupboard to all our baking equipment.
我们专门腾出了一个橱柜来放所有烘焙用具。
Local authorities should allocate more funding to public transport in areas with limited access to essential services.
地方政府应向基本服务不易获取的地区投入更多公共交通资金。
allocate.t: allocate sth to sb/sth表示将某物分配给某人或某项用途。

e: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。
Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。
allow.t: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

e: My weekly allowance covers bus fares and occasional snacks.
我每周的零用钱够支付公交车费，偶尔还能买些零食。
A housing allowance can help essential workers afford accommodation in cities where rents are particularly high.
住房津贴能够帮助必要岗位的工作人员负担租金特别高的城市中的住宿费用。
allowance.t: 零用钱义常见于美式英语；英式常用pocket money。

e: This bicycle frame is made from a lightweight alloy.
这辆自行车的车架由轻质合金制成。
Engineers are developing stronger alloys to reduce vehicle weight and improve fuel efficiency.
工程师正在开发更坚固的合金，以减轻车辆重量并提高燃油效率。
alloy.t: 名词重音在前；动词常读/əˈlɔɪ/。

e: He alluded to a surprise but gave no details.
他暗示会有个惊喜，但没有透露细节。
The report alludes to funding difficulties without explaining how they might affect the proposed transport improvements.
报告间接提及资金困难，却没有解释这些困难可能如何影响拟议的交通改善项目。
allude.t: 固定用allude to，不直接接宾语；勿混elude。

e: Our vegetables grow well in the rich alluvial soil.
我们的蔬菜在肥沃的冲积土中长势良好。
Alluvial plains often support intensive agriculture because rivers deposit fertile sediment across these lowland areas.
冲积平原通常有利于集约农业，因为河流会在这些低地沉积肥沃的泥沙。
alluvial.t: 常修饰soil、plain、deposits，强调流水沉积形成。

e: My neighbour became an ally in saving the park.
在保护公园这件事上，我的邻居成了我的盟友。
Local charities can be valuable allies for governments seeking to reduce poverty and improve social inclusion.
对于致力于减贫和促进社会包容的政府而言，当地慈善机构可以成为重要盟友。
ally.t: 名词重音通常在前；动词通常读/əˈlaɪ/。

e: She sprinkled chopped almonds over her bowl of porridge.
她在那碗燕麦粥上撒了些切碎的扁桃仁。
Almond production requires substantial irrigation in some regions, raising concerns about the sustainability of local water supplies.
一些地区的扁桃种植需要大量灌溉，引发了对当地供水可持续性的担忧。
almond.t: 通常指扁桃仁（巴旦木），并非杏核中的杏仁。

e: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。
Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。
I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。
Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。
alone.t: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

e: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。
Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。
along.t: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

e: I cycled alongside my sister by the river.
我沿着河边骑车，与姐姐并排而行。
Schools should teach practical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for adult life.
学校应在教授学术课程的同时传授实用技能，帮助学生为成年生活做好准备。
alongside.t: 作介词后接名词；也可表示两件事同时进行。

e: Please read the recipe aloud while I mix.
我搅拌的时候，请把食谱读出来。
Reading stories aloud can help young children develop vocabulary and strengthen their understanding of spoken language.
大声朗读故事可以帮助幼儿积累词汇，并增强他们对口语的理解。
aloud.t: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。

e: My little sister learned the alphabet through a song.
我的小妹妹通过一首歌学会了字母表。
Learning the alphabet is an important early step towards literacy, but children also need regular reading practice.
学习字母表是掌握读写能力的重要起点，但孩子也需要经常练习阅读。
alphabet.t: alphabet指整套字母；单个字母用letter。

e: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。
Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。
already.t: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

e: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。
Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.
公共图书馆提供免费书籍，也为社区学习提供宝贵的空间。
also.t: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

e: Could you alter these trousers so they fit better?
你能改一下这条裤子，让它更合身吗？
Rising temperatures may alter rainfall patterns and create serious challenges for farmers in dry regions.
气温上升可能改变降雨模式，给干旱地区的农民带来严峻挑战。
alter.t: 可及物也可不及物；altar是“祭坛”，勿混。

e: Cycling is a cheaper alternative to taking the bus.
骑自行车是比坐公交车更便宜的出行选择。
Governments should invest in alternative energy sources to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve energy security.
政府应投资替代能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖并提高能源安全。
alternative.t: 替代某物用alternative to，不限于二选一。

e: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。
Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。
although.t: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

e: We felt breathless because of the high altitude.
由于海拔高，我们感到喘不过气来。
At higher altitudes, reduced oxygen levels can affect physical performance and require a period of adjustment.
海拔较高时，氧气含量降低会影响身体表现，需要一段适应期。
altitude.t: altitude指高度；attitude指态度，注意拼写区别。

e: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。
Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。
altogether.t: altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

e: This aluminium pan is light enough to carry camping.
这个铝锅很轻，适合露营时携带。
Recycling aluminium requires significantly less energy than producing new metal from raw materials, reducing industrial emissions.
回收铝所需的能源远少于从原材料中提炼新铝，有助于减少工业排放。
This aluminum ladder is light enough to carry alone.
这把铝梯很轻，一个人就能搬动。
Recycling aluminum requires substantially less energy than producing new metal from ore, reducing the environmental impact of manufacturing.
回收铝所需的能源远少于从矿石中提炼新铝，因此能减少制造业对环境的影响。
aluminum.t: 美式拼写；英式通常写aluminium，读音也不同。

e: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。
Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。
always.t: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

e: Although an amateur, she takes beautiful photographs of birds.
虽然是业余爱好者，她拍的鸟类照片却很漂亮。
Amateur sports clubs provide affordable opportunities for physical activity and help strengthen relationships within local communities.
业余体育俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，并有助于加强社区居民之间的联系。
amateur.t: amateur通常指非职业者，不一定表示水平低。

e: The magician's clever tricks never fail to amaze the children.
魔术师巧妙的戏法总能让孩子们惊叹不已。
Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。
amaze.t: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

e: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。
Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。
amazing.t: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

e: The ambassador welcomed visitors to the embassy garden.
大使在使馆花园迎接了来宾。
An ambassador can strengthen international cooperation by encouraging educational exchanges and maintaining dialogue during periods of tension.
大使可以通过鼓励教育交流并在紧张时期保持对话，来加强国际合作。
ambassador.t: 驻某国大使用 ambassador to，不用 for。

e: His ambiguous reply left us unsure whether to come.
他的回答含糊不清，让我们拿不准该不该来。
Ambiguous wording in public health advice can confuse readers and reduce their confidence in official guidance.
公共卫生建议中的含糊措辞可能让读者困惑，并降低他们对官方指导的信任。
ambiguous.t: 侧重可作多种解读；vague侧重细节不清。

e: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。
Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.
学校应培养学生的进取心，同时帮助他们设定切实可行的目标并发展实用技能。
ambition.t: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

e: My ambitious sister hopes to run her own bakery.
我那有抱负的姐姐希望经营自己的面包店。
The city has announced an ambitious plan to replace all diesel buses with electric vehicles within a decade.
该市宣布了一项宏大的计划，要在十年内将所有柴油公交车更换为电动车。
ambitious.t: 形容人指有抱负；形容计划则强调目标宏大、难度高。

e: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
对于搬离家人这件事，我的心情很矛盾。
Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
许多消费者对网购仍持矛盾态度，因为便利与隐私方面的担忧需要权衡。
ambivalent.t: 常接about；指好坏感受并存，不是毫不在意。

e: An ambulance arrived quickly and took him to hospital.
救护车很快赶到，把他送去了医院。
Improving ambulance access in remote communities can reduce delays in treatment and increase patients' chances of recovery.
改善偏远社区的救护车服务可以减少治疗延误，提高患者康复的机会。
ambulance.t: 以元音音素开头，前用an；叫救护车用call an ambulance。

e: Please amend the booking to include one extra guest.
请修改预订，增加一位客人。
Parliament may amend existing legislation to ensure that remote workers receive the same protections as office employees.
议会可能修订现行法律，确保远程工作者获得与办公室员工相同的保护。
amend.t: 常指修改文件或法律；修理实物通常用mend。

e: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
我的表亲搬到美国去学工程。
Many universities in America attract international students through their research facilities and diverse academic programmes.
美国的许多大学凭借研究设施和多样化的学术课程吸引国际学生。
america.t: 日常多指美国；南北美洲合称常用the Americas。

e: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
我的美国邻居邀请我们去他家吃南瓜派。
American universities attract international students through their diverse courses, research facilities, and opportunities for professional development.
美国大学凭借多样的课程、科研设施和职业发展机会吸引国际学生。
american.t: 首字母始终大写；通常指美国，而非整个美洲。

e: Our amiable neighbour always stops to chat by the gate.
我们那位和蔼的邻居总会在门口停下来聊几句。
An amiable manner can help healthcare professionals build trust with patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.
亲切的态度能帮助医护人员与来自不同文化背景的患者建立信任。
amiable.t: amiable多形容人；amicable多形容关系或协议。

e: This cleaning liquid contains ammonia, so keep the window open.
这种清洁液含有氨，所以要开着窗户。
Ammonia emissions from agriculture can contribute to air pollution and damage sensitive natural habitats.
农业产生的氨排放会加剧空气污染，并破坏脆弱的自然栖息地。
ammonia.t: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

e: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。
Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.
经常锻炼在一天大部分时间坐着的上班族中越来越受欢迎。
among.t: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

e: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
往碗里加少量牛奶。
Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。
amount.t: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

e: We have ample time for breakfast before the train leaves.
火车出发前，我们有充足的时间吃早餐。
Providing ample green space in residential areas can improve public health and encourage more active lifestyles.
在住宅区提供充足的绿地能够改善公众健康，并鼓励更积极的生活方式。
ample.t: ample强调足够甚至有余，常修饰time、space、evidence。

e: He connected his guitar to a small amplifier.
他把吉他接到了一台小型扩音器上。
An amplifier can make a speaker's voice clearly audible throughout a large lecture hall.
扩音器可以让整个大型报告厅都清楚地听到演讲者的声音。
amplifier.t: amplifier放大信号；speaker把信号转为声音。

e: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
这个小音箱把我手机播放的音乐放大了。
Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
社交媒体能够放大公众对污染的担忧，促使地方政府更迅速地回应。
amplify.t: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。

e: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
他滑稽的舞蹈逗乐了在厨房等候的每个人。
Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。
amuse.t: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。

e: Our shared kitchen is analogous to a busy workshop.
我们的共用厨房就像一个忙碌的工坊。
The role of public libraries is analogous to that of schools in supporting lifelong learning within communities.
在支持社区终身学习方面，公共图书馆的作用与学校类似。
analogous.t: 常用be analogous to，强调某方面可作比较。

e: This wooden model is an analogue of the bridge.
这个木制模型是那座桥的对应模型。
Researchers use a mechanical analogue of the human heart to investigate how blood flows through damaged valves.
研究人员利用模拟人类心脏的机械装置，研究血液如何流经受损的瓣膜。
analogue.t: 名词指对应物；形容词指模拟式，区别于digital。

e: Her analogy compared our busy kitchen to a train station.
她把我们忙碌的厨房比作火车站。
Teachers often draw an analogy between electrical circuits and flowing water to explain unfamiliar scientific concepts.
教师常将电路与流水作类比，以解释学生不熟悉的科学概念。
analogy.t: 常用draw an analogy between A and B。

e: We analysed our spending and cancelled two unused subscriptions.
我们分析了开销，取消了两项没在用的订阅。
Researchers analyse survey responses to identify the main barriers preventing adults from returning to education.
研究人员分析问卷回答，以找出阻碍成年人重返教育体系的主要因素。
A soil analysis showed why my plants were struggling.
土壤分析揭示了我的植物长势不佳的原因。
Careful analysis of travel patterns can help planners design more efficient public transport networks.
仔细分析出行模式可以帮助规划人员设计更高效的公共交通网络。
Her analytic approach helped us understand our monthly spending.
她采用分析方法，帮助我们了解每月的开支。
Schools should develop students' analytic skills so they can evaluate evidence and recognise weaknesses in public arguments.
学校应培养学生的分析能力，使他们能够评估证据并识别公共论辩中的漏洞。
analytic.t: 与analytical意思接近；日常描述分析能力更常用后者。

e: We analyzed our spending before planning the next holiday.
我们先分析了自己的开销，再计划下一次假期。
Researchers analyze traffic patterns to identify areas where improved public transport could reduce congestion.
研究人员分析交通流动规律，找出改善公共交通可能缓解拥堵的区域。
analyze.t: 美式拼写为analyze，英式通常写analyse。

e: We studied anatomy using a plastic model of the heart.
我们用一个塑料心脏模型学习解剖学。
A thorough knowledge of human anatomy helps medical students understand how injuries affect movement.
深入了解人体解剖学有助于医学生理解损伤如何影响运动。
anatomy.t: anatomy侧重身体结构，physiology侧重生理功能。

e: One of my ancestors built this old stone house.
我的一位祖先建造了这座古老的石屋。
Studying how our ancestors adapted to environmental change can offer insights into human resilience.
研究祖先如何适应环境变化，可以帮助我们理解人类的适应能力。
We dropped the anchor beside a quiet island.
我们在一座宁静的小岛旁抛了锚。
Strong community networks can provide an anchor for families adapting to life in unfamiliar cities.
紧密的社区网络可以为适应陌生城市生活的家庭提供可靠的依靠。
anchor.t: drop anchor指抛锚；weigh anchor指起锚，不是称重。

e: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
我们度假时游览了一座古代寺庙。
Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。
ancient.t: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

e: I bought fresh bread and cheese for our picnic.
我为我们的野餐买了新鲜面包和奶酪。
Governments should invest in public transport and encourage cycling to reduce congestion in growing cities.
政府应投资公共交通并鼓励骑行，以缓解发展中城市的交通拥堵。
and.t: 连接并列成分时注意结构一致；口语常弱读/ən/。

e: He took a deep breath to control his anger.
他深吸了一口气来控制自己的怒气。
Public anger over rising transport costs can encourage local authorities to reconsider their pricing policies.
公众对交通费用上涨的愤怒，可能促使地方政府重新考虑定价政策。
anger.t: anger作名词通常不可数；形容词是angry。

e: Adjust the angle of your screen to reduce glare.
调整屏幕角度以减少眩光。
Examining housing shortages from an economic angle can reveal how planning restrictions influence property prices.
从经济角度审视住房短缺，可以揭示规划限制如何影响房价。
angle.t: angle 是角度；angel 才是天使，注意字母顺序。

e: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。
Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。
angry.t: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

e: The angular table looked striking beside our curved sofa.
那张棱角分明的桌子放在我们的弧形沙发旁格外醒目。
The museum's angular design contrasts sharply with the rounded forms commonly found in the surrounding landscape.
这座博物馆棱角分明的设计与周围景观中常见的圆润形态形成鲜明对比。
angular.t: 形容外形棱角分明，也可形容人瘦削。

e: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。
Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.
保护动物栖息地至关重要，因为生物多样性有助于维持生态系统稳定，并造福人类。
animal.t: animal 不仅指哺乳动物；鸟、鱼和昆虫也属于动物。

e: Her funny stories always animate our family dinners.
她的趣事总能让家庭聚餐活跃起来。
Teachers can animate classroom discussions by encouraging students to share experiences from their own communities.
教师可以鼓励学生分享各自社区的经历，让课堂讨论活跃起来。
animate.t: 动词末尾读/meɪt/；形容词末尾读/mət/。

e: She twisted her ankle while walking down the steps.
她下台阶时扭伤了脚踝。
Appropriate footwear can reduce the risk of ankle injuries during physical exercise and outdoor activities.
合适的鞋子可以降低体育锻炼和户外活动中脚踝受伤的风险。
ankle.t: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

e: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。
The museum celebrated its anniversary by offering free admission to encourage more residents to explore local history.
博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。
anniversary.t: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。

e: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
今天午饭后，我们的老师宣布了获奖者。
Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。
announce.t: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

e: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
我们听到了一则关于所乘列车晚点的通知。
The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.
政府宣布追加教育经费，受到教师和家长的欢迎。
announcement.t: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

e: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。
Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。
annoy.t: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

e: Leila looked annoyed when the printer jammed again.
打印机又卡纸了，莱拉显得有些恼火。
Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。
annoyed.t: annoyed形容人的感受；annoying形容令人恼火的事物。

e: Our annual family picnic was held beside the lake.
我们一年一度的家庭野餐在湖边举行。
The annual report provides useful evidence of how public funding has improved local transport services.
年度报告提供了有用的证据，说明公共资金如何改善了当地交通服务。
annual.t: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

e: An anonymous donor paid for the children's new playground.
一位匿名捐赠者出资为孩子们建了新游乐场。
Anonymous surveys can encourage employees to express honest opinions about conditions in their workplace.
匿名调查能鼓励员工坦诚表达对工作环境的看法。
anonymous.t: 匿名是anonymous；保密是confidential，含义不同。

e: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。
Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
another.t: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

e: I asked the price, but nobody gave an answer.
我问了价格，却没有人回答。
Improving public transport may provide an answer to traffic congestion in rapidly growing urban areas.
改善公共交通或许能为快速发展的城市地区提供缓解交通拥堵的办法。
answer.t: 动词answer直接接问题；名词用the answer to。

e: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。
Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。
ant.t: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

e: We watched a film about penguins on Antarctic ice.
我们看了一部关于南极冰面上企鹅的影片。
Scientists monitor Antarctic ice to understand how rising global temperatures affect sea levels worldwide.
科学家监测南极冰层，以了解全球气温升高如何影响世界各地的海平面。
antarctic.t: 名词用the Antarctic；Antarctica专指南极洲。

e: My cousin photographed penguins during a trip to Antarctica.
我表亲去南极洲旅行时拍了企鹅的照片。
Scientists studying Antarctica analyse ancient ice to understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
研究南极洲的科学家通过分析古老冰层，了解地球气候如何随时间变化。
antarctica.t: 洲名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

e: This simple wooden tool is an antecedent of modern machines.
这件简单的木制工具是现代机器的前身。
Researchers examine the historical antecedents of urban inequality to understand why certain communities remain disadvantaged.
研究人员考察城市不平等的历史根源，以理解某些社区为何一直处于弱势。
antecedent.t: 语法中指代词所指的先行词；不宜直接等同祖先。

e: My cousin studies anthropology and collects stories about family traditions.
我的表姐学习人类学，并收集有关家庭传统的故事。
Anthropology helps researchers understand how cultural traditions influence attitudes towards health, education, and family life.
人类学帮助研究者理解文化传统如何影响人们对健康、教育和家庭生活的态度。
anthropology.t: 通常为不可数名词；研究者称anthropologist。

e: The office still relies on an antiquated heating system.
这间办公室仍然依赖一套陈旧过时的供暖系统。
Replacing antiquated railway infrastructure could improve passenger safety and reduce delays across the national transport network.
更换陈旧的铁路基础设施，可以提高乘客安全水平，并减少全国交通网络的延误。
antiquated.t: 含贬义，强调旧到不合时宜；antique可指珍贵古物。

e: We found a beautiful antique in a small shop.
我们在一家小店里发现了一件漂亮的古董。
Preserving antique furniture helps future generations understand traditional craftsmanship and the everyday lives of people in the past.
保存古董家具有助于后代理解传统工艺以及过去人们的日常生活。
antique.t: antique强调古老且有收藏价值，不只是旧。

e: Our teacher asked us for an antonym of generous.
老师让我们说出一个generous的反义词。
Learning an antonym alongside each new adjective can help language students understand contrasts and expand their vocabulary.
语言学习者每学一个新形容词时同时学习其反义词，有助于理解对比关系并扩大词汇量。
antonym.t: 常用an antonym of；synonym表示同义词。

e: Her anxiety faded when she heard the good news.
听到好消息后，她的焦虑消退了。
Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。
anxiety.t: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

e: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
等待考试成绩时，我感到很焦虑。
Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。
anxious.t: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

e: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。
Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。
any.t: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

e: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？
Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.
公共图书馆应向所有想学习的人开放，不论其收入或背景如何。
anybody.t: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

e: It was raining, but we went swimming anyhow.
虽然下着雨，我们还是去游泳了。
Although public transport improvements require substantial funding, cities should invest in them anyhow to reduce congestion.
虽然改善公共交通需要大量资金，城市仍应投入，以缓解拥堵。
anyhow.t: 表示“反正”较口语化；勿与somehow混淆。

e: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
我不再坐公交车上学了。
Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
许多员工不再每天通勤，因为雇主如今提供灵活的工作安排。
anymore.t: 表示“不再”；英式常写any more，数量“更多”须分写。

e: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。
Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。
anyone.t: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

e: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。
Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。
anything.t: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

e: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。
Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。
anyway.t: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

e: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。
Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。
anywhere.t: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

e: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。
Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。
apart.t: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

e: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。
Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。
apartment.t: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

e: I apologized to my neighbour for the noise.
我为噪声向邻居道了歉。
Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。
apologize.t: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

e: I sent my neighbour an apology for the noise.
我为制造噪声向邻居致歉。
A sincere public apology can help organisations rebuild trust after mistakes, but practical changes are also necessary.
犯错后，真诚的公开道歉有助于机构重建信任，但实际改进也不可或缺。
apology.t: 向某人道歉用apology to someone for something。

e: Her excitement was apparent from her huge smile.
从她灿烂的笑容中可以明显看出她很兴奋。
Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。
apparent.t: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

e: Apparently, the bakery closes early on rainy days.
听说那家面包店下雨天会提早关门。
Apparently, many residents support the proposed park, although a formal survey has not yet been conducted.
看来许多居民支持拟建公园的计划，但正式调查尚未开展。
apparently.t: 表示据现有信息推测，不保证事实确实如此。

e: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。
Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。
appear.t: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

e: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。
Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。
appearance.t: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

e: You'll find the full recipe in the appendix.
你可以在附录里找到完整的食谱。
The report includes an appendix explaining how researchers collected and analysed the survey data.
报告附有一份附录，说明研究人员如何收集和分析调查数据。
appendix.t: 附录复数可用appendices；阑尾常用appendixes。

e: A long walk always gives me a good appetite.
走一段长路总能让我胃口大开。
The growing public appetite for sustainable products encourages companies to reconsider their materials and manufacturing processes.
公众对可持续产品日益增长的需求促使企业重新考虑其材料及制造工艺。
appetite.t: appetite for 除食欲外，也可表示对知识等的渴求。

e: Everyone applauded when the young dancer finished her performance.
年轻舞者表演结束时，所有人都鼓起了掌。
Environmental groups applauded the council's decision to protect urban wetlands from further commercial development.
环保团体赞许市政委员会保护城市湿地、避免其受到进一步商业开发影响的决定。
applaud.t: 可直接接人或事；applause是不可数名词。

e: The audience burst into applause as the curtain fell.
幕布落下时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。
The proposal received widespread applause for making public transport more accessible to passengers with disabilities.
这项提案因让残障乘客更方便地使用公共交通而广受赞誉。
applause.t: 不可数；“一阵掌声”用 a round of applause。

e: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。
Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
在学校提供苹果等新鲜水果，可能有助于鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。
apple.t: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

e: Each applicant waited outside the office for an interview.
每位申请人都在办公室外等候面试。
Universities should assess each applicant fairly, considering both academic achievement and relevant personal experience.
大学应公平评估每位申请人，兼顾学业成绩与相关个人经历。
applicant.t: 申请某职位的人用 applicant for a position。

e: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
今天早饭前，我提交了求职申请。
Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。
application.t: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

e: Apply sunscreen before you go outside on sunny days.
晴天出门前要涂防晒霜。
Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。
apply.t: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

e: The club appointed my sister as its new captain.
俱乐部任命我姐姐为新队长。
Schools should appoint qualified counsellors to help students manage stress and make informed career choices.
学校应聘任合格的辅导员，帮助学生应对压力并作出明智的职业选择。
appoint.t: 任命某人可用appoint sb as或appoint sb to职位。

e: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
我预约了明天一早看牙医。
Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.
弹性工作时间让员工无需请一整天假就能按预约就医。
appointment.t: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

e: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
经理在今天的绩效评估中表扬了我的进步。
A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.
任何大型建设项目启动之前，都应对环境风险进行全面评估。
The coach appraised my technique and suggested some changes.
教练评估了我的动作技巧，并提出了一些改进建议。
Local authorities must appraise the environmental impact of major construction projects before granting planning permission.
地方政府在批准规划许可之前，必须评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。
appraise.t: appraise是评估；不要与apprise（告知）混淆。

e: I really appreciate you watering my plants while I was away.
非常感谢你在我不在的时候帮忙给植物浇水。
Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。
appreciate.t: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

e: We baked our neighbour a cake to show our appreciation.
我们为邻居烤了一个蛋糕，以表达感谢。
Arts education can develop students' appreciation of cultural traditions that differ from their own.
艺术教育能培养学生对不同于自身文化的传统的欣赏能力。
appreciation.t: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。

e: Please apprise me of any changes before Friday.
如有任何变化，请在周五前告知我。
Schools should apprise parents of significant policy changes before introducing new rules that affect their children.
学校在推行影响孩子的新规定之前，应告知家长重大的政策变化。
apprise.t: 正式用语；用apprise sb of sth，勿混appraise。

e: We tried a different approach to training our puppy.
我们试着用另一种方法训练小狗。
A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。
approach.t: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

e: Are these shoes appropriate for a long mountain walk?
这双鞋适合长时间山间徒步吗？
Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。
We need the landlord's approval before painting the kitchen.
粉刷厨房前，我们需要得到房东的许可。
New housing projects should receive approval only when developers demonstrate that adequate transport and public services will be provided.
开发商只有证明能提供充足的交通和公共服务，新住宅项目才应获批。
approval.t: approval of常指赞同；approval for常指项目许可。

e: My manager approved my request for a day off.
经理批准了我请一天假的申请。
Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。
approve.t: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。

e: Can you give me an approximate price for the repairs?
你能告诉我维修大概要多少钱吗？
Researchers used survey responses to calculate the approximate proportion of residents who regularly used public transport.
研究人员利用调查回复，计算经常使用公共交通的居民所占的大致比例。
approximate.t: 形容词词尾读/mət/，动词词尾读/meɪt/。

e: The walk to the lake takes approximately twenty minutes.
步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。
Approximately half of the households surveyed reported using public transport at least once a week.
受访家庭中，约有一半表示每周至少使用一次公共交通。
approximately.t: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。

e: My budget is only a rough approximation of the cost.
我的预算只是对费用的粗略估计。
Computer models provide an approximation of future climate conditions rather than a precise prediction of every change.
计算机模型提供的是对未来气候状况的近似估计，而非对每一次变化的精确预测。
approximation.t: 常用an approximation of；强调接近但并不精确。

e: We are moving into our new flat in April.
我们将在四月搬进新公寓。
The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。
april.t: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

e: Leila showed an aptitude for music at school.
莱拉在学校里展现出了音乐天赋。
Schools should recognise practical aptitude as well as academic achievement when advising students about careers.
学校在为学生提供职业建议时，既应重视学业成绩，也应认可实践方面的天赋。
aptitude.t: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。

e: Two orange fish swim among plants in our aquarium.
两条橙色的鱼在我们鱼缸里的水草间游动。
A well-managed aquarium can teach visitors about marine ecosystems and encourage greater concern for ocean conservation.
管理良好的水族馆可以让游客了解海洋生态系统，并促使他们更加关注海洋保护。
aquarium.t: 既指家中的鱼缸，也指供公众参观的水族馆。

e: The family grows potatoes on a small arable field.
这家人在一小块耕地上种土豆。
Rapid urban expansion is reducing the amount of arable land available for food production in many regions.
在许多地区，城市的快速扩张正在减少可用于粮食生产的耕地面积。
arable.t: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。

e: Her choice felt arbitrary: she picked without even looking.
她的选择显得很随意：她连看都没看就选了。
Arbitrary restrictions on university admissions can prevent capable students from accessing education and may reinforce existing social inequalities.
大学招生中缺乏合理依据的限制可能让有能力的学生无法入学，并加剧现有的社会不平等。
arbitrary.t: 重点是缺乏合理依据，不只是“可以自由选择”。

e: The zoo's arboreal snakes curled around branches above our heads.
动物园里的树栖蛇盘绕在我们头顶的树枝上。
Deforestation threatens arboreal species by removing the branches and canopy they depend on for survival.
森林砍伐破坏了树栖物种赖以生存的树枝和林冠，威胁着它们的生存。
arboreal.t: 常用于动物学，描述主要生活在树上的动物。

e: We sheltered from the rain beneath a stone arch.
我们在一座石拱门下避雨。
Traditional bridges often use a central arch to distribute weight and allow boats to pass beneath.
传统桥梁常用中央拱形结构来分散重量，并让船只从下方通过。
arch.t: 作动词表示弯成拱形，如arch your back。

e: Studying archaeology taught her to recognise ancient pottery fragments.
学习考古学让她学会了辨认古代陶器碎片。
Archaeology provides valuable evidence of how earlier societies adapted to environmental change and developed trading networks.
考古学为了解早期社会如何适应环境变化、发展贸易网络提供了宝贵证据。
archaeology.t: 通常不可数；研究恐龙化石属于古生物学。

e: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。
Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。
architect.t: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

e: My brother studies architecture and builds tiny house models.
我哥哥学建筑设计，还制作小房子模型。
Sustainable architecture can reduce energy consumption by making better use of natural light and ventilation.
可持续建筑设计可以更充分地利用自然采光和通风，从而降低能耗。
An arctic fox curled up beside a snowy rock.
一只北极狐蜷缩在一块覆雪的岩石旁。
Rising temperatures threaten arctic wildlife by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.
气温升高使许多物种赖以生存的海冰减少，威胁着北极野生动物。
arctic.t: 指北极地区时用the Arctic；南极是the Antarctic。

e: The arduous climb left us exhausted but deeply satisfied.
这段艰苦的攀登让我们筋疲力尽，却也十分满足。
Restoring damaged ecosystems is an arduous process that requires sustained investment and cooperation between scientists and local communities.
修复受损生态系统是一个艰巨的过程，需要持续投资以及科学家与当地社区的合作。
There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
湖边有一处安静的野餐区。
Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。
area.t: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

e: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
孩子们为轮到谁玩而争吵。
Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。
argue.t: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

e: We had an argument about whose turn it was.
我们为该轮到谁而争吵了起来。
The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
argument.t: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

e: We practised mental arithmetic while waiting for the bus.
等公交车时，我们练习了心算。
Strong arithmetic skills help young adults manage personal budgets and make informed financial decisions.
扎实的算术能力有助于年轻人管理个人预算，并作出明智的财务决策。
arithmetic.t: 作名词通常不可数；范围比mathematics窄。

e: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。
Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。
arm.t: 表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

e: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
爷爷在窗边的扶手椅上睡着了。
Armchair critics may underestimate the practical challenges that teachers face when managing large classes with limited resources.
缺乏实践经验的评论者可能低估教师在资源有限时管理大班所面临的实际困难。
armchair.t: 坐在扶手椅里用in；作形容词时置于名词前，常含贬义。

e: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
我的表亲毕业后参军了。
During major floods, the army can provide essential transport and supplies when civilian services are overwhelmed.
发生严重洪灾时，如果民用服务不堪重负，军队可以提供必要的运输服务和物资。
army.t: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

e: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
新鲜面包的香气弥漫了整个厨房。
The aroma of freshly prepared food can enhance customers' dining experiences and influence their perception of quality.
现做食物的香气能够提升顾客的用餐体验，并影响他们对品质的判断。
aroma.t: 通常指令人愉悦的气味，尤用于食物和饮品。

e: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。
Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。
around.t: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

e: The locked wooden box aroused my curiosity immediately.
那个上锁的木盒立刻引起了我的好奇。
Proposals to replace public parks with commercial buildings are likely to arouse strong opposition among local residents.
用商业建筑取代公共公园的提案很可能激起当地居民的强烈反对。
arouse.t: arouse 后接宾语；arise 表示“出现”，不接宾语。

e: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
我约好和表亲在电影院外见面。
Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。
arrange.t: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

e: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
我们安排了人来喂猫。
Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。
arrangement.t: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

e: The bakery displayed a colourful array of cakes.
面包店陈列着各式各样、色彩缤纷的蛋糕。
Modern universities offer a wide array of courses to meet the demands of a changing labour market.
现代大学提供广泛的课程，以满足不断变化的劳动力市场需求。
array.t: 常见a wide array of，强调数量多、种类丰富。
