Some monitoring technologies can invade people's privacy, even when they are introduced to improve public safety.
某些监控技术即使是为改善公共安全而引入的，也可能侵犯人们的隐私。
invade.t: 及物动词，直接接宾语；名词形式是invasion。

e: The castle walls once protected villagers from invaders.
这些城堡围墙曾保护村民免遭入侵者袭击。
Biological invaders can disrupt local ecosystems by competing with native species for food, space, and other resources.
生物入侵者会与本地物种争夺食物、空间及其他资源，从而扰乱当地生态系统。
invader.t: invader指入侵者；invasion指入侵这一行为。

e: My ticket was invalid, so I bought another one.
我的票无效，所以我又买了一张。
Conclusions drawn from a small, unrepresentative sample may be invalid and should not guide major policy decisions.
从缺乏代表性的小样本中得出的结论可能不成立，不应作为重大政策决策的依据。
invalid.t: 名词“病弱者”重音在首音节，现已较少使用。

e: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
我买第一辆自行车时，你的建议帮了大忙。
Practical work experience provides students with invaluable insights into the skills employers expect from new graduates.
实际工作经验能帮助学生深入了解雇主对新毕业生技能的期望，这种了解十分宝贵。
invaluable.t: invaluable意为极宝贵，不是没有价值。

e: My brother invariably falls asleep during long train journeys.
我哥哥每次坐长途火车都会睡着。
In this study, participants with longer commuting times invariably reported having less time for leisure activities.
在这项研究中，通勤时间较长的参与者无一例外都表示，自己的休闲时间较少。
invariably.t: 比usually语气更强，表示每次如此，而非通常如此。

e: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。
Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。
invent.t: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

e: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。
The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。
invention.t: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

e: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
这位发明家向我们展示了一盏太阳能灯。
Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
发明者往往需要资金支持，才能把有前景的想法转化为造福社会的实用技术。
inventor.t: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。

e: We made an inventory of everything in the garage.
我们把车库里的所有东西列成了清单。
Digital systems help retailers manage inventory more efficiently, reducing waste and preventing shortages of essential products.
数字系统帮助零售商更高效地管理库存，减少浪费并防止必需品短缺。
inventory.t: 表示库存时多见于美式英语，英式常用stock。

e: Our free time and workload have an inverse relationship.
我们的空闲时间与工作量呈反向关系。
The study found an inverse relationship between regular physical activity and reported stress levels among office workers.
研究发现，上班族的规律运动量与其报告的压力水平呈负相关。
inverse.t: inverse relationship指一方增加时另一方减少。

e: Invert the bowl carefully to release the jelly.
小心地把碗倒扣过来，让果冻脱模。
Researchers can invert the usual teaching sequence by asking students to explore problems before receiving formal explanations.
研究人员可以颠倒通常的教学顺序，让学生先探究问题，再接受正式讲解。
invert.t: 通常是及物动词；倒置的用inverted。

e: My aunt plans to invest in a small bakery.
我姑姑打算投资一家小面包店。
Governments should invest in renewable energy to improve energy security and reduce dependence on imported fuels.
政府应投资可再生能源，以提高能源安全并减少对进口燃料的依赖。
invest.t: 常用invest in；投入时间做事可用invest time in doing。

e: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。
Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。
investigate.t: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

e: Buying better tools was a good investment for our bakery.
购买更好的工具对我们面包店来说是一笔不错的投资。
Greater public investment in renewable energy could create jobs while reducing dependence on fossil fuels.
加大对可再生能源的公共投资可以创造就业机会，同时减少对化石燃料的依赖。
investment.t: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。

e: The thin fishing line was almost invisible underwater.
那根细鱼线在水下几乎看不见。
Although many air pollutants are invisible, prolonged exposure can seriously damage respiratory health, particularly among children.
尽管许多空气污染物看不见，长期接触仍可能严重损害呼吸系统健康，儿童尤其如此。
invisible.t: invisible指看不见；与看不懂的incomprehensible不同。

e: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。
An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。
invitation.t: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

e: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。
Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。
invite.t: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

e: The plumber emailed an invoice after fixing our sink.
水管工修好我们的水槽后，通过电子邮件发来了付款清单。
Small businesses benefit from digital systems that track each invoice and remind customers when payments are due.
小企业可以从追踪每张发票并提醒客户按时付款的数字系统中受益。
invoice.t: invoice 通常用于要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收据。

e: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
我的新工作需要整天与顾客交谈。
Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。
involve.t: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

e: An inward push was enough to open the gate.
只需向内一推，就能打开大门。
An inward flow of investment can help developing economies improve infrastructure and create employment opportunities.
投资流入能够帮助发展中经济体改善基础设施并创造就业机会。
inward.t: 形容词用inward；副词英式英语也常用inwards。

e: We explored the west coast of Ireland by bicycle.
我们骑自行车游览了爱尔兰西海岸。
Ireland attracts international students through its English-speaking universities and opportunities to experience a different culture.
爱尔兰凭借其英语授课的大学和体验不同文化的机会吸引国际学生。
ireland.t: 可指国家或整座岛；北爱尔兰属于英国，不属于该国。

e: An Irish musician played the fiddle at our festival.
一位爱尔兰音乐家在我们的节庆活动上拉小提琴。
Traditional Irish music can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors to rural communities across the country.
爱尔兰传统音乐既能增强文化认同，也能吸引游客前往全国各地的乡村社区。
irish.t: the Irish统称爱尔兰人；单个人用an Irish person。

e: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。
A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。
iron.t: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

e: The irony is that our swimming lesson was cancelled by rain.
讽刺的是，我们的游泳课竟因下雨而取消了。
There is considerable irony in promoting environmental awareness through disposable products that create additional waste.
通过制造更多垃圾的一次性产品来宣传环保意识，颇具讽刺意味。
irony.t: irony不只是巧合，常指结果与预期形成讽刺性反差。

e: The path was made from stones of irregular shapes.
这条小路由形状不规则的石头铺成。
Working irregular hours can disrupt sleep patterns and make it harder for employees to maintain healthy routines.
工作时间不固定可能扰乱睡眠规律，使员工更难保持健康的作息。
irregular.t: 既可形容形状，也可形容时间；不规则动词也用它。

e: The smell of freshly baked bread was irresistible.
刚烤好的面包香气让人无法抗拒。
Online retailers use personalised recommendations to make certain products seem irresistible to potential customers.
网络零售商利用个性化推荐，让某些商品对潜在顾客显得极具吸引力。
irresistible.t: 常形容魅力、诱惑或冲动强烈得令人无法抗拒。

e: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
无论年龄大小，人人都可以参加这次步行活动。
Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.
所有儿童都应能获得优质教育，无论其家庭收入或社会背景如何。
irrespective.t: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

e: Once you sign, your decision becomes legally irrevocable.
一旦签字，你的决定在法律上就不可撤销了。
Governments should consult local communities before making irrevocable decisions about the destruction of historic buildings.
政府在作出拆除历史建筑的不可撤销决定之前，应征求当地社区的意见。
irrevocable.t: 常修饰决定、同意或承诺，强调无法撤回。

e: Farmers irrigate these fields with water from the river.
农民用河水灌溉这些田地。
Using treated wastewater to irrigate crops can reduce pressure on freshwater supplies in dry regions.
使用处理过的废水灌溉作物，可以减轻干旱地区的淡水供应压力。
irrigate.t: 通常作及物动词，宾语是田地或作物，不是水。

e: The farm's irrigation system keeps these vegetables growing.
农场的灌溉系统让这些蔬菜持续生长。
Efficient irrigation can increase crop yields while reducing water consumption in regions affected by drought.
在受干旱影响的地区，高效灌溉可以提高作物产量，同时减少用水量。
irrigation.t: 通常为不可数名词；动词形式是irrigate。

e: The constant dripping from the tap really irritates me.
水龙头不停滴水，真让我烦躁。
Some household cleaning products contain chemicals that can irritate the skin and cause breathing difficulties.
某些家用清洁产品含有会刺激皮肤并导致呼吸困难的化学物质。
irritate.t: irritated形容人感到烦躁；irritating形容事物烦人。

e: He sighed with irritation when the phone rang again.
电话又响了，他烦躁地叹了口气。
Exposure to household cleaning products may cause skin irritation, especially among people with sensitive skin.
接触家用清洁产品可能引起皮肤刺激，皮肤敏感者尤其如此。
irritation.t: 既可指情绪上的恼怒，也可指皮肤等受到刺激。

e: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。
Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。
island.t: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

e: Heavy snow isolated the village from the nearest town.
大雪使这个村庄与最近的城镇隔绝了。
Researchers must isolate the effects of income before drawing conclusions about the relationship between education and health.
研究人员必须单独厘清收入的影响，才能对教育与健康的关系下结论。
isolate.t: 常用isolate A from B；形容词是isolated。

e: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
我们在邻里会议上讨论了停车问题。
Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
政府必须解决住房负担能力问题，确保年轻人能够独立生活。
issue.t: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。

e: I found your scarf and put it by the door.
我找到了你的围巾，把它放在门边了。
It is essential for cities to provide reliable public transport if they want to reduce traffic congestion.
城市若想缓解交通拥堵，就必须提供可靠的公共交通。
it.t: 小写it是代词；大写IT才表示信息技术。

e: We cooked Italian pasta with tomatoes and fresh basil.
我们用番茄和新鲜罗勒做了意大利面。
Studying Italian architecture can help students understand how historical buildings influence contemporary urban design.
研究意大利建筑可以帮助学生理解历史建筑如何影响当代城市设计。
italian.t: 国籍和语言名称首字母大写；意大利人复数为Italians。

e: We travelled around Italy by train last summer.
去年夏天我们乘火车游览了意大利。
Italy attracts international visitors through its historic cities, distinctive cuisine, and rich artistic heritage.
意大利凭借历史名城、特色美食和丰富的艺术遗产吸引着国际游客。
italy.t: 国家名首字母大写，通常不加the；Italian指意大利语等。

e: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。
Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。
item.t: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

e: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。
A durable jacket made from recycled materials can offer consumers a more sustainable clothing choice.
用再生材料制成的耐穿夹克可以为消费者提供更可持续的服装选择。
jacket.t: jacket通常是短外套，不专指羽绒服。

e: The old jail now welcomes visitors as a museum.
这座旧监狱如今作为博物馆接待游客。
Education programmes in jail can help prisoners develop skills and improve their chances of finding work after release.
监狱中的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。
jail.t: in jail指在押，不加冠词；英式旧拼法为gaol。

e: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。
Frequent traffic jams increase air pollution and make daily journeys more stressful for urban residents.
频繁的交通拥堵加剧空气污染，也让城市居民的日常出行更加令人焦虑。
jam.t: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

e: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。
Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。
january.t: 月份首字母大写；在一月用in January。

e: We travelled around Japan by train during our holiday.
假期里，我们乘火车游览了日本。
Japan has invested in earthquake-resistant buildings to reduce the risks associated with living in a seismically active region.
日本投资建设抗震建筑，以降低生活在地震活跃地区所带来的风险。
japan.t: 国名首字母大写，通常不加the；日本人用Japanese。

e: We enjoyed Japanese food at a small restaurant yesterday.
昨天我们在一家小餐馆吃了日本料理。
Studying Japanese architecture can help students understand how traditional design responds to local environmental conditions.
研究日本建筑可以帮助学生理解传统设计如何适应当地环境条件。
japanese.t: 首字母始终大写；指一个日本人常用a Japanese person。

e: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。
Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。
jar.t: jar 常指有盖广口罐；a jar of 后接所装物。

e: My jaw felt sore after chewing the hard bread.
嚼完那块硬面包后，我的下颌有些酸痛。
Protective equipment can reduce the risk of jaw injuries among people who participate in contact sports.
防护装备可以降低接触性运动参与者颌部受伤的风险。
jaw.t: jaw指颌骨或颌部；chin仅指脸部最下方的下巴。

e: We listened to jazz while cooking dinner together.
我们一起做晚饭时听了爵士乐。
Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.
社区爵士音乐节既能吸引游客，也能为当地音乐人提供宝贵的演出机会。
jazz.t: 表示音乐类型时通常不可数，不加 a。

e: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。
Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。
jealous.t: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

e: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。
Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.
允许员工穿牛仔裤可能营造更轻松的工作环境，而不一定降低职业标准。
jeans.t: jeans用复数；一条用a pair of jeans。

e: Skipping practice could jeopardise your place on the team.
缺席训练可能会危及你在队中的位置。
Reducing investment in public transport could jeopardise efforts to cut urban air pollution and traffic congestion.
减少公共交通投资可能会妨碍减少城市空气污染和交通拥堵的努力。
jeopardise.t: 及物动词，直接接宾语；美式通常拼作jeopardize。

e: Skipping these safety checks could jeopardize the whole trip.
省略这些安全检查可能危及整个行程。
Excessive use of groundwater could jeopardize future food production in regions already affected by drought.
过度开采地下水可能危及已受干旱影响地区未来的粮食生产。
jeopardize.t: 直接接宾语；英式英语也常拼作jeopardise。

e: The bus jerked forward, making my shopping bag tumble.
公交车突然向前一冲，我的购物袋随之翻倒。
Poorly maintained trains may jerk unexpectedly, increasing the risk of falls among passengers who are standing.
维护不善的列车可能突然颠动，增加站立乘客跌倒的风险。
jerk.t: 动作强调突然且短促；称人为a jerk不礼貌。

e: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。
Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。
jet.t: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。

e: A blue jewel sparkled on her silver necklace.
她银项链上的一颗蓝色宝石闪闪发光。
The restored theatre is a cultural jewel that attracts visitors and supports local businesses.
修复后的剧院是一颗文化明珠，吸引着游客，也带动了当地商业。
jewel.t: jewel可数；jewellery指珠宝总称，不可数。

e: She keeps her jewellery in a small wooden box.
她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。
Traditional jewellery can reflect cultural identity while providing income for skilled craftspeople in rural communities.
传统首饰既能体现文化认同，也能为农村社区的熟练手工艺人带来收入。
jewellery.t: 不可数；一件用a piece of；美式拼写jewelry。

e: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。
Consumers increasingly want assurance that the materials used in jewelry are sourced responsibly and without environmental damage.
消费者越来越希望得到保证：首饰所用材料的来源负责任，且不损害环境。
jewelry.t: 美式拼写，英式为jewellery；不可数，用piece计件。

e: My sister found a job at the local library.
我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。
Access to practical training can help young people secure a job in a competitive labour market.
获得实用技能培训能帮助年轻人在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中找到工作。
job.t: job指具体工作，可数；work泛指工作，通常不可数。

e: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。
People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
经常慢跑的人无需昂贵的器材或健身房会员资格，也能改善心血管健康。
jog.t: jog someone's memory意为“唤起某人的记忆”。

e: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？
Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。
join.t: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

e: Buying the sofa was a joint decision with my flatmate.
买这张沙发是我和室友共同作出的决定。
Joint research projects allow universities to share resources and address environmental problems more effectively.
联合研究项目使大学能够共享资源，更有效地应对环境问题。
joint.t: joint作形容词指共同参与；作名词可指关节。

e: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。
Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。
joke.t: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

e: I keep a journal beside my bed every night.
我每晚都把一本日记放在床边。
Researchers publish their findings in academic journals so that other experts can evaluate the evidence.
研究人员在学术期刊上发表成果，以便其他专家评估相关证据。
journal.t: journal常指专业期刊；表示私人记录时近似diary。

e: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
那位记者就新公园的事采访了我们的邻居。
A responsible journalist should verify information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion.
负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众舆论的报道前，应仔细核实信息。
journalist.t: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

e: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。
journey.t: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

e: The children jumped for joy when the snow began.
开始下雪时，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。
Community gardens can bring joy to residents while strengthening social connections and encouraging healthier lifestyles.
社区花园既能给居民带来欢乐，也能加强社会联系并鼓励更健康的生活方式。
joy.t: 表喜悦通常不可数；表乐事可数，如a joy。

e: Don't judge the soup until you have tasted it.
先尝尝这汤，再评价它。
Schools should judge students on a range of abilities rather than relying entirely on examination results.
学校应根据学生的多方面能力作出评价，而不是完全依赖考试成绩。
judge.t: judge A by B表示依据B判断A。

e: I trust your judgement when choosing a reliable bicycle.
挑选可靠的自行车时，我相信你的判断力。
Schools should teach students to exercise independent judgement when evaluating information from unfamiliar online sources.
学校应教导学生在评估陌生网络来源的信息时作出独立判断。
judgement.t: 英式可写judgement或judgment；美式通常用后者。

e: The lawyer explained the judicial process to our family.
律师向我们一家解释了司法程序。
An independent judicial system helps protect individual rights and ensures that governments remain accountable.
独立的司法体系有助于保护个人权利，并确保政府承担责任。
Please bring a jug of water to the table.
请拿一壶水到餐桌上。
Serving tap water in a reusable jug can help restaurants reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bottles.
用可重复使用的水壶供应自来水，有助于餐馆减少对一次性塑料瓶的依赖。
jug.t: 英式常指有嘴敞口壶；美式常指窄口带柄罐。

e: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。
Although fruit juice contains vitamins, eating whole fruit usually provides more fibre and helps limit sugar intake.
虽然果汁含有维生素，但吃完整的水果通常能摄入更多膳食纤维，并有助于限制糖分摄入。
juice.t: juice通常不可数；点餐时a juice可指一杯果汁。

e: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。
In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。
july.t: 月份首字母大写；表示在七月用in July。

e: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。
Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。
jump.t: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。

e: Turn left at the junction beside the bakery.
在面包店旁的路口左转。
Installing better lighting at busy junctions could reduce accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians.
在繁忙路口安装更好的照明设施，可以减少涉及骑行者和行人的事故。
junction.t: 英式常用junction，美式路口常说intersection。

e: My sister is getting married in June this year.
我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。
The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。
june.t: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

e: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
茂密的藤蔓垂在狭窄的丛林小路上方。
Clearing jungle for agriculture destroys wildlife habitats and can reduce biodiversity across an entire region.
清除热带丛林以开辟农田会破坏野生动物栖息地，并可能降低整个地区的生物多样性。
jungle.t: 通常指热带的茂密丛林；forest泛指森林。

e: Our junior chef prepares vegetables before the restaurant opens.
我们餐厅的初级厨师在开门营业前准备蔬菜。
Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。
junior.t: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

e: The jury listened carefully as the witness described the accident.
证人描述事故经过时，陪审团认真聆听。
Serving on a jury allows ordinary citizens to participate directly in the administration of justice.
担任陪审员让普通公民能够直接参与司法工作。
jury.t: jury指整个陪审团；单个陪审员叫juror。

e: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。
A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
just.t: 作副词可指仅仅、刚刚；作形容词指公正的。

e: There is no justification for leaving this mess behind.
把这里弄得一团糟却不收拾，没有任何正当理由。
Governments must provide clear justification for policies that restrict individual freedom in the interests of public safety.
政府必须为那些以公共安全为由限制个人自由的政策提供明确的合理依据。
justification.t: 常接for加名词或动名词，说明某事的合理依据。

e: I cannot justify buying another coat this winter.
我找不到理由今年冬天再买一件外套。
Governments must justify major infrastructure spending by demonstrating clear benefits for the wider community.
政府必须通过展示对整个社区的明确益处，来证明重大基础设施支出的合理性。
justify.t: justify后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

e: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
一只小袋鼠从妈妈的育儿袋里探出头来。
Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.
栖息地丧失可能迫使袋鼠种群靠近道路，增加它们与车辆相撞的风险。
Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
莱拉很想加入我们的周末徒步小组。
Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。
keen.t: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。

e: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。
Governments should keep public transport affordable to encourage residents to leave their cars at home.
政府应使公共交通保持价格实惠，鼓励居民不开私家车出行。
keep.t: 过去式、过去分词均为kept；继续做用keep doing。

e: She cracked the walnut and carefully removed the kernel.
她敲开核桃，小心地取出果仁。
Even exaggerated media reports may contain a kernel of truth that deserves further investigation by independent researchers.
即使是夸大的媒体报道，也可能包含值得独立研究者进一步调查的些许事实。
kernel.t: kernel指壳内的仁或谷粒，不是桃子等的硬核。

e: We bought kerosene for the old lamp at the cabin.
我们买了煤油，给小屋里的旧油灯用。
Replacing kerosene lamps with solar lighting can reduce indoor air pollution in communities without reliable electricity.
在供电不稳定的社区，用太阳能灯替代煤油灯可以减少室内空气污染。
kerosene.t: 不可数名词；英式日常用语也常称paraffin。

e: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
你先烧水，我来找杯子。
Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.
每次只烧所需的水，长期下来可以减少家庭用电量。
kettle.t: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。

e: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。
Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.
获取可靠信息是帮助消费者就自身健康作出明智决定的关键。
key.t: the key to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

e: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。
Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。
keyboard.t: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

e: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。
Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。
kick.t: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

e: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。
Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。
kid.t: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

e: In the film, criminals kidnap a wealthy businessman.
电影中，犯罪分子绑架了一位富商。
International cooperation helps police investigate criminal groups that kidnap people and demand money for their release.
国际合作有助于警方调查绑架他人并索要赎金的犯罪团伙。
kidnap.t: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

e: The doctor checked his kidneys during a routine examination.
医生在常规检查中检查了他的肾脏。
Public health campaigns should explain how managing blood pressure can help prevent kidney disease.
公共卫生宣传应说明控制血压如何有助于预防肾病。
kidney.t: kidney是可数名词；医学形容词renal表示“肾的”。

e: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。
Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.
过量使用农药会杀死益虫，破坏农业生态系统的自然平衡。
kill.t: kill强调造成死亡；die表示自身死亡，不接宾语。

e: Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes, please?
请给我半公斤西红柿，好吗？
Comparing food prices per kilo can help households manage their budgets and make more economical purchasing decisions.
比较食品每公斤的价格，有助于家庭管理预算，作出更经济的购买决定。
kilo.t: kilo通常是kilogram的简称，不指公里。

e: The nearest bakery is about a kilometer from here.
最近的面包店离这里大约一公里。
Providing reliable public transport within a kilometer of residential areas could reduce dependence on private cars.
在居民区一公里范围内提供可靠的公共交通，可以减少人们对私家车的依赖。
kilometer.t: 美式拼写；英式为kilometre，符号km不加s。

e: The nearest bus stop is about a kilometre away.
最近的公交车站大约在一公里外。
Building safe cycle lanes within a kilometre of schools could encourage more children to cycle daily.
在学校周边一公里内修建安全的自行车道，可以鼓励更多孩子每天骑车。
Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。
Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。
kind.t: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

e: My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的小鸟。
High-quality kindergarten education can develop children's social skills and prepare them for more structured learning.
优质的学前教育能培养儿童的社交能力，为更系统的学习做好准备。
kindergarten.t: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。

e: We used dry twigs to kindle a small fire.
我们用干树枝生起了一小堆火。
Visits to science museums can kindle children's curiosity and encourage them to explore unfamiliar scientific ideas.
参观科学博物馆可以激发儿童的好奇心，鼓励他们探索陌生的科学概念。
kindle.t: 较正式或文学化；既能点火，也能激起兴趣。

e: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
她的体贴让新邻居感受到了欢迎。
Schools can encourage kindness by giving students opportunities to support classmates who face personal difficulties.
学校可以让学生有机会帮助遇到个人困难的同学，从而培养他们的善意。
kindness.t: 指善良品质时不可数；指具体善举时可数。

e: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
国王从马车上向人群挥手。
In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。
king.t: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

e: The old castle once guarded the entrance to the kingdom.
这座古堡曾经守卫着王国的入口。
Tourism in the small kingdom provides employment, but increasing visitor numbers place pressure on historic buildings.
旅游业为这个小王国提供了就业机会，但游客数量增长也给历史建筑带来了压力。
kingdom.t: 政治语境指王国；animal kingdom指动物界。

e: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。
In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。
kiss.t: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

e: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
我们在车里备有一个急救包。
Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。
kit.t: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

e: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。
Shared kitchen facilities can encourage social interaction among students living in university accommodation away from home.
共用厨房设施能促进离家住在大学宿舍的学生之间的社交互动。
kitchen.t: in the kitchen表示在厨房；ch读/tʃ/。

e: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。
Outdoor activities such as flying kites offer families affordable recreation and encourage children to spend time away from screens.
放风筝等户外活动为家庭提供了经济实惠的娱乐方式，也鼓励孩子暂时远离屏幕。
kite.t: “放风筝”用 fly a kite，不用 play a kite。

e: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。
Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。
Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
用一把锋利的刀把面包切成片。
Learning to use a kitchen knife safely is an important part of practical food education.
学习安全使用菜刀是实用饮食教育的重要组成部分。
My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
我爷爷给我织了一条暖和的围巾。
Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.
为当地收容所编织毯子的社区团体，将实际援助与社交机会结合起来。
knit.t: k不发音；过去式和过去分词可用knitted或knit。

e: Please knock on the door before you come in.
进来之前请先敲门。
Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。
knock.t: 词首k不发音；敲门用knock on或at the door。

e: This knot is too tight for me to undo.
这个结太紧了，我解不开。
During outdoor education courses, students learn to tie a secure knot before attempting basic climbing activities.
在户外教育课程中，学生先学习打牢固的绳结，再尝试基础攀爬活动。
knot.t: k不发音；航速的knot是每小时一海里。

e: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？
Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。
know.t: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

e: My grandfather shared his knowledge of birds with me.
祖父和我分享了他对鸟类的了解。
Schools should help students apply their knowledge to practical problems rather than simply memorise facts.
学校应帮助学生运用知识解决实际问题，而不只是记忆事实。
knowledge.t: 通常不可数；可说a good knowledge of某领域。

e: We wore safety goggles while mixing liquids in the lab.
我们在实验室混合液体时戴着护目镜。
A well-equipped school lab allows students to test scientific ideas through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
设备齐全的学校实验室让学生通过实际实验检验科学观点，而非仅仅死记硬背。
lab.t: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。

e: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
洗新毛衣之前，先看看标签。
Schools should avoid labelling children as failures, since this can damage their confidence and motivation.
学校应避免给孩子贴上失败者的标签，因为这会损害他们的信心和学习动力。
Repairing the old fence took a full day of labor.
修理那道旧围栏花了整整一天的工夫。
Investment in automation can reduce labor costs, but governments must help displaced workers develop new skills.
投资自动化可以降低劳动力成本，但政府必须帮助失业工人培养新技能。
We wore safety glasses inside the school laboratory.
我们在学校实验室里戴着护目镜。
Investment in laboratory equipment enables university students to develop practical skills and conduct reliable experiments.
投资实验室设备能让大学生培养实践技能并开展可靠的实验。
laboratory.t: 常缩写为lab；英美发音的重音位置不同。

e: Removing the old wallpaper was a slow, laborious job.
清除旧墙纸是一项缓慢又费力的工作。
Digitising historical records is a laborious process, but it greatly improves public access to valuable research materials.
将历史档案数字化是一个费时费力的过程，但能大大方便公众获取珍贵的研究资料。
laborious.t: 通常形容任务或过程；形容人勤劳用industrious。

e: A lack of sleep made me tired all morning.
睡眠不足让我整个上午都很疲惫。
Many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with practical science lessons.
许多乡村学校缺少为学生开设科学实践课所需的资源。
lack.t: 名词用a lack of；动词直接接宾语，不加of。

e: A friendly lad helped us carry the bags.
一个友善的小伙子帮我们提了袋子。
As a young lad, the novelist experienced rural poverty, which later became a central theme in his work.
这位小说家年少时经历过乡村贫困，这后来成为他作品的核心主题。
lad.t: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。

e: She climbed the ladder to pick apples from the tree.
她爬上梯子，摘树上的苹果。
Access to professional training can help young employees move up the career ladder more quickly.
获得专业培训的机会可以帮助年轻员工更快地晋升。
ladder.t: ladder是可移动的梯子；stairs指建筑内楼梯。

e: A kind lady helped me find the station.
一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。
An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。
lady.t: woman是中性通用词；lady常用于礼貌称呼。

e: I always lag behind my sister on steep hills.
走陡坡时，我总是落在姐姐后面。
Investment in rural transport often lags behind urban development, limiting access to jobs and essential services.
农村交通投资往往落后于城市发展，限制了人们获得工作和基本服务的机会。
lag.t: 常用lag behind表示落后；过去式为lagged。

e: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。
Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。
lake.t: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

e: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。
Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。
lamb.t: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

e: My grandparents often lament the loss of local shops.
我的祖父母常为附近小店的消失而叹息。
Many residents lament the destruction of historic buildings, arguing that redevelopment weakens the city's cultural identity.
许多居民为历史建筑遭到拆除而惋惜，认为改建削弱了城市的文化特色。
lament.t: 较正式；动词可直接接宾语，也可接that从句。

e: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
她打开了床边的灯。
Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。
lamp.t: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

e: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。
Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。
land.t: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。

e: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
卡车把我们的垃圾运到了附近的填埋场。
Expanding recycling services could reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill each year.
扩大回收服务范围可以减少每年送去填埋的生活垃圾量。
landfill.t: 指填埋场时可数；指填埋处理时通常不可数。

e: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
尽管有风，飞机还是平稳着陆了。
Improved weather forecasting can help pilots prepare for a safe landing during rapidly changing conditions.
更准确的天气预报能帮助飞行员在天气快速变化时做好安全着陆的准备。
landing.t: 除“着陆”外，也指楼梯顶部或中间的平台。

e: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
我们的女房东过来修厨房水龙头。
A responsible landlady should maintain safe housing conditions and respond promptly when tenants report serious problems.
负责任的女房东应确保住房条件安全，并在租客报告严重问题时及时回应。
Our landlord came over to fix the leaking tap.
我们的房东过来修漏水的水龙头。
Local authorities should require landlords to maintain safe living conditions for all their tenants.
地方政府应要求房东为所有租客维持安全的居住条件。
landlord.t: 房东是landlord，租客是tenant；第二义常见于英国。

e: Snow covered the landscape beyond our small wooden cabin.
白雪覆盖了我们小木屋外的山野。
Large wind farms can alter the rural landscape, although they provide an important source of clean energy.
大型风电场虽然是重要的清洁能源来源，却可能改变乡村景观。
landscape.t: landscape可数，指一片景观；scenery通常不可数。

e: A landslide blocked the road after last night's rain.
昨晚下雨后，一场山体滑坡堵住了道路。
Removing trees from steep hillsides can increase the risk of landslides during periods of heavy rainfall.
砍伐陡峭山坡上的树木，会增加强降雨期间发生山体滑坡的风险。
landslide.t: 政治语境中常指选举中的压倒性胜利。

e: Our bus moved into the lane beside the pavement.
我们乘坐的公交车驶入了靠近人行道的车道。
Dedicated cycle lanes can improve road safety and encourage more residents to travel by bicycle.
专用自行车道可以改善道路安全，并鼓励更多居民骑自行车出行。
lane.t: lane指一条车道；整条道路通常用road。

e: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
邻居教我一点她的语言。
Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。
language.t: 指某种语言时可数；泛指语言能力时常不可数。

e: He carried a lantern along the dark garden path.
他提着一盏灯，沿着漆黑的花园小径走去。
Solar lanterns provide affordable lighting in remote communities where reliable access to electricity remains limited.
在仍难以稳定用电的偏远社区，太阳能灯提供了价格实惠的照明。
lantern.t: 指有外罩的灯，常可提携；不等同于手电筒。

e: A brief lapse in concentration made me miss my stop.
我一时走神，坐过了站。
Even a minor lapse in judgment can undermine public confidence in the management of essential services.
即使是轻微的判断失误，也可能削弱公众对基本公共服务管理的信心。
lapse.t: 失误常用a lapse in；时间间隔用a lapse of。

e: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。
Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.
为每位学生配备笔记本电脑或许能改善学习资源的获取，但技术支持仍然必不可少。
laptop.t: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

e: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。
Large cities often offer better employment opportunities, although high housing costs can reduce residents' quality of life.
大城市通常提供更好的就业机会，但高昂的住房成本可能降低居民的生活质量。
large.t: large number接可数名词，large amount接不可数名词。

e: The beach was largely empty when we arrived.
我们到达时，海滩上几乎没什么人。
The success of public health campaigns depends largely on clear communication and widespread community trust.
公共卫生宣传活动的成功很大程度上取决于清晰的沟通和广泛的社区信任。
largely.t: 表示主要或大体上，不表示物体体积很大。

e: Heavy rain lashed the windows throughout the night.
大雨整夜猛烈地拍打着窗户。
As storms lash coastal communities, stronger sea defences become increasingly important for protecting homes and essential infrastructure.
随着风暴猛烈袭击沿海社区，更坚固的海防设施对保护住房和重要基础设施愈发重要。
lash.t: lash out at可指突然攻击或猛烈抨击。

e: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。
Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。
last.t: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

e: Our camping trip left me with lasting memories.
那次露营给我留下了长久难忘的回忆。
Investment in early childhood education can bring lasting benefits to individuals and society as a whole.
投资幼儿教育可以为个人和整个社会带来长远益处。
lasting.t: lasting强调持续很久，不一定像permanent那样永久。

e: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。
Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。
late.t: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

e: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？
Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
lately.t: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。

e: Her first pottery class revealed a latent artistic talent.
第一堂陶艺课显露了她潜在的艺术天赋。
Supportive teaching can help students develop latent abilities that conventional examinations may fail to identify.
支持性的教学能帮助学生发展传统考试可能无法识别的潜在能力。
latent.t: 指已经存在但尚未显现或发挥作用。

e: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。
Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。
later.t: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。

e: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
你听说关于我们邻居的最新消息了吗？
The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.
最新研究表明，规律运动可以改善记忆力和心理健康。
latest.t: latest指最新；last常指上一个或最后一个。

e: My sister studies Latin at school twice a week.
我妹妹在学校每周学两次拉丁语。
Studying Latin can help students understand the origins of scientific terms and the development of European languages.
学习拉丁语可以帮助学生理解科学术语的起源及欧洲语言的发展。
latin.t: 首字母大写；Latin America指拉丁美洲。

e: Our geography teacher showed us latitude on a globe.
地理老师用地球仪给我们讲解纬度。
Regions at higher latitudes generally experience greater seasonal variations in daylight than those near the equator.
高纬度地区的日照时长通常比赤道附近地区有更明显的季节变化。
We tried swimming and cycling, but preferred the latter.
我们尝试了游泳和骑车，但更喜欢后者。
Although both prevention and treatment deserve funding, healthcare budgets often devote more resources to the latter.
尽管预防和治疗都值得投入资金，医疗预算往往将更多资源用于后者。
latter.t: the latter指两者中的后者，不等于later。

e: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。
People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
经常一起欢笑的人可能建立更牢固的社会联系，并更好地应对日常压力。
laugh.t: laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。

e: Laughter filled the kitchen when the puppy sneezed.
小狗一打喷嚏，厨房里便充满了笑声。
Shared laughter can strengthen social bonds and help people manage stress in demanding work environments.
一起欢笑可以增进人际联系，帮助人们应对高压工作环境中的压力。
laughter.t: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。

e: Our local bakery launched a new delivery service yesterday.
我们当地的面包店昨天推出了新的送货服务。
Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.
学校应开展宣传活动，鼓励学生养成更健康的饮食习惯，并减少食物浪费。
launch.t: 推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。

e: Please put your dirty laundry in the basket.
请把脏衣服放进篮子里。
Shared laundry facilities can reduce water consumption and save space in modern apartment buildings.
共用洗衣设施可以减少用水量，并节省现代公寓楼的空间。
laundry.t: 表示衣物或洗衣这件事时通常不可数。

e: The lavatory is just beyond the waiting room.
洗手间就在候车室另一边。
Every passenger carriage should include a lavatory that travellers with limited mobility can access easily.
每节客车车厢都应设有行动不便的旅客能够轻松使用的洗手间。
lavatory.t: 较正式，常见于英式英语；日常多用toilet。

e: They prepared a lavish feast for the whole family.
他们为全家准备了一顿丰盛的大餐。
Critics argue that lavish spending on official ceremonies diverts public funds from essential services such as healthcare.
批评者认为，在官方仪式上大肆花费会挤占医疗等基本服务的公共资金。
lavish.t: 动词常用lavish sth on sb，表示大量给予。

e: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。
Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.
政府应始终如一地执行环境法律，防止企业通过有害行为获取优势。
law.t: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

e: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。
Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。
lawyer.t: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

e: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
这家俱乐部对会员卡的检查很松懈。
Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.
环境法规执行不严，使一些工厂得以向附近河流排放未经处理的废物。
lax.t: 常指规则执行不严；不要用它表示日常的腹泻。

e: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。
Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。
A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
架子上覆盖着薄薄的一层灰尘。
Adding an extra layer of insulation can significantly reduce energy consumption in older homes.
增加一层保温材料可以显著降低老旧住宅的能源消耗。
layer.t: “一层某物”用a layer of；layer也可作动词。

e: The mechanic explained the problem in layman's terms.
修理工用通俗易懂的话解释了这个问题。
Scientific reports should include summaries that a layman can understand without specialist training.
科学报告应附有摘要，让未受专业训练的普通人也能看懂。
layman.t: 泛指非专业人士时，layperson更具性别包容性。

e: We changed the kitchen layout to create more space.
我们调整了厨房布局，腾出了更多空间。
A clear website layout helps users find essential information quickly and improves access to public services.
清晰的网站布局有助于用户快速找到关键信息，并更方便地使用公共服务。
layout.t: 名词layout写成一词；动词lay out分开写。

e: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
今晚我懒得做饭。
Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。
lazy.t: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。

e: Our guide led us safely through the forest.
向导带着我们安全地穿过了森林。
Poor access to public transport can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
公共交通不便可能导致人们更加依赖私家车。
lead.t: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。

e: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。
Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.
高效的领导者鼓励员工分享想法，而不是毫无疑问地服从指令。
leader.t: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。

e: Her calm leadership helped our team finish the project.
她沉着的领导帮助我们团队完成了项目。
Effective leadership in schools can improve staff morale and create a more supportive learning environment.
有效的学校领导可以提升教职工士气，并营造更有支持性的学习环境。
leadership.t: 通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。

e: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
一位志愿者递给我一张介绍新图书馆的传单。
Health centres can distribute a leaflet explaining how regular exercise helps prevent several common diseases.
医疗中心可以发放宣传单，解释规律运动如何帮助预防几种常见疾病。
leaflet.t: leaflet通常是单页或折页；brochure通常为小册子。

e: Our team finished top of the league this season.
我们队本赛季在联赛中排名第一。
A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。
league.t: in a different league常指水平远胜一筹。

e: A leak under the sink soaked all our cleaning cloths.
水槽下方的漏水把我们所有的清洁布都浸湿了。
Water companies should repair leaks promptly to conserve resources and reduce unnecessary pressure on local supplies.
供水公司应及时修复漏水处，以节约资源并减轻当地供水的不必要压力。
leak.t: leak 可作名词或动词，也可指秘密信息泄露。

e: She leaned against the wall and untied her shoes.
她靠着墙，解开了鞋带。
Lean production methods can help manufacturers reduce waste while maintaining the quality of their products.
精益生产方法能帮助制造商在保持产品质量的同时减少浪费。
lean.t: lean against指倚靠；lean towards可指倾向于。

e: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。
Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。
learn.t: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。

e: Our learned neighbour can explain almost any historical mystery.
我们那位博学的邻居几乎能解释任何历史谜团。
Learned societies play an important role in sharing research findings and encouraging debate across academic disciplines.
学术团体在分享研究成果、促进跨学科学术讨论方面发挥着重要作用。
learned.t: 意为“博学的”读两音节；作 learn 过去式读一音节。

e: Learning becomes easier when I practise a little every day.
每天练习一点，学习就变得更容易了。
Schools can encourage independent learning by giving students opportunities to investigate questions beyond the standard curriculum.
学校可以让学生探索常规课程之外的问题，以鼓励自主学习。
learning.t: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。

e: We signed a lease for a sunny upstairs flat.
我们签下了楼上一套阳光充足的公寓的租约。
Small businesses often lease equipment rather than purchase it outright, allowing them to manage initial costs more effectively.
小企业往往租用设备而非一次性买下，从而更有效地控制初期成本。
lease.t: lease from指租入；lease to指租给别人。

e: This soup needs the least salt of all.
这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。
Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。
least.t: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

e: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
她的旧皮包摸起来仍然柔软光滑。
Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.
一些消费者避免购买皮革制品，因为他们关心动物福利以及生产对环境的影响。
leather.t: 通常不可数；leather jacket中名词作定语。

e: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。
Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.
带薪育儿假让新手父母能够照顾孩子，而不必立即重返工作岗位。
leave.t: leave 的过去式和过去分词均为 left。

e: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。
Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。
lecture.t: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

e: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
我用左手提购物袋。
Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.
驾驶员左转前应仔细查看后视镜，尤其是在与骑行者共用道路的地方。
left.t: 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词；表剩余时置于名词后。

e: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。
Regular walking strengthens the muscles in our legs and can improve health without expensive equipment.
经常步行能增强腿部肌肉，无需昂贵器材就能改善健康。
leg.t: leg也指桌椅的支脚或旅程中的一段。

e: We sought legal advice before signing the rental agreement.
签订租赁协议前，我们征求了法律意见。
Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。
legal.t: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

e: Grandma told us a legend about a sleeping dragon.
奶奶给我们讲了一个关于沉睡巨龙的传说。
Local legends can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors interested in the history of a region.
地方传说既能增强文化认同，也能吸引对当地历史感兴趣的游客。
legend.t: legend可能有历史原型，不等于已证实的历史。

e: Your handwriting is much more legible with this pen.
用这支笔写字，你的字迹清楚多了。
Public information should be presented in a legible format so that older residents can access essential services independently.
公共信息应以清晰易读的形式呈现，让老年居民能够独立获取基本服务。
legible.t: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。

e: Selling homemade bread is a legitimate business here.
在这里，售卖自制面包是合法的生意。
Residents have legitimate concerns about the impact of airport expansion on local air quality.
居民对机场扩建影响当地空气质量的担忧是合理的。
legitimate.t: 既可指法律允许，也可指理由或担忧合理。

e: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
她把大部分闲暇时间都花在花园里。
Public parks provide affordable spaces for leisure, helping urban residents relax and maintain social connections.
公共公园提供了经济实惠的休闲空间，帮助城市居民放松并维持社交联系。
leisure.t: leisure通常不可数；leisure time指闲暇时间。

e: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
我把半个柠檬的汁挤在烤鱼上。
Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.
在餐食中加入柠檬汁可以增添风味，而不增加盐的摄入量。
lemon.t: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。

e: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？
Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。
lend.t: lend是借出，borrow是借入；过去式为lent。

e: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
我们买椅子之前量了桌子的长度。
The length of the school day can affect both student concentration and family routines.
每天在校时间的长短既会影响学生的注意力，也会影响家庭的日常安排。
length.t: at length常指“详细地”，不是“在长度上”。

e: Our teacher was lenient when I submitted homework late.
我迟交作业时，老师宽容地处理了。
Some argue that lenient penalties for illegal dumping fail to discourage companies from damaging the environment.
有人认为，对非法倾倒垃圾的宽松处罚无法阻止企业破坏环境。
lenient.t: 对人宽容用lenient with；常涉及规则或处罚。

e: She carefully wiped the dust off her camera lens.
她小心地擦去相机镜头上的灰尘。
A damaged lens in the eye can reduce vision and affect a person's ability to perform everyday tasks.
眼球晶状体受损会降低视力，影响一个人完成日常任务的能力。
lens.t: 复数为lenses；隐形眼镜常用contact lenses。

e: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。
Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。
less.t: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

e: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。
A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。
lesson.t: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

e: She whispered lest she wake the sleeping baby.
她轻声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。
Policymakers should assess new technologies carefully lest short-term economic gains create lasting environmental problems.
政策制定者应仔细评估新技术，以免短期经济收益造成长期环境问题。
lest.t: 较正式；从句常用动词原形或should加原形。

e: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
你平安到家后请告诉我。
Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.
学校应让学生先探索不同学科，再要求他们选择专业方向。
let.t: let sb do sth中不加to；过去式、过去分词均为let。

e: Some wild mushrooms contain toxins that can be lethal.
有些野生蘑菇含有可能致命的毒素。
Exposure to lethal concentrations of air pollutants highlights the importance of strict industrial safety regulations.
接触致命浓度的空气污染物，凸显了严格工业安全法规的重要性。
lethal.t: 通常作形容词；lethal 强调具有致死能力。

e: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。
Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。
letter.t: letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

e: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。
Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.
在城市菜园种植生菜能让居民在家附近获得新鲜食材。
lettuce.t: 指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

e: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。
Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。
level.t: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

e: Pull this lever to raise the seat a little.
拉这个操纵杆，把座位稍微升高一点。
Tax policy can serve as a powerful lever for encouraging businesses to invest in cleaner technologies.
税收政策可以成为鼓励企业投资更清洁技术的有力手段。
lever.t: 英式首音节读/liː/，美式通常读/lev/。

e: My aunt works as a lexicographer for a small publisher.
我姑姑在一家小出版社做词典编纂工作。
A lexicographer examines authentic language use to ensure that dictionary definitions reflect contemporary meanings accurately.
词典编纂者研究真实的语言使用情况，以确保词典释义准确反映当代词义。
lexicographer.t: 指编写或修订词典的人，不泛指语言学家。

e: Our insurance covers liability for damage to neighbouring homes.
我们的保险承保对邻居住宅造成损坏所需承担的责任。
Clear rules on legal liability encourage companies to take greater responsibility for the safety of their products.
明确的法律责任规定能促使企业更加重视其产品的安全性。
liability.t: 责任常不可数；债务常用复数liabilities。

e: These old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
这些旧水管在冬天很容易爆裂。
Employers may be held liable for injuries caused by unsafe conditions in the workplace.
雇主可能须对工作场所不安全条件造成的伤害承担法律责任。
liable.t: liable to后接动词表可能；liable for表责任。

e: My parents are liberal about what clothes I wear.
父母对我的穿着很开明。
A liberal society should protect individual freedoms while encouraging citizens to respect the rights of others.
自由开放的社会应保护个人自由，同时鼓励公民尊重他人的权利。
liberal.t: 政治含义随国家而异；也可表示开明或用量充足。

e: The rescued prisoners cheered when soldiers liberated the camp.
士兵解放营地时，获救的囚犯欢呼起来。
Accessible public transport can liberate older people from dependence on relatives and enable greater participation in community life.
无障碍公共交通能让老年人摆脱对亲属的依赖，并更多地参与社区生活。
liberate.t: 及物动词；liberate A from B表示使A摆脱B。

e: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。
School librarians support independent learning by teaching students how to locate reliable sources and evaluate information.
学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。
librarian.t: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。

e: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。
Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.
公共图书馆通过免费提供书籍、数字资源和安静的学习空间来支持终身学习。
library.t: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

e: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
我把驾驶执照放在钱包里。
Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
要求旅游船持证运营，可以帮助主管部门维持繁忙水道的安全标准。
licence.t: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

e: You need a license to drive on public roads.
你需要有驾驶执照才能在公共道路上开车。
Authorities should license childcare providers carefully to ensure that facilities meet appropriate safety and quality standards.
主管部门应审慎审批托育机构的经营许可，确保设施符合相应的安全和质量标准。
license.t: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。

e: The puppy licked my hand and wagged its tail.
小狗舔了舔我的手，摇着尾巴。
Visitors should not allow wild animals to lick their hands, as close contact may spread infections.
游客不应让野生动物舔自己的手，因为近距离接触可能传播感染。
lick.t: lick指用舌头舔；咬用bite，吸吮用suck。

e: Put the lid on before you shake the jar.
摇晃罐子之前先把盖子盖上。
A tightly fitted lid helps households keep food fresh and reduce unnecessary waste.
严密贴合的盖子能帮助家庭保持食物新鲜，减少不必要的浪费。
lid.t: 容器的盖子用lid；瓶子的旋盖也常用cap。

e: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。
Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。
The lieutenant helped the new soldiers organise their equipment.
中尉帮助新兵整理装备。
During disaster relief operations, a lieutenant may coordinate military teams delivering essential supplies to isolated communities.
在救灾行动中，中尉可能负责协调向偏远社区运送必需物资的军方队伍。
lieutenant.t: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。

e: Life feels quieter since we moved to the countryside.
自从搬到乡下，我们的生活感觉更安静了。
Access to affordable housing can significantly improve the quality of life in large cities.
获得负担得起的住房可以显著提高大城市居民的生活质量。
life.t: 复数是 lives；泛指生活时通常不可数。

e: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？
Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
在较老的公共建筑中安装电梯，可以方便轮椅使用者和行动不便的人进出。
Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。
Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。
light.t: 光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。

e: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。
Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。
like.t: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

e: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain this afternoon.
乌云增加了今天下午下雨的可能性。
Regular physical activity can reduce the likelihood of developing certain health conditions later in life.
经常进行体育活动可以降低晚年患上某些疾病的可能性。
likelihood.t: 常用likelihood of doing或likelihood that从句。

e: I folded my umbrella, and my sister did likewise.
我收起雨伞，姐姐也照做了。
Public libraries provide free internet access; likewise, community centres help residents develop essential digital skills.
公共图书馆提供免费上网服务；同样，社区中心也帮助居民培养必要的数字技能。
likewise.t: 较正式，常用于连接相似情况；do likewise意为照做。

e: She squeezed a lime over the warm rice.
她往热米饭上挤了些青柠汁。
Farmers may apply lime to acidic soils to improve growing conditions and increase crop productivity.
农民可以向酸性土壤施用石灰，以改善生长条件并提高作物产量。
lime.t: 水果义可数，石灰义不可数；lemon是柠檬。

e: The old cottage was built from pale local limestone.
这座旧乡间小屋是用当地浅色的石灰岩建成的。
Limestone formations attract tourists, but heavy visitor traffic can damage delicate cave environments over time.
石灰岩地貌吸引游客，但大量游客往来可能逐渐破坏脆弱的洞穴环境。
limestone.t: limestone通常不可数；lime还可指石灰或青柠。

e: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
这个包能装的东西是有限的。
Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.
政府应限制工业排放，同时为采用更清洁生产方式的企业提供资金支持。
limit.t: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。

e: The main limitation of this camera is its battery life.
这台相机的主要不足是电池续航时间短。
Researchers should acknowledge the limitations of small samples before drawing conclusions about the wider population.
研究人员在对更广泛人群作出结论前，应承认小样本的局限性。
limitation.t: “局限性”常用复数；对……的限制用limitation on。

e: We have limited space, so choose a smaller sofa.
我们空间有限，所以选一张小一点的沙发吧。
Students with limited access to reliable internet may struggle to participate fully in online learning.
难以获得稳定网络连接的学生可能无法充分参与在线学习。
limited.t: be limited to表示“仅限于”，to后接名词或动名词。

e: I had to limp home after twisting my ankle.
扭伤脚踝后，我只好一瘸一拐地走回家。
Athletes who continue to limp after an injury should receive professional assessment before returning to competitive sport.
受伤后仍然跛行的运动员应先接受专业评估，再重返竞技运动。
limp.t: 作动词指跛行；作形容词指无力或软塌塌。

e: Draw a straight line across the page with your ruler.
用尺子在纸上画一条直线。
Extending the railway line could connect rural communities with employment opportunities in nearby cities.
延长铁路线可以让农村社区的居民获得附近城市的就业机会。
line.t: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。

e: I wore a linen shirt on the hot afternoon.
那个炎热的下午，我穿了一件亚麻衬衫。
Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse towels and change bed linen less frequently.
酒店可以鼓励住客重复使用毛巾并降低床上用品的更换频率，以减少用水量。
linen.t: 通常不可数；bed linen不一定由亚麻制成。

e: We lingered outside the cinema, chatting about the film.
我们在电影院外迟迟没有离开，聊着刚看的电影。
The effects of prolonged unemployment can linger even after individuals return to stable work.
长期失业的影响即使在人们重新获得稳定工作后，也可能持续存在。
linger.t: 不及物动词；linger over表示慢慢享用或细看。

e: The linguist recorded my grandmother telling an old story.
那位语言学家录下了我奶奶讲述一个古老故事的声音。
Linguists can support endangered languages by documenting local speech and helping communities develop teaching materials.
语言学家可以通过记录当地语言、帮助社区编写教材来保护濒危语言。
linguist.t: linguist 指人；linguistics 指语言学，作单数学科名。

e: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
这座新桥连接了这些村庄。
Researchers have identified a strong link between regular physical activity and improved mental health.
研究人员发现，经常运动与心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。
link.t: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

e: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
那头狮子在树荫下休息。
Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
保护狮子需要大片栖息地，让它们能够自然捕猎而不与农民发生冲突。
lion.t: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。

e: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。
Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。
lip.t: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

e: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。
Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。
liquid.t: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

e: The restaurant keeps its liquor in a locked cabinet.
这家餐厅把烈酒存放在上锁的柜子里。
Governments often impose higher taxes on liquor to discourage excessive consumption and protect public health.
政府常对烈酒征收较高税款，以抑制过量饮用并保护公众健康。
liquor.t: 通常指烈酒；liqueur则指利口酒，注意拼写。

e: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
出门前，我列了一张购物清单。
The report lists several practical measures that cities can adopt to reduce traffic congestion.
这份报告列出了城市可以采取的几项缓解交通拥堵的实用措施。
list.t: 在名单上用on the list，不用in。

e: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
每天晚上做饭时，我都会听音乐。
Local authorities should listen to residents before making decisions that significantly affect their neighbourhoods.
地方政府在作出对社区有重大影响的决定前，应听取居民的意见。
listen.t: 接对象须用listen to；hear侧重听到的结果。

e: This bottle holds exactly one liter of fresh milk.
这个瓶子正好能装一升鲜奶。
Measuring household water consumption by the liter can help residents understand how much they use each day.
以升为单位测量家庭用水量，可以帮助居民了解自己每天用了多少水。
liter.t: liter是美式拼写，英式为litre；一升等于一千毫升。

e: The library offers free literacy classes for local adults.
图书馆为当地成年人提供免费的读写课程。
Improving digital literacy helps older adults access essential services and participate more fully in modern society.
提高数字素养有助于老年人获取必要服务，更充分地参与现代社会生活。
literacy.t: 不可数；digital literacy指数字素养，不只是识字。

e: I meant cold feet in the literal sense.
我说的就是脚冷，没有什么比喻含义。
A literal translation may preserve individual words while failing to convey the cultural meaning of an expression.
逐字翻译可能保留每个词，却无法传达某种表达背后的文化含义。
literal.t: literal指字面义；literary指文学的，注意区别。

e: He took my advice literally and bought a bigger plate.
他按字面理解了我的建议，买了一个更大的盘子。
Translating idioms literally can confuse language learners because their meanings often depend on cultural context.
直译习语可能让语言学习者困惑，因为其含义往往取决于文化语境。
literally.t: 口语可用于夸张；正式写作宜保留字面或确实义。

e: Our local library hosts a literary festival each spring.
我们当地的图书馆每年春天都会举办文学节。
Studying literary works from different cultures can help students understand perspectives beyond their own experiences.
学习不同文化的文学作品可以帮助学生理解自身经历之外的观点。
She became literate after attending evening classes for adults.
参加成人夜校后，她学会了读写。
Schools should ensure that students are digitally literate so they can evaluate online information critically.
学校应确保学生具备数字素养，使他们能够批判性地评估网络信息。
literate.t: 常用作形容词；名词 literacy 表示读写能力。

e: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
我姐姐学文学，总能推荐很棒的小说。
A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.
对科学文献的综述表明，经常运动可以改善心理健康。
literature.t: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。

e: We need a litre of milk for this pudding.
做这道布丁需要一升牛奶。
Measuring household water use in litres can help residents understand consumption and identify opportunities to reduce waste.
以升为单位测量家庭用水量，有助于居民了解消耗情况并找到减少浪费的方法。
We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。
Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。
litter.t: 垃圾义不可数；一窝幼崽用a litter of。

e: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。
Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。
little.t: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

e: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。
People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。
live.t: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

e: The lively puppy chased a ball around the garden.
那只活泼的小狗在花园里追着球跑。
Lively classroom discussions can encourage students to consider different perspectives and develop critical thinking skills.
热烈的课堂讨论能鼓励学生考虑不同观点，并培养批判性思维能力。
lively.t: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

e: The doctor explained how the liver keeps us healthy.
医生解释了肝脏如何帮助我们保持健康。
Public health campaigns should explain how a balanced diet can support the liver and reduce disease risks.
公共健康宣传应解释均衡饮食如何保护肝脏并降低患病风险。
liver.t: 指器官常说 the liver；作食物时通常不可数。

e: The farmer moved the livestock into a sheltered field.
农民把牲畜赶进了一块有遮蔽的田地。
Raising livestock requires substantial land and water resources, which can increase pressure on ecosystems in dry regions.
饲养牲畜需要大量土地和水资源，这可能加剧干旱地区生态系统的压力。
livestock.t: 集合名词，不加-s；表示活的农场动物。

e: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
池塘里满是微小的生物。
Rising housing costs make it harder for young adults to earn a decent living in major cities.
住房成本上涨，使年轻人在大城市更难挣到足以过上体面生活的收入。
living.t: living可放名词前；alive通常作表语或后置修饰。

e: A tiny lizard rested on the warm garden wall.
一只小蜥蜴趴在花园里温暖的墙上。
Protecting rocky habitats helps preserve lizard populations, which play an important role in controlling insects.
保护岩石栖息地有助于维持蜥蜴种群，它们在控制昆虫数量方面发挥着重要作用。
The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
Sharing household tasks more equally can reduce the load on parents who also work full time.
更公平地分担家务可以减轻还需全职工作的父母的负担。
load.t: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。

e: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
我们申请了一笔贷款来修屋顶。
Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.
负担得起的学生贷款可以扩大大学入学机会，但毕业后的还款可能带来经济压力。
loan.t: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

e: I was loath to leave the warm kitchen.
我舍不得离开温暖的厨房。
Many residents are loath to support redevelopment projects that could destroy the character of their neighbourhoods.
许多居民不愿支持可能破坏社区特色的重建项目。
loath.t: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

e: I'll wait in the lobby while you collect your suitcase.
你去拿行李箱，我在大厅等你。
Environmental groups lobby governments to introduce stricter controls on industrial pollution and protect vulnerable ecosystems.
环保团体游说政府加强工业污染管控，保护脆弱的生态系统。
lobby.t: 游说支持用lobby for，反对用lobby against。

e: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。
Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。
local.t: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

e: We finally located the missing keys behind the sofa.
我们终于在沙发后面找到了丢失的钥匙。
Local authorities should locate new health centres near public transport routes to improve access for elderly residents.
地方政府应将新的医疗中心设在公共交通线路附近，以方便老年居民就医。
locate.t: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。

e: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
这家咖啡馆坐落在河边，位置很不错。
The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
保障性住房的位置会显著影响居民获得教育、医疗服务和就业机会的便利程度。
location.t: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。

e: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
上楼前请把后门锁好。
Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.
员工离开办公桌时应锁定电脑，以防机密信息被未经授权的人查看。
lock.t: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。

e: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。
locker.t: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

e: A steam locomotive pulled the carriages slowly past our platform.
一台蒸汽机车拉着车厢，缓缓驶过我们所在的站台。
Replacing diesel locomotives with electric models can reduce local air pollution, especially along busy urban railway routes.
用电力机车替代柴油机车可以减少当地空气污染，尤其是在繁忙的城市铁路沿线。
locomotive.t: 指提供动力的机车，不是包含所有车厢的整列火车。

e: She has lofty ambitions but works hard every day.
她志向远大，同时每天都在努力。
Governments often announce lofty goals for reducing inequality, but meaningful progress requires sustained investment and practical policies.
政府常常宣布减少不平等的宏大目标，但实质性进展需要持续投入和切实可行的政策。
lofty.t: 修饰理想时可表赞许，也可暗示目标过高、不切实际。

e: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
我们坐在湖边一段倒下的树干上。
Researchers log changes in water temperature to assess how climate change affects freshwater ecosystems over time.
研究人员记录水温变化，以评估气候变化长期以来对淡水生态系统的影响。
log.t: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。

e: I understand the logic behind your plan to save money.
我理解你这个省钱计划背后的思路。
The logic behind investing in public transport is that fewer cars can reduce urban congestion.
投资公共交通的逻辑是，减少汽车数量可以缓解城市拥堵。
logic.t: 通常不可数；the logic behind表示背后的道理。

e: Taking the bus seemed logical because parking was expensive.
停车费很贵，所以乘公交车似乎很合理。
Students should learn to construct logical arguments rather than simply memorise facts for examinations.
学生应该学习如何构建合乎逻辑的论证，而不是仅仅为考试背诵事实。
logical.t: logical强调推理合理，不表示事实一定正确。

e: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring London by bus.
我们在一个下雨的下午乘公交车游览了伦敦。
London attracts international students because its universities offer diverse courses and access to extensive cultural resources.
伦敦吸引着国际学生，因为当地大学提供多样的课程和丰富的文化资源。
london.t: 城市名首字母大写；通常不加the。

e: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。
Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。
lonely.t: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

e: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。
Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。
long.t: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

e: We need a long-term plan for our garden.
我们需要为花园制定一个长期规划。
Investment in public transport can bring long-term benefits to both local economies and the environment.
投资公共交通可以为地方经济和环境带来长期效益。
long-term.t: 作定语常用连字符；in the long term不加。

e: Our guide checked our longitude before steering the boat east.
向导在把船驶向东边之前查看了我们所在位置的经度。
Accurate measurements of longitude and latitude allow navigation systems to determine a vehicle's position on Earth.
准确测量经纬度能让导航系统确定车辆在地球上的位置。
longitude.t: longitude是经度，分东西；latitude是纬度，分南北。

e: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
看窗边那只小鸟。
Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
当当地居民协助维护花园和步道时，公共公园往往显得更有吸引力。
look.t: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

e: A huge ship loomed out of the morning fog.
一艘巨轮从晨雾中隐约显现。
As water shortages loom, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and encourage households to reduce unnecessary consumption.
随着缺水危机逼近，政府必须投资高效灌溉，并鼓励家庭减少不必要的用水。
loom.t: 动词常带压迫或担忧感；loom large指问题突出。

e: She made a loop in the rope for hanging plants.
她把绳子打成一个圈，用来悬挂盆栽。
A bus route forming a loop can connect residential areas with schools and local health centres.
环形公交线路可以将住宅区与学校和当地医疗中心连接起来。
loop.t: on a loop指不断重复，如音乐循环播放。

e: One loose screw made the whole chair feel shaky.
一颗松动的螺丝让整把椅子都摇晃起来。
Loose regulations on industrial waste can allow harmful substances to enter rivers and damage local ecosystems.
对工业废物监管不严，可能导致有害物质进入河流，破坏当地生态系统。
loose.t: loose是形容词，尾音/s/；lose是动词，尾音/z/。

e: He loosened his scarf as the room grew warmer.
房间渐渐暖和起来，他松了松围巾。
Governments may loosen restrictions on foreign investment to encourage business growth and create more employment opportunities.
政府可能放宽对外国投资的限制，以促进企业发展并创造更多就业机会。
loosen.t: loosen是动词；loose是形容词，勿混淆lose。

e: The guide showed us where the local lord once lived.
导游带我们看了当地领主曾经居住的地方。
In medieval society, a lord often controlled farmland and collected payments from the people who worked it.
在中世纪社会，领主往往控制着农田，并向耕种者收取费用。
lord.t: 指上帝用the Lord；置于姓名前作头衔也大写。

e: A lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the shop.
一辆货车把新鲜蔬菜送到了店里。
Restricting lorry deliveries during peak hours could reduce congestion and improve road safety in city centres.
限制货车在高峰时段送货，可以缓解市中心的拥堵并改善道路安全。
lorry.t: lorry主要用于英式英语，美式英语通常用truck。

e: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。
Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。
lose.t: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。

e: She reported the loss of her wallet yesterday.
她昨天报失了钱包。
The loss of natural habitats threatens biodiversity and can weaken ecosystems that support local agriculture.
自然栖息地的丧失威胁生物多样性，也可能削弱支撑当地农业的生态系统。
loss.t: loss是名词，lose是动词，过去式和过去分词为lost。

e: We got lost while walking through the old town.
我们在老城区步行时迷路了。
Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。
lost.t: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

e: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
我们今天买了很多新鲜水果。
Cities can save a lot of energy by improving public transport and encouraging residents to walk.
城市可以通过改善公共交通并鼓励居民步行来节约大量能源。
lot.t: a lot of接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot可修饰动词。

e: My uncle bought a lottery ticket at the shop.
我叔叔在商店买了一张彩票。
Allocating school places by lottery may reduce favouritism, but it can also create uncertainty for families.
通过抽签分配学位或许能减少偏袒，却也可能给家庭带来不确定性。
lottery.t: by lottery指通过抽签，不一定涉及购买彩票。

e: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。
Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。
loud.t: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

e: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。
Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。
loudly.t: loudly强调音量大；aloud强调出声而非默读。

e: A voice from the loudspeaker announced our train's arrival.
扩音器里传来播报我们列车到站的声音。
Public transport stations use loudspeaker systems to communicate urgent safety information to large numbers of passengers.
公共交通车站利用扩音系统向大量乘客传达紧急安全信息。
We waited in the lounge until our room was ready.
我们在休息室等候，直到房间准备好。
Comfortable airport lounges can make long journeys less stressful for passengers travelling with young children.
舒适的机场休息室可以减轻带幼儿出行的旅客在长途旅行中的压力。
lounge.t: 英式英语中可指家中客厅；作动词常接 around。

e: I love walking by the river after dinner.
我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。
Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。
love.t: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

e: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。
Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。
lovely.t: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。

e: The two lovers walked hand in hand beside the river.
这对恋人手牵着手沿河散步。
Public gardens offer nature lovers valuable opportunities to observe wildlife without leaving the city.
公共花园为自然爱好者提供了不出城就能观察野生动物的宝贵机会。
lover.t: 表爱好者常用名词＋lover；单用可能指情人。

e: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
这个低矮的架子很方便孩子们取东西。
Low wages can prevent essential workers from finding affordable housing close to their places of employment.
低工资可能让从事必要服务的劳动者难以在工作地点附近找到负担得起的住房。
Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
把重碗放在下面那层架子上。
Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.
政府可以通过投资可靠的公交服务和安全的自行车道来降低交通成本。
lower.t: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。

e: Our loyal dog waits by the door every evening.
我们忠实的狗每天傍晚都在门边等候。
Companies that treat their employees fairly are more likely to retain a loyal and productive workforce.
公平对待员工的公司更有可能留住忠诚且高效的员工队伍。
loyal.t: 表示忠于某人或组织，用loyal to，不用loyal with。

e: I lubricated the door hinges to stop that annoying squeak.
我给门铰链加了润滑油，让那烦人的吱呀声停下来。
Regularly lubricating industrial machinery reduces friction, improves energy efficiency, and extends the working life of essential equipment.
定期润滑工业机械可以减少摩擦、提高能源效率，并延长关键设备的使用寿命。
lubricate.t: 及物动词，直接接被润滑的部件；用with引出润滑剂。

e: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
我的包掉下来摔开了，幸好没有东西掉出来。
The storm damaged several classrooms, but luckily the school had already moved its students to a safer building.
暴风雨损坏了几间教室，但幸好学校已将学生转移到一栋更安全的建筑中。
luckily.t: 常修饰整个句子，放句首时通常后接逗号。

e: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。
Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。
lucky.t: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

e: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
我们的行李勉强塞进了那辆小出租车。
Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.
在火车站提供安全的行李寄存服务，可以鼓励游客步行游览附近景点。
luggage.t: 不可数；一件行李用a piece of luggage。

e: We stepped outside during a lull in the rain.
趁雨暂时停歇，我们走到了外面。
A temporary lull in economic activity may give businesses time to review their long-term strategies.
经济活动的暂时放缓可能让企业有时间重新审视其长期战略。
lull.t: lull强调暂时平静，不表示彻底结束。

e: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
我们买了些木料，准备做一张花园长椅。
Demand for sustainably sourced lumber can encourage forest owners to adopt more responsible management practices.
对可持续来源木材的需求可以促使林场主采取更负责任的管理方式。
lumber.t: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。

e: She dropped a lump of clay onto the table.
她把一团黏土放到了桌子上。
Policymakers should not lump all unemployed people together, as their circumstances and support needs vary considerably.
政策制定者不应把所有失业者一概而论，因为他们的处境和援助需求差异很大。
lump.t: lump together常暗示忽略差异，笼统归类。

e: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
我们在花园里观看了月食。
Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.
对月球岩石的研究有助于科学家了解月球及早期太阳系的演变。
We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。
Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.
提供营养丰富的学校午餐可以提高儿童的专注力，并帮助他们逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。
lunch.t: 泛指吃午餐用have lunch，通常不加冠词。

e: The doctor listened to my lungs through a stethoscope.
医生用听诊器听了听我的肺部。
Long periods of exposure to polluted air can damage the lungs and increase the risk of respiratory disease.
长期接触受污染的空气可能损伤肺部，并增加患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
lung.t: 单个肺用lung；谈双肺或肺部通常用lungs。

e: We used some cheese to lure the mouse outside.
我们用一些奶酪把老鼠引到了外面。
Large cities often lure young graduates with higher salaries, leaving rural communities with a shortage of skilled workers.
大城市常以较高薪资吸引年轻毕业生，导致乡村社区缺乏技术人才。
lure.t: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。

e: Our hotel room had a luxurious bath overlooking the sea.
我们的酒店客房里有一个可欣赏海景的豪华浴缸。
Although luxurious resorts attract wealthy visitors, their high water consumption can place pressure on local resources.
尽管豪华度假村能吸引富裕游客，但其高耗水量会给当地资源带来压力。
luxurious.t: luxurious指豪华舒适；luxuriant多指植物繁茂。

e: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。
As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。
luxury.t: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

e: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。
A modern machine can perform repetitive tasks efficiently, allowing workers to focus on more complex problems.
现代机器能高效完成重复性任务，让工人专注于更复杂的问题。
machine.t: machine是可数名词；machinery是不可数集合名词。

e: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
爸爸很生气，因为我打碎了他最喜欢的杯子。
Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
虽然一些居民热衷足球，但公共体育资金应支持更广泛的活动。
mad.t: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

e: Would you like a table by the window, madam?
女士，您想坐靠窗的桌子吗？
In formal customer service settings, staff may address a female customer as madam to show respect.
在正式的客户服务场合，工作人员可能用madam称呼女性顾客，以示尊重。
madam.t: 正式称呼女性时使用；日常熟人交谈中通常不用。

e: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。
A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.
专业杂志可以提供综合新闻网站未必能提供的实用职业建议。
magazine.t: 可数名词；英式重音通常在末音节，美式在首音节。

e: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。
Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。
magic.t: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。

e: The magician pulled a silk scarf from an empty cup.
魔术师从空杯子里抽出了一条丝巾。
A skilled magician can demonstrate how easily human attention is directed away from important visual details.
技艺娴熟的魔术师可以展示，人的注意力多么容易被引开，从而忽略重要的视觉细节。
magician.t: 现实中指魔术表演者；故事中也可指魔法师。

e: A small magnet holds our shopping list on the fridge.
一块小磁铁把我们的购物清单固定在冰箱上。
Well-funded universities can act as a magnet for talented researchers, supporting innovation across the wider economy.
资金充足的大学能够吸引优秀研究人员，从而推动更广泛经济领域的创新。
magnet.t: 比喻吸引某类人时常用a magnet for。

e: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
从阳台可以欣赏到壮丽的雪山景色。
Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.
保护宏伟的历史建筑能增强当地认同感，并吸引其他地区的游客。
magnificent.t: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

e: This lens magnifies tiny insects so we can examine them.
这个镜头能放大小昆虫，方便我们观察。
Social media can magnify public concerns by repeatedly exposing users to dramatic accounts of rare events.
社交媒体反复向用户展示对罕见事件的夸张描述，可能放大公众的担忧。
magnify.t: 既可指视觉放大，也可指夸大问题或加剧影响。

e: We only realised the magnitude of the damage at sunrise.
直到日出时，我们才意识到损坏的严重程度。
The magnitude of global food waste highlights the need for better storage systems and more responsible consumption.
全球食物浪费的巨大规模凸显了改善储存系统和更负责任地消费的必要性。
magnitude.t: 谈规模常用the magnitude of；震级也用此词。
