Greater internet penetration in rural areas can improve access to education and support the growth of small businesses.
提高农村地区的互联网普及率，有助于改善教育获取条件并支持小企业发展。
The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过岩石，朝大海走去。
Changes in ocean temperatures can affect penguin populations by altering the availability of fish and other prey.
海水温度的变化会改变鱼类及其他猎物的供应量，从而影响企鹅种群。
penguin.t: 企鹅是不会飞的鸟；并非全都生活在南极。

e: We cycled around the peninsula and stopped at a beach.
我们骑车绕着半岛游览，在一处海滩停了下来。
Tourism on the peninsula provides local employment, but excessive development could damage its fragile coastal habitats.
半岛上的旅游业为当地提供了就业机会，但过度开发可能破坏其脆弱的沿海栖息地。
peninsula.t: 半岛与大陆相连；island指四面环水的岛。

e: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
今天早上我在沙发底下发现了一枚便士硬币。
For families on low incomes, every penny saved on energy bills can make a difference.
对于低收入家庭，能源账单上省下的每一分钱都可能有所帮助。
penny.t: 英国金额复数用pence；指多枚硬币用pennies。

e: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。
Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。
people.t: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

e: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？
Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。
pepper.t: 胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。

e: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。
Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。
per.t: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

e: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。
Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。
percent.t: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

e: What percentage of your monthly income goes on rent?
你每月收入的百分之多少用于付房租？
The percentage of households using renewable energy has increased as installation costs have fallen in recent years.
近年来，随着安装成本下降，使用可再生能源的家庭比例有所上升。
My sister plays percussion in the school band.
我姐姐在学校乐队里演奏打击乐器。
Group percussion lessons can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and creative expression.
集体打击乐课程可以帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作与创造性表达。
percussion.t: 总称时不可数；一件打击乐器用a percussion instrument。

e: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。
Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
尽管没有完美的交通系统，可靠的公共交通服务仍能显著减少城市对汽车的依赖。
perfect.t: 形容词重音在前；动词读/pəˈfekt/（英）。

e: The bread was baked to perfection, with a crisp crust.
这面包烤得恰到好处，外皮酥脆。
An excessive desire for perfection can increase students' anxiety and discourage them from experimenting with new ideas.
过度追求完美会加重学生的焦虑，并使他们不愿尝试新想法。
perfection.t: 通常为不可数名词；to perfection指做得恰到好处。

e: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。
Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。
perform.t: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

e: The coach praised our performance after the football match.
足球赛后，教练表扬了我们的表现。
Regular feedback can improve employee performance by helping workers understand expectations and address specific weaknesses.
定期反馈能帮助员工了解工作要求并改进具体不足，从而提升工作表现。
performance.t: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。

e: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。
Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。
performer.t: 不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

e: She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist.
她在手腕上喷了一点香水。
Some workplaces discourage employees from wearing perfume because strong fragrances can cause discomfort for sensitive colleagues.
一些工作场所不鼓励员工使用香水，因为浓烈的香味可能让敏感的同事感到不适。
perfume.t: 表示身上用了香水常用wear perfume，而非put perfume。

e: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。
perhaps.t: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

e: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。
A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。
period.t: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

e: The old boiler needs periodic checks to keep working safely.
这台旧锅炉需要定期检查，才能继续安全运行。
Periodic assessments allow teachers to identify learning difficulties before students fall significantly behind their classmates.
定期评估能让教师在学生明显落后于同学之前发现其学习困难。
periodic.t: periodic是形容词，不是名词；副词为periodically。

e: The library keeps that periodical beside the newspapers.
图书馆把那种期刊放在报纸旁边。
Academic periodicals allow researchers to share findings, although subscription costs can limit access for smaller institutions.
学术期刊让研究人员能够分享成果，但订阅费用可能限制小型机构获取这些资源。
periodical.t: 名词指期刊；表示定期发生时，periodic更常用。

e: The paint colour is peripheral to our kitchen repairs.
油漆颜色在我们的厨房维修中是次要问题。
Funding debates should not allow peripheral issues to distract attention from the central goal of improving education.
资金讨论不应让次要问题分散人们对改善教育这一核心目标的关注。
peripheral.t: peripheral to表示对……而言次要或非核心。

e: These delicate plants will perish if left outside tonight.
这些娇嫩的植物如果今晚放在外面，就会冻死。
Without effective habitat protection, many vulnerable species may perish as temperatures rise and food sources disappear.
如果没有有效的栖息地保护，随着气温上升和食物来源消失，许多脆弱物种可能灭绝。
perish.t: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。

e: Planting a tree gave our new home a sense of permanence.
种下一棵树，让我们的新家有了长久安定的感觉。
The apparent permanence of digital records raises important questions about privacy and the right to be forgotten.
数字记录看似永久留存，这引发了有关隐私和被遗忘权的重要问题。
The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。
Investment in flood prevention can reduce the risk of permanent damage to homes and public infrastructure.
投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。
permanent.t: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。

e: The smell of fresh bread permeated the entire house.
新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整栋房子。
Digital technology now permeates almost every aspect of education, changing how students access information and collaborate with others.
数字技术如今渗透到教育的几乎各个方面，改变了学生获取信息和与他人合作的方式。
permeate.t: 可直接接宾语；气味弥漫房间无需加介词。

e: Is it permissible to take photographs inside this museum?
可以在这家博物馆内拍照吗？
Governments should establish clear limits on permissible emissions to protect public health in industrial areas.
政府应明确规定允许的排放限值，以保护工业区的公众健康。
permissible.t: 常用句型：It is permissible to do sth.。

e: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。
Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。
permission.t: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

e: The museum permits visitors to take photos without flash.
这家博物馆允许游客在不开闪光灯的情况下拍照。
Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.
地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。
permit.t: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。

e: Keep the drill perpendicular to the wooden board.
让电钻与木板保持垂直。
The proposed cycle path runs perpendicular to the main road, creating a crossing that requires careful safety planning.
拟建自行车道与主干道垂直相交，形成的交叉口需要周密的安全规划。
perpendicular.t: 表示与某物垂直用perpendicular to，不用with。

e: The dripping tap is a source of perpetual irritation.
水龙头不停滴水，让人一直心烦。
The pursuit of perpetual economic growth raises questions about how societies can protect limited natural resources.
对持续经济增长的追求引出了社会如何保护有限自然资源的问题。
perpetual.t: 可指永不停止，也常夸张表示某事没完没了。

e: The washing machine's strange noises continue to perplex me.
洗衣机发出的奇怪声响一直让我摸不着头脑。
Conflicting dietary advice can perplex consumers who are trying to make healthier food choices.
相互矛盾的饮食建议会让试图选择更健康食物的消费者感到困惑。
perplex.t: 及物动词；人感到困惑用perplexed，事物令人困惑用perplexing。

e: Her grandparents were persecuted because of their religious beliefs.
她的祖父母曾因宗教信仰受到迫害。
Governments must protect minority communities and ensure that nobody is persecuted for peacefully expressing their beliefs.
政府必须保护少数群体，确保没有人因和平表达信念而遭受迫害。
A persistent cough kept me awake throughout the night.
持续的咳嗽让我整夜都睡不着。
Persistent shortages of affordable housing can force young adults to delay leaving their family homes.
经济适用住房持续短缺，可能迫使年轻人推迟搬离父母家的计划。
persistent.t: 修饰问题常含负面意味；修饰人可表示坚持不懈。

e: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
只有一个人在面包店外等候。
Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.
每个人都应享有负担得起的医疗服务，无论其收入或就业状况如何。
person.t: 普通复数用people；persons多见于正式法律语境。

e: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。
Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。
personal.t: personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。

e: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
她开朗的性格让每位来吃饭的人都感到受欢迎。
Schools should recognise that differences in personality can influence how students participate in group activities.
学校应认识到，性格差异会影响学生参与集体活动的方式。
personality.t: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。

e: Personally, I prefer walking to taking the bus.
就我个人而言，我更喜欢步行而不是乘公交车。
Personally, I believe that public libraries remain essential because they provide free access to reliable information.
我个人认为，公共图书馆仍不可或缺，因为它们让人们免费获取可靠信息。
personally.t: take it personally指把事情看作针对自己。

e: Hearing her story gave me a completely different perspective.
听了她的故事，我对事情有了完全不同的看法。
Examining urban development from residents' perspective can help planners create more inclusive and accessible public spaces.
从居民的视角审视城市发展，有助于规划者打造更具包容性、更加便利的公共空间。
perspective.t: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。

e: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
我说服弟弟加入了我们的步行小组。
Public health campaigns can persuade people to adopt healthier habits by explaining the benefits in accessible language.
公共卫生宣传可以用通俗语言解释益处，说服人们养成更健康的习惯。
persuade.t: persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。

e: After some persuasion, my brother joined our evening walk.
经过一番劝说，我弟弟加入了我们的晚间散步。
Public health campaigns often rely on persuasion rather than legal restrictions to encourage healthier habits.
公共卫生宣传活动往往依靠劝导而非法律限制来鼓励更健康的习惯。
persuasion.t: 表示劝说时通常不可数；动词是persuade。

e: Her persuasive explanation finally convinced me to join the club.
她那番有说服力的解释终于让我同意加入俱乐部。
Public health campaigns need persuasive messages that encourage people to adopt healthier daily habits.
公共健康宣传需要有说服力的信息，鼓励人们养成更健康的日常习惯。
persuasive.t: 通常形容论点或表达有说服力，不作名词。

e: These rules pertain to everyone who uses the kitchen.
这些规定适用于所有使用厨房的人。
The committee reviewed documents pertaining to water quality before recommending stricter controls on industrial waste.
委员会在建议加强工业废物管控之前，审阅了有关水质的文件。
pertain.t: 正式用语，通常接to；常见结构为pertaining to。

e: Lena asked a pertinent question about the repair costs.
莉娜问了一个关于维修费用的切题问题。
Evidence about local air quality is particularly pertinent to discussions of expanding public transport networks.
有关当地空气质量的证据与扩大公共交通网络的讨论尤其相关。
pertinent.t: 常用pertinent to表示与某事相关，语体较正式。

e: He felt pessimistic about the picnic when clouds gathered.
乌云聚拢时，他觉得野餐恐怕办不成了。
Young people may become pessimistic about their career prospects when stable employment opportunities remain limited.
当稳定的就业机会持续不足时，年轻人可能对职业前景感到悲观。
pessimistic.t: 常用be pessimistic about；反义词是optimistic。

e: These tiny pests have eaten holes in my cabbage leaves.
这些小害虫把我的卷心菜叶咬出了洞。
Farmers can control pests through biological methods that reduce reliance on chemicals and protect beneficial insects.
农民可以采用生物方法防治害虫，减少对化学品的依赖并保护益虫。
pest.t: pest不限于昆虫，也可指老鼠等有害动物。

e: The farmer wore protective clothing while spraying pesticide on crops.
农民向作物喷洒农药时穿着防护服。
Excessive pesticide use can harm beneficial insects and contaminate water sources near agricultural land.
过量使用农药可能伤害益虫，并污染农田附近的水源。
Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
我们的宠物兔喜欢躲在厨房桌子下面。
Caring for a pet can help children develop responsibility and learn to recognise the needs of others.
照顾宠物能帮助儿童培养责任感，并学会察觉他人的需求。
pet.t: 动词过去式为petted；英式英语中抚摸也常用stroke。

e: Our neighbours signed a petition to save the playground.
邻居们在请愿书上签名，希望保住这座游乐场。
Residents submitted a petition asking the council to improve public transport in areas outside the city centre.
居民提交了请愿书，要求市政委员会改善市中心以外地区的公共交通。
petition.t: 动词常用petition somebody to do something。

e: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。
Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。
petrol.t: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

e: We wasted the afternoon arguing over petty details.
我们整个下午都浪费在争论琐碎细节上了。
Investment in youth services may help reduce petty crime by providing constructive activities and support.
投资青少年服务，为他们提供有益活动和支持，可能有助于减少轻微犯罪。
petty.t: 形容人时常含贬义，指小心眼，不只是小气。

e: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
午饭后，我去药店取了药。
A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。
pharmacy.t: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

e: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
厨房维修已进入最后阶段。
During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.
在城市发展的初期阶段，规划者应优先考虑可负担住房和可靠的公共交通。
phase.t: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。

e: The philosopher asked us what makes a life meaningful.
那位哲学家问我们，什么使人生有意义。
A philosopher might question whether economic growth should be the main measure of a society's progress.
哲学家可能会质疑，经济增长是否应当成为衡量社会进步的主要标准。
My sister studies philosophy and enjoys discussing difficult questions.
我姐姐学习哲学，喜欢讨论难解的问题。
Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.
学习哲学有助于学生质疑既有假设，并就复杂的伦理问题提出更有力的论证。
philosophy.t: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

e: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
我洗碗时，电话响了。
Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.
限制课堂上的手机使用，可能有助于学生更专注于课程和小组活动。
phone.t: 动词直接接人：phone someone，不加to。

e: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。
Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。
Please bring a photocopy of your passport tomorrow.
请明天带一份你的护照复印件来。
Students should keep a photocopy of important application documents in case the originals are lost.
学生应保留重要申请文件的复印件，以防原件丢失。
photocopy.t: 既作名词也作动词；复数和三单均为photocopies。

e: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
这张照片里，我的祖父母站在他们的第一所房子旁。
Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
历史照片为城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵的证据。
My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。
Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。
photography.t: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

e: I learned a useful phrase in my English class today.
今天我在英语课上学到了一个实用短语。
Researchers must phrase survey questions carefully to avoid influencing participants and reducing the reliability of their findings.
研究人员必须仔细斟酌调查问题的措辞，以免影响参与者并降低研究结果的可靠性。
phrase.t: phrase是短语，不一定构成完整句子。

e: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。
Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
规律的体育活动能够改善公众健康，并减轻国家医疗体系的财政压力。
physical.t: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

e: The physician listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。
Access to a qualified physician remains limited in remote areas, contributing to significant inequalities in healthcare.
偏远地区获得合格医生诊治的机会仍然有限，这加剧了医疗服务方面的显著不平等。
physician.t: 美式常泛指医生；英式常指内科医生。

e: A physicist showed our class how magnets work.
一位物理学家向我们班演示了磁铁的工作原理。
Physicists contribute to medical progress by developing imaging technologies that help doctors examine the human body.
物理学家通过开发帮助医生检查人体的成像技术，推动医学进步。
Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。
A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。
physics.t: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

e: The pianist smiled before playing her favourite song.
那位钢琴演奏者微微一笑，开始弹奏她最喜爱的歌曲。
A professional pianist usually needs years of disciplined practice as well as opportunities to perform publicly.
职业钢琴家通常既需要多年严格的练习，也需要公开演出的机会。
My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。
Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。
piano.t: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

e: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。
Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。
pick.t: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

e: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。
Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。
picnic.t: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

e: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。
Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。
picture.t: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

e: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。
Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。
She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。
Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。
piece.t: a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

e: Use a fork to pierce the potato before baking.
烘烤前，用叉子在土豆上扎几个孔。
Powerful artificial lights pierce the darkness around coastal developments, potentially disturbing the behaviour of nesting birds.
沿海开发区周围的强烈人造光穿透黑暗，可能干扰筑巢鸟类的行为。
pierce.t: 打耳洞常说have/get your ears pierced。

e: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。
Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。
pig.t: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

e: A grey pigeon landed on the bench beside me.
一只灰鸽子落在了我身旁的长椅上。
Urban pigeon populations often grow where food waste is abundant, highlighting the importance of effective rubbish collection.
城市里食物垃圾丰富的地方，鸽子数量往往会增加，这凸显了有效清运垃圾的重要性。
pigeon.t: 注意拼写pigeon；同音词pidgin指洋泾浜语。

e: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
一堆脏餐具塞满了水槽。
When waste collection services are inadequate, piles of rubbish can threaten public health in densely populated neighbourhoods.
垃圾清运服务不足时，成堆的垃圾可能威胁人口密集社区的公共卫生。
pile.t: a pile of后接所堆之物；pile up表示积聚。

e: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
他用一杯水把药片吞了下去。
Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.
虽然药物可能缓解症状，但要持久改善健康，往往需要改变日常习惯。
pill.t: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。

e: We sheltered from the rain behind a stone pillar.
我们躲在一根石柱后面避雨。
Accessible education is a central pillar of social development because it expands opportunities across generations.
普及教育是社会发展的核心支柱，因为它能为一代又一代人拓展机会。
pillar.t: pillar of可比喻某体系的支柱或群体的中坚。

e: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。
Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。
pillow.t: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

e: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。
The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。
pilot.t: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

e: She used a pin to hold the fabric together.
她用一枚大头针把布料固定在一起。
Teachers can pin students' artwork to classroom walls to celebrate creativity and encourage participation.
教师可以把学生的美术作品钉在教室墙上，以肯定创造力并鼓励参与。
pin.t: pin作动词时，过去式pinned，进行式pinning。

e: Pinch the pastry edges together to seal the pie.
把面皮边缘捏合，将馅饼封好。
As food prices rise, families on low incomes increasingly feel the pinch and reduce nonessential spending.
随着食品价格上涨，低收入家庭越来越感到经济拮据，并减少非必要支出。
pinch.t: a pinch of表少量；feel the pinch指手头紧。

e: We rested beneath a tall pine after lunch.
午饭后，我们在一棵高大的松树下休息。
Planting pine trees can support timber production, but diverse native forests generally provide richer wildlife habitats.
种植松树可以支持木材生产，但树种多样的原生森林通常能提供更丰富的野生动物栖息地。
pine.t: pine for表示渴望或思念；pine away指日渐憔悴。

e: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。
Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
种植菠萝用于出口可以增加农村收入，但集约化种植可能损害当地土壤。
pineapple.t: 整个菠萝可数，作为食物的菠萝果肉常不可数。

e: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。
Community centres can offer inexpensive activities such as ping-pong to encourage social interaction among older residents.
社区中心可以提供乒乓球等花费不高的活动，鼓励老年居民进行社交。
ping-pong.t: 较口语化；正式比赛和写作常用table tennis。

e: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。
Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。
pink.t: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

e: Winning the tournament was the pinnacle of her career.
赢得那场锦标赛是她职业生涯的巅峰。
For many researchers, international recognition represents the pinnacle of a career devoted to scientific discovery.
对许多研究人员而言，获得国际认可代表着献身科学探索的职业生涯达到顶峰。
pinnacle.t: 比喻义常用the pinnacle of，表示成就的顶峰。

e: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。
Consumers comparing international recipes should note that a British pint is larger than an American pint.
比较不同国家食谱的消费者应注意，英制品脱比美制品脱大。
pint.t: 英制品脱约568毫升，美制液量品脱约473毫升。

e: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。
Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。
pipe.t: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

e: The pirate in the story sailed a wooden ship.
故事里的海盗驾驶着一艘木船。
When companies pirate educational software, they undermine the income that developers need to improve their products.
企业盗版教育软件，会损害开发者改进产品所需的收入。
pirate.t: pirated强调被非法复制；piracy是对应名词。

e: The old pistol was displayed behind thick museum glass.
那把旧手枪陈列在博物馆的厚玻璃后面。
Strict pistol storage requirements can reduce accidental injuries and improve safety in local communities.
严格的手枪存放要求可以减少意外伤害，提高当地社区的安全水平。
The mechanic removed a damaged piston from the engine.
机修工从发动机中拆下了一个损坏的活塞。
In a conventional engine, expanding gases push each piston, converting energy from fuel into mechanical motion.
在传统发动机中，膨胀的气体推动每个活塞，将燃料的能量转化为机械运动。
piston.t: 活塞在 cylinder（气缸）内往复运动。

e: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
我们挖了一个浅坑，准备栽这棵新树。
Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.
废弃矿坑可能威胁当地生态系统，除非修复项目能稳固土壤并改善水质。
pit.t: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

e: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。
Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。
pitch.t: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。

e: I felt pity for the puppy shivering in the rain.
看到小狗在雨中发抖，我心生怜悯。
It is a pity that many historic buildings are demolished before their cultural value is properly assessed.
许多历史建筑的文化价值尚未得到充分评估就被拆除，实在令人遗憾。
pity.t: 表同情通常不可数；表遗憾常用a pity。

e: The seesaw turned smoothly on its central pivot.
跷跷板绕着中央支点平稳地转动。
Small companies may need to pivot towards online services as consumer habits change and operating costs rise.
随着消费者习惯改变和运营成本上升，小公司可能需要转向线上服务。
pivot.t: pivotal 表示关键的；pivot 作动词也可指策略转向。

e: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。
Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。
pizza.t: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

e: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。
Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。
place.t: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

e: The museum has an exhibition about plague in medieval towns.
博物馆有一个关于中世纪城镇瘟疫的展览。
Poor drainage continues to plague rapidly growing cities, increasing flood risks and threatening the health of local residents.
排水不良持续困扰着快速发展的城市，增加了洪灾风险，并威胁当地居民的健康。
plague.t: 动词常用be plagued by，表示长期反复受困扰。

e: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。
Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。
plain.t: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

e: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。
Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。
plan.t: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

e: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。
Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。
plane.t: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

e: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。
Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。
planet.t: planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。

e: We laid a plank across the muddy ditch.
我们在泥泞的沟上架了一块厚木板。
Investment in affordable housing should be a central plank of any strategy to reduce urban inequality.
投资可负担住房应成为任何缩小城市不平等的战略的核心内容。
plank.t: a central plank of可比喻政策的核心内容。

e: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。
Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。
plant.t: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

e: We walked past a tea plantation on the hillside.
我们从山坡上的一片茶园旁走过。
Expanding palm oil plantations can threaten biodiversity when natural forests are cleared to make room for crops.
为扩大油棕种植园而清除天然森林，可能威胁生物多样性。
plantation.t: 通常指大面积种植单类作物的农场，不是普通花园。

e: My cousin donates plasma at the local clinic.
我的表亲在当地诊所捐献血浆。
Donated plasma contains proteins that can be used to produce treatments for certain immune system disorders.
捐献的血浆含有可用于生产某些免疫系统疾病治疗药物的蛋白质。
plasma.t: 通常不可数；医学中指血浆，物理学中指等离子体。

e: Small pieces of plaster fell from the kitchen ceiling.
小块灰泥从厨房天花板上掉了下来。
Restoring historic buildings often requires skilled workers who can repair damaged plaster without harming original decorative features.
修复历史建筑往往需要熟练工人，他们能在不损坏原有装饰的情况下修补受损灰泥。
plaster.t: 表灰泥时通常不可数；英式英语中a plaster是创可贴。

e: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。
Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。
plastic.t: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

e: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。
Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。
plate.t: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

e: We camped on a grassy plateau above the valley.
我们在山谷上方一片长满青草的高原上露营。
Language learners often reach a plateau and may need different study methods to make further progress.
语言学习者常会进入平台期，可能需要改变学习方法才能继续进步。
plateau.t: 平台期指增长后趋稳，不表示水平开始下降。

e: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。
Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。
platform.t: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

e: His explanation sounded plausible, but I still checked.
他的解释听起来很合理，但我还是核实了一下。
Although remote working offers a plausible solution to congestion, its long-term effects require further investigation.
虽然远程办公似乎是缓解拥堵的合理方案，但其长期影响仍需进一步研究。
plausible.t: 表示听起来合理，不保证真实，也不一定暗指虚假。

e: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。
Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。
play.t: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

e: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。
Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。
player.t: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

e: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。
Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。
playground.t: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

e: They heard our plea for help and stopped immediately.
他们听见我们的求助声，立刻停了下来。
Residents made a plea for better flood protection after repeated storms damaged homes across the region.
多次暴风雨损坏该地区房屋后，居民恳请加强防洪措施。
plea.t: plea for后接所求之物；plea to后接请求对象。

e: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
我们在河边愉快地散了步。
Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.
公共花园提供舒适宜人的空间，让居民锻炼、社交，并暂时摆脱城市生活的压力。
pleasant.t: pleasant形容事物令人愉快；pleased形容人感到高兴。

e: Could you please hold the door for me?
你能帮我扶一下门吗？
Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
旨在取悦所有群体的公共政策，可能无法解决最紧迫的社会问题。
please.t: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

e: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
我对这个蛋糕做出来的效果非常满意。
Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.
居民们很高兴，市政部门增设了更多绿地，让孩子们可以安全地玩耍。
pleased.t: 对结果满意用pleased with；听到喜讯用pleased to hear。

e: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。
Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。
pleasure.t: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

e: We made a pledge to keep the beach clean.
我们郑重承诺保持海滩清洁。
Local authorities have pledged to improve public transport and reduce traffic congestion over the next decade.
地方政府已承诺在未来十年改善公共交通并缓解交通拥堵。
pledge.t: 比promise更正式；动词常接to do。

e: Fresh berries are plentiful at the market this summer.
今年夏天，市场上的新鲜浆果供应充足。
Regions with plentiful sunshine are well placed to generate affordable electricity through investment in solar technology.
阳光充足的地区具备有利条件，可以通过投资太阳能技术生产价格低廉的电力。
plentiful.t: 表示物资或机会充足，不表示一个人富有。

e: There is plenty of soup left for everyone.
剩下的汤足够大家喝。
Although cities offer plenty of employment opportunities, high housing costs can discourage young workers from moving there.
尽管城市提供大量就业机会，高昂的住房成本仍可能让年轻劳动者不愿迁入。
plenty.t: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。

e: Warm the clay until it becomes soft and pliable.
把黏土加热，直到它变得柔软易塑形。
Pliable materials allow designers to create lightweight products that can be folded for easier storage and transport.
柔韧材料让设计师能够制造可折叠的轻质产品，方便储存和运输。
pliable.t: 形容材料指柔韧；形容人常指易被摆布。

e: The film had a simple but exciting plot.
这部电影的情节简单却扣人心弦。
Community gardens allow residents to grow vegetables on a small plot, improving access to fresh food.
社区花园让居民可以在一小块土地上种菜，更方便地获得新鲜食物。
plot.t: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

e: The farmer pulled an old plough from the shed.
农民从棚里拖出了一把旧犁。
Farmers who plough steep slopes too frequently may increase soil erosion and reduce long-term agricultural productivity.
过于频繁地耕作陡坡的农民可能会加剧水土流失，并降低长期农业生产力。
plough.t: 美式拼作plow；两种拼写都读/plaʊ/。

e: Pull the plug out before you clean the toaster.
清洁烤面包机前，先拔掉插头。
Households can reduce some unnecessary electricity consumption by removing plugs from sockets when appliances are not in use.
家电不用时拔掉插头，家庭就能减少一些不必要的耗电。
plug.t: 插头是plug，插座是socket；plug in表示插电。

e: She picked a plump peach from the fruit bowl.
她从果盘里挑了一个饱满的桃子。
Consumers often prefer plump fruit, although appearance alone is not a reliable indicator of nutritional value.
消费者往往偏爱饱满的水果，但单凭外观并不能可靠地判断营养价值。
plump.t: 比fat语气温和，但描述他人体型仍需谨慎。

e: He plunged his muddy boots into a bucket of water.
他把沾满泥的靴子猛地浸进一桶水里。
Tourism revenue may plunge when extreme weather forces popular coastal resorts to close during peak season.
当极端天气迫使热门海滨度假区在旺季关闭时，旅游收入可能骤降。
plunge.t: plunge into可指跳入，也可指突然陷入某种状态。

e: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。
Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。
plus.t: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

e: My grandfather stayed in hospital while recovering from pneumonia.
我爷爷在肺炎康复期间住在医院里。
Improved access to vaccination and timely treatment can reduce deaths from pneumonia, particularly among young children.
提高疫苗接种的可及性并提供及时治疗，可以减少肺炎死亡，尤其是幼儿的死亡。
pneumonia.t: 词首p不发音；通常不可数，不说a pneumonia。

e: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。
Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。
pocket.t: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。

e: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。
Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.
阅读来自另一种文化的诗歌，可以帮助学生探索陌生的视角，培养语言敏感度。
poem.t: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

e: The poet read her latest work beside the fireplace.
这位诗人在壁炉旁朗读了她的最新作品。
A poet can challenge social attitudes by expressing familiar experiences in unexpected and emotionally powerful ways.
诗人可以用出人意料且富有感染力的方式表达日常体验，从而挑战社会观念。
poet.t: poet指诗人，poem指一首诗，poetry统称诗歌。

e: She reads poetry aloud while her tea cools.
她一边等茶凉下来，一边朗读诗歌。
Studying poetry encourages students to explore complex emotions and appreciate the expressive possibilities of language.
学习诗歌能鼓励学生探索复杂情感，并欣赏语言丰富的表达潜力。
poetry.t: poetry不可数；一首诗用a poem，不用a poetry。

e: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。
The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。
point.t: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

e: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
有些园艺植物含有毒素，因此要让宠物远离。
Toxic waste from poorly regulated factories can poison rivers, threatening wildlife and the health of nearby communities.
监管不力的工厂排出的有毒废物可能污染河流，威胁野生动物和附近居民的健康。
poison.t: poison 是名词或动词；“有毒的”用 poisonous。

e: Some colourful berries are poisonous, so leave them alone.
有些颜色鲜艳的浆果有毒，所以不要碰。
Factories must prevent poisonous substances from entering rivers that supply drinking water to nearby communities.
工厂必须防止有毒物质流入为周边社区提供饮用水的河流。
She poked the dough gently to check its softness.
她轻轻戳了戳面团，检查它是否柔软。
Museum visitors can poke virtual objects on interactive screens to explore scientific concepts through play.
博物馆游客可以戳点互动屏幕上的虚拟物体，在玩乐中探索科学概念。
poke.t: poke fun at是“取笑”，不是“戳”。

e: We watched a film about animals in polar regions.
我们看了一部关于极地动物的影片。
Rising global temperatures threaten polar ecosystems by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.
全球气温升高使许多物种赖以生存的海冰减少，威胁着极地生态系统。
polar.t: polar指两极地区；polar opposites表示截然相反。

e: We used a long pole to support the tent.
我们用一根长杆撑起帐篷。
Climate change is affecting both poles, although the environmental consequences differ significantly between the two regions.
气候变化正影响着南北两极，但两个地区面临的环境后果存在显著差异。
pole.t: pole与poll同音；地理名称the North Pole需大写。

e: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
警方帮我们找到了丢失的自行车。
Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.
警方与当地居民的有效合作可以改善公共安全，并建立社区内部的信任。
police.t: the police作主语用复数；一名警察用a police officer。

e: A policeman helped us cross the busy road.
一位男警察帮我们穿过了繁忙的马路。
A local policeman visited the school to explain how children can stay safe online.
当地一位男警察到学校讲解儿童如何保障上网安全。
policeman.t: policeman指男性；不强调性别用police officer。

e: Our school has a policy of serving fresh fruit daily.
我们学校规定每天供应新鲜水果。
An effective housing policy should address both rising rents and the shortage of affordable homes.
有效的住房政策应同时应对租金上涨和可负担住房短缺的问题。
policy.t: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

e: I polish my shoes before every important meeting.
每次参加重要会议前，我都会把鞋擦亮。
University students should learn to polish their writing by removing unnecessary words and organising arguments logically.
大学生应学会通过删去多余词语和有条理地组织论点来润色文章。
polish.t: 小写polish指擦亮；大写Polish指波兰的，读音不同。

e: The polite child held the door open for us.
那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。
Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。
polite.t: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

e: We often discuss political issues around the dinner table.
我们经常在餐桌上讨论政治问题。
Political stability can encourage long-term investment and help governments maintain essential public services.
政治稳定能够鼓励长期投资，并帮助政府维持必要的公共服务。
political.t: political是形容词；politics指政治，politician指政治家。

e: A local politician visited our neighbourhood to discuss transport.
一位当地政治人物来到我们社区讨论交通问题。
Politicians should consult local communities before making decisions that could affect access to public services.
政治人物在作出可能影响公共服务获取的决定前，应征求当地社区的意见。
politician.t: politician指从政者，本身不一定含贬义。

e: My uncle loves discussing politics over dinner with friends.
我叔叔喜欢在晚餐时和朋友们讨论政治。
Greater involvement in politics can help young people influence decisions that affect their future.
更多地参与政治能帮助年轻人影响关乎自身未来的决策。
politics.t: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

e: A local poll showed strong support for the park.
一项当地民意调查显示，人们大力支持这座公园。
Opinion polls can help governments understand public concerns, but their accuracy depends on how participants are selected.
民意调查有助于政府了解公众关切，但其准确性取决于参与者的选择方式。
poll.t: 民调常用opinion poll；the polls指选举投票。

e: This filter removes harmful pollutants from our drinking water.
这个过滤器能去除我们饮用水中的有害污染物。
Stricter controls on industrial pollutants could improve air quality and reduce respiratory illness in urban areas.
更严格地管控工业污染物可以改善空气质量，减少城市地区的呼吸道疾病。
pollutant.t: pollutant指具体污染物，可数；pollution指污染。

e: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
请不要往小溪里扔垃圾，污染溪水。
Factories that pollute local rivers should face stricter penalties to protect ecosystems and public health.
污染当地河流的工厂应受到更严厉的处罚，以保护生态系统和公众健康。
pollute.t: 及物动词，直接接被污染的对象，不加介词。

e: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
空气污染让远处的山丘难以看清。
Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。
A green frog jumped into the pond beside our house.
一只绿青蛙跳进了我们屋旁的池塘。
Creating ponds in urban parks can provide valuable habitats for amphibians and increase local biodiversity.
在城市公园中建造池塘可以为两栖动物提供宝贵的栖息地，并增加当地的生物多样性。
pond.t: pond通常比lake小；可指天然或人工池塘。

e: She pondered the menu before ordering vegetable soup.
她仔细看了看菜单，才点了蔬菜汤。
Policymakers must ponder the long-term consequences of replacing public transport services with privately operated alternatives.
政策制定者必须仔细考虑用私营服务取代公共交通服务的长期后果。
ponder.t: 可直接接宾语，也可用ponder on/over。

e: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。
Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。
pool.t: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。

e: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。
Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。
poor.t: poor at表示不擅长；poor in表示缺乏。

e: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。
Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。
pop.t: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

e: We shared a bowl of popcorn during the film.
看电影时，我们一起吃了一碗爆米花。
Cinemas often earn additional revenue by selling snacks such as popcorn alongside tickets for film screenings.
电影院除了出售电影票，往往还通过销售爆米花等零食获得额外收入。
popcorn.t: 通常是不可数名词；一颗可说a piece of popcorn。

e: This small café is popular with local students.
这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。
Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。
popular.t: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

e: Her cooking videos helped popularize this simple bean soup.
她的烹饪视频让这道简单的豆汤流行起来。
Public broadcasters can popularize scientific knowledge by explaining complex discoveries through accessible documentaries and practical demonstrations.
公共广播机构可以通过通俗的纪录片和实际演示解释复杂的发现，从而普及科学知识。
popularize.t: 英式也常写popularise；不只是“宣传”。

e: The village population grows when families move here.
有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。
An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。
population.t: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。

e: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
我们把沾满泥的靴子放在门廊上过了一夜。
A shaded porch can reduce indoor temperatures while providing residents with a comfortable outdoor meeting space.
带遮阴的门廊既能降低室内温度，也能为住户提供舒适的户外交流空间。
porch.t: 指入口外的有顶空间，不是室内走廊。

e: Tiny drops of sweat appeared around his skin pores.
他的皮肤毛孔周围冒出了细小的汗珠。
Researchers pore over historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of severe drought.
研究人员仔细研读历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对严重干旱时期。
pore.t: 动词常用pore over，勿与pour over混淆。

e: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
我们把猪肉和苹果、洋葱一起慢炖。
Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.
清晰的食品标签有助于消费者识别含猪肉的产品，并作出符合自身饮食要求的选择。
pork.t: pork是不可数名词，指肉；活猪用pig。

e: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。
Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。
porridge.t: 通常为不可数名词；一碗用a bowl of。

e: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
我们看着渔船返回港口。
Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。
port.t: port指左舷时，反义词是starboard（右舷）。

e: We took a portable speaker to the picnic.
我们带了一个便携式音箱去野餐。
Portable medical equipment enables healthcare workers to provide essential services in remote rural communities.
便携式医疗设备使医护人员能够在偏远农村社区提供基本服务。
portable.t: 强调容易携带或移动，不一定能放进口袋。

e: The porter carried our heavy suitcases to the lift.
行李搬运工把我们沉重的行李箱搬到了电梯旁。
Hotels can improve accessibility by training each porter to assist guests with limited mobility.
酒店可以培训每位行李搬运工协助行动不便的客人，从而改善无障碍服务。
porter.t: 不是泛指服务员；通常指搬行李者或门房。

e: She brought her photography portfolio to the interview.
她带着自己的摄影作品集去参加面试。
A diversified investment portfolio can reduce financial risk, although it cannot guarantee steady returns.
多元化的投资组合可以降低金融风险，但不能保证稳定的回报。
portfolio.t: 求职时常指作品集；金融语境指投资组合。

e: A large portion of our garden is shaded.
我们花园里有很大一部分处于阴凉处。
Housing costs consume a substantial portion of household income, particularly in cities with limited affordable accommodation.
住房开支占家庭收入的很大一部分，在平价住房有限的城市尤其如此。
portion.t: portion可指整体的一部分，也常指一人份食物。

e: My grandmother's portrait hangs above the living room fireplace.
我祖母的肖像挂在客厅壁炉上方。
The documentary offers a compelling portrait of rural life as younger generations move to urban areas.
这部纪录片生动描绘了年轻一代迁往城市背景下的乡村生活。
portrait.t: portrait以人物为主体；landscape多指风景画或照片。

e: Her paintings portray village life in warm colours.
她的画作用温暖的色彩描绘了乡村生活。
News reports often portray urban life as stressful, overlooking the social and cultural opportunities cities provide.
新闻报道常将城市生活描绘为压力重重，却忽视了城市提供的社交和文化机会。
portray.t: 常用portray A as B，表示把A描绘成B。

e: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。
position.t: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

e: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。
Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.
经常接触大自然可以对儿童的情绪发展和整体健康产生积极影响。
positive.t: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。

e: My uncle possesses a remarkable collection of antique clocks.
我叔叔拥有一批令人惊叹的古董钟藏品。
Graduates who possess strong communication skills are often better prepared to adapt to changing workplace demands.
具备较强沟通能力的毕业生通常更能适应不断变化的职场要求。
possess.t: 比have正式；通常不用进行时。注意拼写有四个s。

e: There is a possibility of snow later tonight.
今晚晚些时候可能会下雪。
Improved public transport increases the possibility that commuters will leave their cars at home.
改善公共交通会增加通勤者不开车出行的可能性。
possibility.t: 常用possibility of doing或possibility that从句。

e: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
可以预订今晚的餐桌吗？
Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.
对可再生能源的投资使各国有可能减少对进口燃料的依赖。
possible.t: 常用it is possible to do；不说人is possible to do。

e: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。
Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。
possibly.t: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

e: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
今天早上寄来了一个包裹。
Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。
post.t: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

e: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
午饭前，我把包裹送到了邮局。
A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.
当地邮局可以为缺乏可靠网络连接的农村居民提供基本服务。
post office.t: 标准拼写为post office，两词之间不加连字符。

e: I dropped the birthday card into the postbox outside.
我把生日贺卡投进了外面的邮筒。
Keeping a postbox within walking distance helps residents without internet access maintain contact with essential services.
在步行可达的范围内保留邮筒，有助于无法上网的居民与基本服务机构保持联系。
postbox.t: 英式英语指公共寄信邮筒；美式通常用mailbox。

e: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。
Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。
postcard.t: 寄给某人可说send someone a postcard或用to引出收件人。

e: Please include your postcode when you fill in the form.
填写表格时，请填上你的邮政编码。
Researchers used postcode data to compare access to public transport across different residential areas.
研究人员利用邮政编码数据，比较不同住宅区的公共交通便利程度。
postcode.t: 英式常用postcode；美式常用ZIP code。

e: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
她在书桌上方挂了一张色彩鲜艳的海报。
A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.
设计精良的海报可以清晰而有吸引力地传达环保信息，鼓励人们回收利用。
poster.t: poster 是海报；postcard 是明信片，注意区分。

e: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。
In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。
postman.t: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

e: We postponed our picnic because heavy rain was forecast.
因为天气预报说有大雨，我们推迟了野餐。
Local authorities decided to postpone construction until a full assessment of the environmental impact was completed.
地方当局决定推迟施工，直到完成全面的环境影响评估。
postpone.t: 后接名词或动名词：postpone doing，不接to do。

e: Adjusting your chair can improve your posture while working.
调整椅子能改善你工作时的坐姿。
Schools should teach children how good posture and regular movement can reduce discomfort during prolonged study.
学校应教导儿童，良好姿势和定时活动如何减轻长时间学习带来的不适。
posture.t: 名词常指体态；动词常含“装样子”的贬义。

e: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。
Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。
pot.t: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

e: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。
Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.
马铃薯种植为世界各地许多农村社区提供了重要的食物和收入来源。
potato.t: 复数是 potatoes，词尾加 es。

e: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
市场摊位上陈列着色调柔和、带有泥土色泽的陶器。
Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.
传统陶器能够揭示早期社会如何储存食物、交易商品以及表达文化身份。
pottery.t: 指陶器统称时不可数；一件用a piece of pottery。

e: My aunt keeps poultry in a spacious backyard enclosure.
我阿姨在后院一个宽敞的围栏里养家禽。
Higher welfare standards for poultry can improve animal health, although they may increase production costs.
提高家禽福利标准可以改善动物健康，但可能增加生产成本。
poultry.t: 不用a poultry；表示一只家禽可说a chicken等。

e: I paid one pound for this bag of apples.
我花了一英镑买了这袋苹果。
A weaker pound can attract international tourists, but it also raises the cost of imported goods.
英镑贬值可以吸引国际游客，但也会提高进口商品的成本。
pound.t: 英镑和重量单位磅都用pound；复数通常加s。

e: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
她把温牛奶倒进一个蓝色的大杯子里。
When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.
工厂将未经处理的废弃物排入河流时，会威胁水生生态系统及附近社区的饮用水安全。
pour.t: 倒入用pour into；倒出用pour out of。

e: The charity helps local families living in poverty.
这家慈善机构帮助当地生活贫困的家庭。
Improving access to education and stable employment can help reduce poverty across both rural and urban communities.
改善教育机会和稳定就业机会，有助于减少城乡社区的贫困。
poverty.t: 不可数名词；“生活贫困”用live in poverty。

e: Stir the cocoa powder into a little warm milk.
把可可粉搅入少量温牛奶中。
Some manufacturers turn surplus fruit into powder to extend its shelf life and reduce food waste.
一些生产商将多余的水果制成果粉，以延长保质期并减少食物浪费。
powder.t: powder通常不可数；一勺粉用a spoonful of powder。

e: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
经理有权调整我们的班次。
Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。
power.t: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

e: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
大风把我们的花园椅子吹到了草地上。
Powerful companies should take greater responsibility for reducing the environmental damage caused by their operations.
有影响力的企业应承担更大责任，减少其经营活动造成的环境破坏。
powerful.t: 通常作形容词；副词用powerfully，不用powerful。

e: Taking the bus is practicable now the road has reopened.
道路重新开放后，坐公交车现在行得通了。
Local authorities must assess whether expanding public transport is financially practicable before approving new infrastructure projects.
地方政府在批准新基础设施项目之前，必须评估扩大公共交通在财务上是否可行。
practicable.t: practicable强调可实施；practical还可指实用的。

e: The course gave me practical experience in repairing bikes.
这门课程让我获得了修理自行车的实践经验。
Schools should combine academic learning with practical skills to prepare students for a changing workplace.
学校应将学术学习与实用技能相结合，帮助学生为不断变化的职场做好准备。
practical.t: practical可强调亲手实践，也可表示实用、可行。

e: The fridge was practically empty when we got home.
我们到家时，冰箱几乎空了。
Without reliable internet access, participating in online education is practically impossible for students in remote areas.
没有可靠的互联网连接，偏远地区的学生几乎无法参与在线教育。
practically.t: 常表示“几乎”，并不总等于“实际地”。

e: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。
Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。
practice.t: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

e: The nurse suggested speaking to a qualified medical practitioner.
护士建议咨询有资质的执业医师。
Experienced practitioners should help design training programmes so that graduates develop skills relevant to their profession.
经验丰富的从业者应参与设计培训课程，让毕业生掌握与职业相关的技能。
practitioner.t: general practitioner指全科医生，常缩写为GP。

e: We took a pragmatic approach and repaired the old sofa.
我们采取了务实的办法，把旧沙发修好了。
A pragmatic housing policy should balance environmental goals with the immediate needs of local residents.
务实的住房政策应兼顾环保目标和当地居民的迫切需求。
pragmatic.t: 强调实际可行和效果，而非理论或理想。

e: We watched tall grass ripple across the open prairie.
我们看着高高的草在开阔的大草原上起伏。
Protecting native prairie habitats helps preserve biodiversity and maintains grassland ecosystems that store substantial amounts of carbon.
保护原生北美草原生境有助于维护生物多样性，并维持储存大量碳的草原生态系统。
prairie.t: 通常特指北美草原；泛指草地可用 grassland。

e: Our coach praised us for helping the new players.
教练表扬了我们帮助新队员的举动。
Teachers who praise effort rather than natural ability may encourage students to persist when facing academic challenges.
表扬努力而非天赋的教师，可能更能鼓励学生在学业遇到挑战时坚持下去。
praise.t: praise sb for sth；名词通常不可数。

e: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。
Providing quiet spaces allows people of different faiths to pray while studying or working on campus.
提供安静的空间能让不同信仰的人在校园学习或工作期间祈祷。
pray.t: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

e: She closed her eyes and said a quiet prayer.
她闭上眼睛，轻声祈祷。
For many communities, prayer provides comfort during difficult times and strengthens a sense of belonging.
对许多群体而言，祈祷能在艰难时期带来慰藉，并增强归属感。
prayer.t: 表示祈祷活动常不可数；一段祷词可数。

e: The minister preached about kindness at the morning service.
牧师在晨间礼拜中以友善为主题讲道。
Schools should demonstrate respect through everyday practices rather than simply preach the importance of good behaviour.
学校应通过日常实践展现尊重，而不应仅仅说教，强调良好行为的重要性。
preach.t: preach to someone常含“对某人说教”的贬义。

e: The ladder looked precarious on the wet, uneven ground.
梯子架在湿滑不平的地面上，看起来摇摇欲坠。
Workers on short-term contracts often face precarious financial circumstances, making it difficult to plan for the future.
短期合同工往往面临不稳定的经济状况，难以规划未来。
precarious.t: 不仅表示“不稳定”，还暗含随时出问题的风险。

e: We packed an extra torch as a precaution.
我们多带了一个手电筒，以防万一。
Taking basic safety precautions in laboratories can prevent accidents and protect both students and teaching staff.
在实验室采取基本安全防范措施，可以预防事故并保护师生。
precaution.t: 常用 take precautions；as a precaution 表示以防万一。

e: A short welcome speech will precede the evening meal.
晚餐前会有一段简短的欢迎致辞。
Thorough environmental assessments should precede major construction projects to identify potential risks to local ecosystems.
大型建设项目启动前应进行全面的环境评估，以识别对当地生态系统的潜在风险。
precede.t: precede 指先于；proceed 指继续进行。

e: I slept badly on the night preceding my interview.
面试前一晚，我睡得很不好。
The survey revealed that household energy consumption had fallen significantly compared with the preceding year.
调查显示，与前一年相比，家庭能源消耗已显著下降。
preceding.t: preceding指所谈时间或事物之前的，不等于现在之前。

e: She keeps her precious necklace in a velvet box.
她把珍贵的项链放在一个天鹅绒盒子里。
Fresh water is a precious resource that requires careful management as populations grow and temperatures rise.
随着人口增长和气温上升，淡水作为宝贵资源需要得到谨慎管理。
precious.t: 既可指金钱价值高，也可指感情上珍贵或资源稀缺。

e: A broken pipe precipitated an emergency visit from the plumber.
水管破裂，水管工因此紧急上门维修。
A sharp increase in food prices could precipitate a wider economic crisis in vulnerable regions.
食品价格大幅上涨可能在脆弱地区引发更广泛的经济危机。
precipitate.t: 动词末尾读/teɪt/，名词、形容词读/tət/。

e: The heavy rain precluded our planned picnic by the lake.
大雨让我们原定的湖边野餐无法进行。
High tuition fees may preclude students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education without financial support.
高昂的学费可能使弱势家庭的学生在没有经济资助的情况下无法接受高等教育。
preclude.t: 正式用词；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

e: The rabbit froze when it noticed a predator nearby.
兔子发现附近有捕食者时，一动也不敢动。
Protecting natural predators can help farmers control pests without relying heavily on chemical pesticides.
保护天敌可以帮助农民防治害虫，减少对化学农药的依赖。
predator.t: predator是捕食者，prey是被捕食的猎物。

e: My predecessor left some helpful notes in the desk.
我的前任在桌子里留下了一些有用的笔记。
The new transport system uses less energy than its predecessor while carrying substantially more passengers.
新的交通系统比其前身能耗更低，同时运载的乘客大幅增加。
predecessor.t: 指某职位的前任或事物的前身，不泛指所有前辈。

e: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
他们预报有大雨，所以带上你的伞吧。
Climate models help scientists predict how rising temperatures may affect agricultural production in different regions.
气候模型帮助科学家预测气温上升可能如何影响不同地区的农业生产。
predict.t: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

e: The film's predictable ending made us laugh rather than cry.
这部电影老套的结局让我们笑了，而不是哭了。
A predictable income helps families plan their spending and reduces the stress associated with financial uncertainty.
可预期的收入有助于家庭规划支出，并减轻财务不确定性带来的压力。
predictable.t: 既可表示结果可预料，也可贬指情节老套。

e: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
你预测对了：整个下午都在下雨。
Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.
准确预测未来能源需求，对于规划可靠且可持续的电力供应至关重要。
prediction.t: 作出预测用make a prediction，不用do。

e: The author explains her inspiration in the book's preface.
作者在这本书的前言中解释了她的创作灵感。
In the preface, the researchers explain how their personal experiences influenced the questions explored throughout the book.
研究人员在前言中解释了个人经历如何影响全书探讨的问题。
preface.t: 书的preface通常由作者写；foreword常由他人撰写。

e: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。
Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。
prefer.t: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

e: A quiet evening at home is preferable to another party.
比起再参加一场聚会，在家度过安静的夜晚更合心意。
Investing in reliable public transport is often preferable to building more roads in densely populated cities.
在人口稠密的城市，投资可靠的公共交通通常比修建更多道路更可取。
preferable.t: 用A is preferable to B，不用than；通常不加more。

e: My preference is tea, but coffee is fine too.
我更喜欢茶，不过咖啡也可以。
Consumer preference for locally grown food can encourage sustainable farming and reduce transport emissions.
消费者对本地种植食品的偏好可以促进可持续农业，并减少运输排放。
preference.t: 对某物的偏好用preference for，不用to。

e: She enjoyed gentle walks throughout her pregnancy last year.
去年怀孕期间，她一直喜欢轻松地散步。
Access to reliable healthcare during pregnancy improves health outcomes for both mothers and their babies.
孕期获得可靠的医疗服务，有助于改善母亲和婴儿的健康状况。
pregnancy.t: during pregnancy意为孕期；形容词是pregnant。

e: My cousin is pregnant and expects her baby in June.
我表姐怀孕了，预产期在六月。
Accessible healthcare helps pregnant women receive regular check-ups and reliable advice throughout their pregnancy.
便捷可及的医疗服务有助于孕妇在整个孕期获得定期检查和可靠的建议。
pregnant.t: 表示怀孕多久可说six months pregnant。

e: Her neighbours welcomed her warmly, without any prejudice.
邻居们热情地欢迎她，没有任何偏见。
Schools can challenge prejudice by encouraging students to learn about cultures different from their own.
学校可以鼓励学生了解不同于自身的文化，从而消除偏见。
prejudice.t: 表示对某群体的偏见，常用prejudice against。

e: Our short walk was a prelude to a lovely picnic.
我们先散了会儿步，随后享受了一次愉快的野餐。
Investment in reliable internet infrastructure is often a prelude to broader economic development in rural regions.
投资建设可靠的互联网基础设施，往往是农村地区实现更广泛经济发展的序幕。
prelude.t: 常用a prelude to，to后接名词或动名词。

e: Our celebration was premature; the match wasn't over yet.
我们庆祝得太早了，比赛还没结束。
It would be premature to conclude that the policy has succeeded without examining its long-term effects.
在考察这项政策的长期影响之前，就断定它已取得成功，为时尚早。
The premier visited our village after the river flooded.
河水泛滥后，总理到我们村视察。
The premier announced new measures to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
总理宣布了新措施，以改善快速发展城市中居民获得可负担住房的机会。
premier.t: premier可指政府首脑；premiere指首映或首演。

e: Your plan rests on the premise that everyone agrees.
你的计划建立在所有人都同意这一前提上。
The policy is based on the premise that affordable education improves both individual prospects and national productivity.
这项政策的前提是，负担得起的教育能改善个人前景并提高国家生产力。
premise.t: 表示房屋及场地时用复数premises。

e: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。
Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。
preparation.t: 泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。

e: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。
Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。
prepare.t: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

e: Our teacher used a toy rabbit to explain each preposition.
老师用一只玩具兔来解释每个介词。
Choosing the correct preposition helps language learners express relationships between ideas more precisely in academic writing.
选择正确的介词有助于语言学习者在学术写作中更准确地表达观点之间的关系。
preposition.t: 介词后通常接名词、代词或动名词。

e: The doctor prescribed eye drops for my sore eyes.
医生给我开了眼药水，治疗眼睛疼痛。
Doctors should prescribe antibiotics only when necessary to reduce the risk of bacteria developing resistance.
医生应仅在必要时开抗生素，以降低细菌产生耐药性的风险。
prescribe.t: prescribe是开药；describe是描述，注意区分。

e: The doctor gave me a prescription for eye drops.
医生给我开了眼药水的处方。
Requiring a prescription for certain medicines can reduce misuse and protect public health.
要求某些药物凭处方购买，可以减少滥用并保护公众健康。
prescription.t: 处方用for引出药物；on prescription指凭处方。

e: Her presence at the concert made her daughter smile.
她来到音乐会现场，女儿见了露出笑容。
The presence of green spaces in urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' physical and mental health.
城市社区中的绿地可以改善居民的身心健康。
presence.t: in someone's presence指当着某人的面。

e: All the children were present for the class photo.
拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。
Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。
present.t: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

e: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。
Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。
presentation.t: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。

e: We preserve old family photographs in a special album.
我们把家里的老照片保存在一本专用相册里。
Local authorities should preserve historic buildings while adapting them to meet the needs of modern communities.
地方政府应保护历史建筑，同时改造它们以满足现代社区的需求。
preserve.t: preserve强调保持原状；保藏食物也用它。

e: Our club elected Nina to preside over the next meeting.
我们俱乐部推选妮娜主持下一次会议。
An independent expert should preside over the public hearing to ensure that all participants receive fair treatment.
公开听证会应由独立专家主持，以确保所有参与者都得到公平对待。
preside.t: 不直接接会议等宾语，通常用preside over。

e: The president waved to the crowd outside the palace.
总统向宫殿外的人群挥手致意。
The newly elected president promised to improve public healthcare and expand access to affordable education.
新当选的总统承诺改善公共医疗，并扩大可负担教育的覆盖范围。
president.t: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。

e: Press this button to open the garage door.
按这个按钮就能打开车库门。
A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。
press.t: 表示新闻界通常用the press；按按钮不用push down。

e: I feel pressure to answer work messages immediately.
我觉得自己必须立即回复工作消息，这让我有压力。
Employers should avoid putting excessive pressure on staff, as this can damage both health and productivity.
雇主应避免给员工施加过大压力，因为这既可能损害健康，也可能降低生产力。
pressure.t: under pressure表示承压；动词常接into doing。

e: Winning the award brought considerable prestige to her small bakery.
获奖为她的小面包店带来了很高的声誉。
Some students choose universities for their international prestige rather than the suitability of individual courses.
一些学生选择大学看重的是其国际声望，而非具体课程是否适合自己。
Her coat is gone, so presumably she has left.
她的外套不见了，想必她已经离开了。
More frequent bus services would presumably encourage commuters to leave their cars at home, reducing urban traffic.
更频繁的公交班次想必会鼓励通勤者不开车出门，从而缓解城市交通拥堵。
presumably.t: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

e: The children pretended the sofa was a pirate ship.
孩子们把沙发想象成一艘海盗船。
Children who pretend to be different characters can develop empathy by exploring unfamiliar perspectives through play.
孩子们在游戏中扮演不同角色、体验陌生视角，可以培养同理心。
pretend.t: 常用pretend to do或pretend that，不用pretend doing。

e: The café felt pretentious, with velvet chairs and tiny portions.
这家咖啡馆摆着天鹅绒椅子，食物分量却很小，让人觉得装腔作势。
Public art may alienate local residents if its presentation seems pretentious rather than welcoming and accessible.
如果公共艺术的呈现方式显得故作高深，而非亲切易懂，就可能疏远当地居民。
pretentious.t: 贬义：刻意显得高雅或重要，不只是有自信。

e: He used a headache as a pretext to leave.
他以头痛为借口离开了。
Companies should not use economic uncertainty as a pretext for abandoning their environmental commitments.
企业不应以经济不确定性为借口，放弃其环保承诺。
pretext.t: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。

e: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。
Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。
pretty.t: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

e: A relaxed atmosphere prevails in our kitchen on Sundays.
每逢星期日，我们的厨房里总洋溢着轻松的气氛。
Where traditional attitudes prevail, public education campaigns may be needed to encourage more equal opportunities for women.
在传统观念盛行的地方，可能需要开展公众教育活动，为女性争取更平等的机会。
prevail.t: 获胜用prevail over；说服用prevail upon sb to do。

e: The prevailing mood at dinner was one of relief.
晚餐时，大家普遍都松了一口气。
The prevailing view among urban planners is that reliable public transport can reduce dependence on private cars.
城市规划者普遍认为，可靠的公共交通能减少人们对私家车的依赖。
prevailing.t: 常置于名词前；prevailing wind指盛行风。

e: This tight lid will prevent the soup from spilling.
这个严实的盖子能防止汤洒出来。
Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.
投资早期健康教育有助于预防慢性病，并减轻公共医疗服务未来的压力。
prevent.t: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

e: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
上一位租客在阳台上留下了几盆植物。
Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。
previous.t: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

e: The owl watched its prey from a low branch.
猫头鹰从一根低矮的树枝上注视着猎物。
When natural prey becomes scarce, some predators move closer to farms in search of food.
当天然猎物稀缺时，一些捕食者会靠近农场寻找食物。
prey.t: 名词通常不可数；动词常用prey on；勿混pray。

e: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。
Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。
price.t: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

e: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
她展示画作时，脸上洋溢着自豪。
Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.
学校可以鼓励学生参与改善当地环境的项目，从而培养社区自豪感。
pride.t: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。

e: The priest welcomed everyone as they entered the church.
大家走进教堂时，神父向每个人表示欢迎。
In many communities, a priest provides emotional support and helps organise assistance for families in need.
在许多社区，神父提供情感支持，并帮助为困难家庭组织援助。
priest.t: 并非所有宗教人士都称priest；僧侣通常称monk。

e: I use my tablet primarily for reading books.
我的平板电脑主要用来看书。
Public transport policies should focus primarily on improving reliability rather than simply reducing ticket prices.
公共交通政策应主要着眼于提高可靠性，而非仅仅降低票价。
primarily.t: 通常表示“主要”，不是表示先后顺序的“首先”。

e: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。
Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.
投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。
The guide pointed to a primate swinging between branches.
导游指着一只在树枝间荡来荡去的灵长类动物。
Protecting tropical forests is essential for the survival of many primate species threatened by habitat loss.
保护热带森林对许多因栖息地丧失而受到威胁的灵长类物种的生存至关重要。
primate.t: 包括人、猿和猴；并非只指猴子。

e: Our prime concern is getting everyone home safely tonight.
我们最关心的是今晚让所有人安全到家。
Reliable public transport is a prime requirement for cities seeking to reduce dependence on private cars.
对于希望减少私家车依赖的城市而言，可靠的公共交通是一项首要需求。
prime.t: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一个例子。

e: The campsite had only a primitive outdoor cooking area.
营地只有一个简陋的户外烹饪区。
Although these tools appear primitive, they reveal considerable skill in selecting and shaping locally available materials.
尽管这些工具看起来粗糙，却体现了选择和加工当地材料的高超技艺。
primitive.t: 形容设施可指简陋；用于当代民族或文化可能含贬义。

e: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
王子在宫殿阳台上向来访者挥手。
In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.
在一些君主立宪制国家，王子可能支持慈善组织，但不掌握任何直接的政治权力。
prince.t: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。

e: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
公主从马车里向人群挥手。
Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。
princess.t: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

e: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
我们搬家的主要原因是交通噪声太大。
The principal challenge facing urban planners is providing affordable housing without reducing access to green spaces.
城市规划者面临的主要挑战是提供经济适用的住房，同时不减少居民享用绿地的机会。
principal.t: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

e: I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.
出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。
The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.
旨在改善高等教育入学机会的政策应以机会平等原则为指导。
principle.t: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。

e: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？
Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。
print.t: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

e: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。
Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。
printer.t: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

e: You need prior permission to use this room.
你需要事先获得许可才能使用这个房间。
Applicants with prior experience in community work may adapt more quickly to roles in public services.
有社区工作经验的申请者可能更快适应公共服务岗位。
prior.t: prior常放名词前；prior to相当于before。

e: Finding a warm home is our main priority now.
找到一个温暖的家是我们现在的首要任务。
Governments should give priority to preventive healthcare rather than focus exclusively on treating existing illnesses.
政府应优先重视预防性医疗，而不是只关注治疗已有疾病。
priority.t: give priority to后接优先考虑的事物。

e: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。
Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。
prison.t: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

e: The prisoner borrowed a novel from the prison library.
那名囚犯从监狱图书馆借了一本小说。
Providing prisoners with education and vocational training may improve their chances of finding employment after release.
为囚犯提供教育和职业培训，可能提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。
prisoner.t: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。

e: Please knock before entering; everyone needs a little privacy.
进门前请敲门；每个人都需要一点私人空间。
Governments should protect individual privacy while allowing researchers to use anonymous data for public health studies.
政府应保护个人隐私，同时允许研究人员使用匿名数据开展公共卫生研究。
privacy.t: 通常不可数；英美发音首音节差异明显。

e: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。
Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。
private.t: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

e: Having the whole garden to myself felt like a privilege.
能独自享用整个花园，感觉像是获得了特殊待遇。
Access to quality education should be a universal right rather than a privilege reserved for wealthy families.
获得优质教育应是人人享有的权利，而不是富裕家庭独享的特权。
privilege.t: 表示荣幸常用have the privilege of doing。

e: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。
Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。
prize.t: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

e: Dark clouds suggest a high probability of rain tonight.
乌云表明今晚下雨的可能性很大。
Improved weather models allow scientists to estimate the probability of extreme rainfall with greater accuracy.
改进后的天气模型使科学家能够更准确地估算极端降雨的概率。
probability.t: 常接of加名词或动名词；也可接that从句。

e: The mechanic explained the probable cause of the noise.
机修工解释了噪声最可能的原因。
Given current population trends, it is probable that demand for affordable housing will continue to rise.
考虑到目前的人口趋势，对可负担住房的需求很可能会继续增长。
probable.t: 常用it is probable that；不用某人is probable to do。

e: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。
probably.t: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

e: The electrician probed behind the wall for damaged wires.
电工探查墙后是否有损坏的电线。
Independent investigators should probe the causes of industrial accidents to prevent similar incidents in the future.
独立调查人员应深入调查工业事故的原因，以防今后发生类似事件。
probe.t: 动词可直接接调查对象，也可用probe into。

e: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。
Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。
problem.t: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

e: The receptionist explained the procedure for joining the gym.
接待员说明了办理健身房会员的手续。
Every laboratory should establish a clear procedure for handling chemicals safely and disposing of waste responsibly.
每个实验室都应制定明确规程，以安全处理化学品并妥善处置废物。
procedure.t: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

e: We can proceed with dinner once everyone arrives.
等大家都到了，我们就可以继续安排晚餐了。
Local authorities should consult residents before they proceed with major changes to public transport.
地方政府在继续推进公共交通重大调整前，应征询居民意见。
proceed.t: proceed是动词；表示收入的名词是proceeds。

e: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。
The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。
process.t: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

e: These apples are ready for processing into juice.
这些苹果已准备好加工成果汁。
Modern food processing can extend shelf life, although some methods reduce the nutritional value of fresh ingredients.
现代食品加工可以延长保质期，不过某些方法会降低新鲜食材的营养价值。
processing.t: 通常为不可数名词；processing plant指加工厂。

e: Our garden produces enough tomatoes for the whole family.
我们菜园里种出的番茄够全家吃。
Investing in renewable energy can produce long-term benefits for both local communities and the environment.
投资可再生能源可以为当地社区和环境带来长期益处。
produce.t: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。

e: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。
Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。
product.t: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

e: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。
Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。
production.t: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

e: I had a productive morning and finished my report.
我上午效率很高，完成了报告。
Flexible working arrangements can help employees remain productive while balancing professional responsibilities with family commitments.
灵活的工作安排可以帮助员工兼顾工作职责和家庭义务，同时保持高效。
productive.t: 形容工作或讨论有成果；产量或效率用productivity。

e: My cousins profess to love cooking but always order takeaway.
我的表亲们声称喜欢做饭，却总是点外卖。
Many companies profess a commitment to sustainability, yet their production methods continue to generate substantial waste.
许多企业宣称致力于可持续发展，但其生产方式仍不断产生大量废物。
profess.t: 正式用语；profess to do常暗示声称未必属实。

e: Nursing is a demanding profession, but my sister loves it.
护理是个要求很高的职业，但我姐姐很喜欢。
The teaching profession needs greater public support to attract talented graduates and retain experienced staff.
教师行业需要更多公众支持，以吸引优秀毕业生并留住经验丰富的教师。
profession.t: profession通常指需专门训练的职业，比job范围窄。

e: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
我们为婚礼聘请了一位专业摄影师。
Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
持续的专业发展帮助教师调整教学方法，以适应学生需求的变化和新的教育技术。
professional.t: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

e: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
我们的教授今天带了古钱币来上课。
The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。
professor.t: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

e: Her proficiency in French helped us order dinner easily.
她熟练掌握法语，让我们轻松点好了晚餐。
Universities often require evidence of English proficiency to ensure students can participate fully in academic discussions.
大学通常要求提供英语能力证明，以确保学生能够充分参与学术讨论。
proficiency.t: 常用proficiency in接语言、学科或技能。

e: After months of practice, she became proficient at sewing.
经过几个月的练习，她的缝纫技术变得很熟练。
Graduates who are proficient in a second language may have better access to international employment opportunities.
熟练掌握第二语言的毕业生可能更容易获得国际就业机会。
proficient.t: 常用proficient in某领域或at某项活动。

e: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
她用软铅笔画出了祖父的侧面轮廓。
Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
公共展览能提高当地艺术家的知名度，并吸引游客前往小城镇。
profile.t: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。

e: The bakery made a small profit this month.
这家面包店这个月赚了一点钱。
Companies should invest part of their profit in cleaner technology to reduce environmental damage.
企业应将部分利润投入更清洁的技术，以减少环境损害。
profit.t: profit是扣除成本后的利润，不等于收入revenue。

e: Meeting my childhood teacher filled me with profound gratitude.
见到儿时的老师让我心中充满了深深的感激。
Access to reliable internet has had a profound impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
可靠的互联网接入对偏远社区的教育机会产生了深远影响。
This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。
Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。
program.t: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

e: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。
A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。
programme.t: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

e: You have made real progress with your swimming.
你的游泳水平确实有了进步。
Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.
定期反馈有助于学生了解自己的进步，并找出需要进一步练习的方面。
progress.t: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。

e: Our new manager has progressive ideas about flexible working.
我们的新经理对弹性工作有进步的想法。
Progressive education policies can promote equal opportunities by providing additional support for students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
进步的教育政策可以为弱势背景的学生提供额外支持，从而促进机会平等。
progressive.t: 既可指支持改革，也可指逐步发展，未必变好。

e: The pool rules prohibit running on the wet floor.
泳池规定禁止在湿滑的地面上奔跑。
Governments should prohibit the dumping of untreated industrial waste into rivers to protect public health.
政府应禁止将未经处理的工业废物倾倒入河，以保护公众健康。
prohibit.t: 用prohibit doing或prohibit sb from doing。

e: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。
Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。
project.t: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

e: My aunt is a prolific painter with two studios.
我姑姑是位多产的画家，拥有两间画室。
Prolific researchers can contribute substantially to scientific progress, but publication quantity should not outweigh quality.
成果丰硕的研究者能大力推动科学进步，但发表数量不应比质量更受重视。
prolific.t: 强调产出多，不等于作品质量一定高。

e: The gallery gave her painting prominence near the entrance.
画廊把她的画摆在入口附近的显眼位置。
Environmental issues have gained prominence in public debate as communities experience more frequent extreme weather events.
随着各地遭遇极端天气事件的频率上升，环境议题在公共讨论中日益受到关注。
prominence.t: 通常不可数；rise to prominence指崭露头角。

e: A prominent local artist opened the exhibition yesterday.
昨天，一位当地著名艺术家为展览揭幕。
Universities play a prominent role in developing technologies that support the transition to renewable energy.
大学在开发支持向可再生能源转型的技术方面发挥着重要作用。
prominent.t: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形显眼。

e: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。
Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。
Your first attempt looks promising; keep practising every day.
你的初次尝试看起来很有希望；坚持每天练习吧。
Solar energy offers a promising solution for remote communities that lack access to reliable electricity.
太阳能为缺乏可靠电力供应的偏远社区提供了一种前景可期的解决方案。
promising.t: 表示有成功的潜力，不等于已经成功。

e: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。
