A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。
sign.t: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

e: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。
Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。
signal.t: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

e: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
送货司机在门口请我签名。
Electronic signatures allow businesses to complete agreements remotely, reducing delays and the need for paper documents.
电子签名让企业能够远程签订协议，减少延误和纸质文件的使用。
signature.t: signature通常指签名；名人纪念签名常用autograph。

e: I finally understood the significance of her quiet smile.
我终于明白了她那淡淡微笑中的含义。
The discovery has considerable significance for scientists seeking cleaner and more affordable sources of energy.
这一发现对寻找更清洁、更经济能源的科学家具有重要意义。
significance.t: be of great significance相当于be very significant。

e: Moving closer to work made a significant difference to me.
搬到工作地点附近对我的生活产生了很大的影响。
Access to reliable internet services has a significant impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
能否获得可靠的互联网服务，对偏远社区的教育机会有重大影响。
significant.t: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。

e: These dark clouds usually signify that rain is coming.
这些乌云通常意味着快要下雨了。
Rising literacy rates may signify improvements in educational access, especially among previously disadvantaged communities.
识字率上升可能意味着受教育机会有所改善，尤其是在原本处于弱势的群体中。
signify.t: signify较正式，常接名词或that从句。

e: We stopped at the signpost beside the forest path.
我们在林间小路旁的路标处停了下来。
Writers should signpost changes in their argument so that readers can follow complex discussions more easily.
作者应提示论证中的转折，让读者更容易跟上复杂的讨论。
signpost.t: 写作中作动词，指用衔接表达提示论证结构。

e: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
外面下着雪，我们静静地坐着。
Extended periods of silence in classrooms can give students valuable time to reflect on difficult questions.
课堂上较长的安静时段可以给学生宝贵的时间来思考难题。
silence.t: in silence意为默默地；silent是形容词。

e: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。
Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。
silent.t: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

e: She wrapped a soft silk scarf around her neck.
她把一条柔软的丝巾围在脖子上。
Traditional silk production provides employment in rural communities while preserving skills passed down through generations.
传统丝绸生产为农村社区提供就业机会，同时保留了代代相传的技艺。
silk.t: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

e: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
把伞留在家里真是不明智。
Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。
silly.t: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

e: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
这把小勺子是纯银做的。
Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。
silver.t: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。

e: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。
Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。
similar.t: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

e: The twins dress similarly but have very different personalities.
这对双胞胎穿着相似，性格却很不一样。
Public libraries provide free access to information; similarly, community centres offer valuable opportunities for lifelong learning.
公共图书馆提供免费获取信息的渠道；同样，社区中心也为终身学习提供宝贵机会。
similarly.t: 句首Similarly常接逗号，用于引出相似情况。

e: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。
Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。
simple.t: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

e: I love the simplicity of this easy vegetable soup recipe.
我喜欢这份蔬菜汤食谱，做法特别简单。
The simplicity of a digital service can determine whether older users feel confident accessing essential information independently.
数字服务是否简便，可能决定老年用户是否有信心独立获取必要信息。
simplicity.t: simplicity通常不可数；simple的名词形式。

e: Could you simplify these instructions before I start cooking?
我开始做饭之前，你能把这些步骤说得简单些吗？
Governments should simplify application procedures so that small businesses can access financial support more easily.
政府应简化申请流程，让小企业更容易获得资金支持。
simplify.t: simplify强调减少复杂性；simple是形容词。

e: I simply want a quiet evening at home.
我只想在家安安静静地过个晚上。
Improving public health requires more than simply encouraging individuals to exercise; affordable facilities are also essential.
改善公共健康不仅仅需要鼓励个人锻炼；价格亲民的设施也必不可少。
simply.t: simply可表示“仅仅”，不一定表示“简单地”。

e: This driving game simulates icy roads surprisingly well.
这款驾驶游戏把结冰路面模拟得出奇逼真。
Researchers simulate extreme weather conditions to assess how new building materials perform under environmental stress.
研究人员模拟极端天气条件，以评估新型建筑材料在环境压力下的表现。
simulate.t: 模拟环境用simulate；刺激发展用stimulate。

e: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
街道两边同时爆发出欢呼声。
Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.
同时投资公共交通和自行车基础设施，比采取单一措施更能有效缓解交通拥堵。
simultaneous.t: 强调时间重合；副词simultaneously表示同时地。

e: He believed that lying to his friends was a sin.
他认为对朋友撒谎是一种罪过。
Ideas about sin can influence social attitudes, even in societies where religious participation is declining.
即使在宗教参与度下降的社会，对罪的观念也可能影响社会态度。
sin.t: 侧重宗教或道德上的罪，不等于法律上的crime。

e: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
我从小就住在这个街区。
Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。
since.t: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

e: Her sincere apology helped us become friends again.
她真诚的道歉让我们重新成为了朋友。
Sincere efforts to consult local residents can strengthen public trust in major urban development projects.
真诚征求当地居民意见的努力，可以增强公众对重大城市开发项目的信任。
sincere.t: sincere强调不虚假；sincerely常用于信件结尾。

e: I sincerely hope you feel better very soon.
我由衷地希望你很快好起来。
Organisations should listen sincerely to residents' concerns before introducing changes that affect the local community.
机构在推行影响当地社区的变革之前，应真诚倾听居民的关切。
sincerely.t: 英式书信称呼已知姓名者，结尾常用Yours sincerely。

e: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。
Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。
The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
观众开始鼓掌时，歌手露出了笑容。
Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.
当地节庆为年轻歌手提供了宝贵的公开演出机会，帮助他们建立对自身能力的信心。
singer.t: sing 的过去式、过去分词分别是 sang、sung。

e: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
停电时，房间里只有一支蜡烛照明。
No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.
如果不改善公共交通和地方规划，任何单一政策都无法解决城市拥堵。
single.t: 单程票英式常说single ticket，美式用one-way ticket。

e: The little toy boat sank beneath the bathwater.
那只小玩具船沉到了洗澡水下面。
Coastal communities face increasing risks as land sinks and sea levels rise because of climate change.
随着地面下沉以及气候变化导致的海平面上升，沿海社区面临日益严峻的风险。
Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。
In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。
sir.t: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

e: An ambulance siren woke me early this morning.
今天一大早，救护车的警报声把我吵醒了。
Emergency sirens can help coastal communities respond quickly when severe storms threaten their safety.
当强风暴威胁沿海社区的安全时，应急警报器能帮助居民迅速作出反应。
siren.t: 可指发声的警报器，也可指其发出的警报声。

e: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。
Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。
sister.t: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

e: My sister-in-law brought homemade soup when I was ill.
我生病时，嫂子送来了她自己做的汤。
Sharing childcare with a sister-in-law can help working parents balance professional responsibilities and family life.
与姑嫂分担育儿工作，可以帮助在职父母平衡工作责任与家庭生活。
sister-in-law.t: 指姻亲姐妹，不是继姐妹；复数sisters-in-law。

e: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。
Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。
sit.t: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

e: Workers put a fence around the building site.
工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。
The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。
site.t: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

e: Our hotel is situated beside a quiet mountain lake.
我们的酒店坐落在一处宁静的高山湖泊旁。
Schools situated near busy roads may need additional measures to protect pupils from air pollution.
位于繁忙道路附近的学校可能需要采取额外措施，保护学生免受空气污染的影响。
situated.t: 常用be situated in/near，描述位置，较正式。

e: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。
The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。
situation.t: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

e: We baked sixteen small cakes for the family picnic.
我们为家庭野餐烤了十六个小蛋糕。
In some countries, students can choose vocational training instead of continuing general education at the age of sixteen.
在一些国家，学生十六岁时可以选择职业培训，而不继续接受普通教育。
sixteen.t: 注意与sixty（六十）区分，sixteen词尾有/n/。

e: My grandfather turned sixty and celebrated with a picnic.
我爷爷满六十岁时，办了一次野餐来庆祝。
The survey found that sixty percent of respondents preferred reliable buses to additional parking spaces.
调查发现，百分之六十的受访者更希望公交服务可靠，而不是增加停车位。
sixty.t: sixty重音在首音节；sixteen通常重读末音节。

e: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。
Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。
size.t: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

e: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。
Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。
skate.t: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

e: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。
Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。
We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
Studying the skeleton of an ancient animal can reveal how it moved and adapted to its environment.
研究古代动物的骨骼可以揭示它的运动方式以及它如何适应环境。
skeleton.t: skeleton staff指维持运转所需的最少人员。

e: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。
Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。
ski.t: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

e: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。
Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。
skill.t: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

e: A skilled mechanic fixed my bicycle in minutes.
一位技术熟练的修车师傅几分钟就修好了我的自行车。
Investment in vocational education can help countries develop a skilled workforce and reduce unemployment.
投资职业教育可以帮助各国培养技术熟练的劳动力，并降低失业率。
skilled.t: skilled at/in后接名词或动名词。

e: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。
Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。
skin.t: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

e: I skipped breakfast because I woke up too late.
我起得太晚，所以没吃早餐。
Students who regularly skip classes may struggle to develop the knowledge required for more advanced courses.
经常缺课的学生可能难以掌握学习更高阶课程所需的知识。
Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。
Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。
The museum displayed the skull of a large dinosaur.
博物馆展出了一只大型恐龙的头骨。
Wearing a properly fitted helmet helps protect the skull and brain during cycling accidents.
骑行发生事故时，佩戴尺寸合适的头盔有助于保护颅骨和大脑。
skull.t: skull指头部骨骼，brain指内部的大脑。

e: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。
Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。
sky.t: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

e: The skyscraper cast a long shadow across the park.
那座摩天大楼在公园里投下了一道长长的影子。
Building skyscrapers can accommodate growing urban populations, but cities must also invest in reliable public transport.
建造摩天大楼可以容纳不断增长的城市人口，但城市也必须投资建设可靠的公共交通。
skyscraper.t: 比普通high-rise更强调极高的建筑。

e: The tent rope was slack after the heavy rain.
大雨过后，帐篷的绳子松了。
When demand is slack, manufacturers may reduce working hours rather than dismiss experienced employees immediately.
需求疲软时，制造商可能会缩短工作时间，而不是立即解雇有经验的员工。
slack.t: slack指松弛或懈怠；slacks是宽松长裤。

e: The wind slammed the window shut during breakfast.
吃早饭时，风把窗户砰地吹关了。
Environmental groups slammed the proposal because it would allow further construction in protected coastal areas.
环保组织猛烈抨击该提案，因为它将允许在受保护的沿海地区继续施工。
She slapped her knee and laughed at the joke.
她听了这个笑话，拍着膝盖笑了起来。
The coach slapped the player's back in celebration, highlighting the supportive atmosphere within the team.
教练拍了拍球员的背以示庆祝，体现了队内相互支持的氛围。
slap.t: 过去式和过去分词为slapped，须双写p。

e: The farmer explained why some animals are slaughtered for food.
农场主解释了为什么有些动物会被宰杀供人食用。
Strict regulations on how animals are slaughtered can improve welfare standards throughout the food production industry.
严格规范动物屠宰方式，可以提高整个食品生产行业的动物福利标准。
slaughter.t: 指宰杀动物或残酷杀戮，语气强；不用于普通死亡。

e: The museum tells the story of a slave who escaped.
这家博物馆讲述了一名奴隶逃离奴役的故事。
Studying the experiences of slaves helps students understand the human consequences of historical systems of exploitation.
研究奴隶的经历有助于学生理解历史上剥削制度给人带来的影响。
slave.t: 历史语境可用enslaved person，强调其人的身份。

e: We learned about slavery during our museum visit yesterday.
昨天参观博物馆时，我们了解了奴隶制度。
Although slavery has been legally abolished worldwide, forced labour remains a serious challenge for governments and international organisations.
尽管奴隶制度已在全球范围内被依法废除，强迫劳动仍是各国政府和国际组织面临的严峻挑战。
slavery.t: slavery为不可数名词；abolish slavery指废除奴隶制。

e: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。
Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
规律的睡眠有助于记忆和注意力，因此对备考学生尤其重要。
sleep.t: 过去式和过去分词均为slept；入睡用fall asleep。

e: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。
Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。
sleepy.t: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

e: I caught my sleeve on the kitchen door handle.
我的袖子被厨房门把手勾住了。
Workers should keep loose sleeves away from moving machinery to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
工人应让宽松的袖子远离运转中的机器，以降低工伤风险。
sleeve.t: sleeve指衣服的袖子，不是手臂arm。

e: A slender branch bent under the bird's weight.
一根细长的树枝被鸟的重量压弯了。
Small businesses often operate with slender profit margins, making them particularly vulnerable to rising energy costs.
小企业的利润率往往很低，因此尤其容易受到能源成本上涨的冲击。
slender.t: 形容身材常含赞美；也可形容机会、优势很小。

e: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。
Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。
slice.t: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。

e: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。
Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。
slide.t: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

e: There is a slight scratch on my new phone.
我的新手机上有一道轻微的划痕。
Even a slight increase in average temperatures can have significant consequences for fragile ecosystems worldwide.
即使平均气温仅略微上升，也可能给全球脆弱的生态系统带来重大影响。
slight.t: slight是形容词；修饰动词或比较级用slightly。

e: This slim lamp fits neatly on my small desk.
这盏细长的灯放在我的小书桌上正合适。
Without reliable public transport, there is only a slim chance that commuters will stop driving.
没有可靠的公共交通，通勤者放弃开车的可能性就很小。
slim.t: 形容身材多含褒义；slim chance指机会渺茫。

e: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
我在湿地板上滑了一下，但没有摔倒。
Hospitals should keep floors dry to reduce the risk of patients slipping and injuring themselves.
医院应保持地面干燥，以降低病人滑倒受伤的风险。
slip.t: 过去式和过去分词均为slipped，双写p。

e: I found my missing slipper underneath the sofa.
我在沙发下面找到了丢失的那只拖鞋。
Providing slippers in shared accommodation can improve comfort, although regular cleaning remains essential for good hygiene.
在合住场所提供拖鞋能提升舒适度，但保持良好卫生仍离不开定期清洁。
slipper.t: 通常用复数slippers；人字拖常叫flip-flops。

e: Sunlight came through a narrow slit in the curtains.
阳光透过窗帘间的一条狭缝照了进来。
A narrow slit in the laboratory screen allows researchers to observe how light behaves when passing through small openings.
实验室屏障上的一道狭缝让研究人员能够观察光穿过小开口时的表现。
slit.t: 动词过去式、过去分词均为slit；现在分词为slitting。

e: Our club chose a catchy slogan for its recycling campaign.
我们社团为回收利用活动选了一句朗朗上口的口号。
An effective environmental slogan can attract attention, but lasting behavioural change usually requires practical support.
有效的环保口号能够吸引注意，但持久的行为改变通常需要实际支持。
slogan.t: slogan用于宣传；motto多指座右铭或行为准则。

e: She pushed a coin into the narrow slot.
她把一枚硬币塞进了狭窄的投币口。
Offering evening appointment slots could help working adults access essential healthcare services more easily.
提供晚间预约时段可以让上班族更方便地获得基本医疗服务。
slot.t: slot作动词常搭配into；不表示“跟踪”。

e: We took a slow walk along the river.
我们沿着河边慢慢散步。
Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。
slow.t: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

e: I felt sluggish after eating such a large lunch.
午饭吃得太多，我感觉懒洋洋的。
Sluggish economic growth can discourage investment and limit employment opportunities for recent university graduates.
经济增长乏力会抑制投资，并限制大学应届毕业生的就业机会。
sluggish.t: 既形容人没精神，也形容经济或系统运转慢。

e: Their family shared a small room in a crowded slum.
他们一家挤住在拥挤贫民窟里的一间小屋中。
Improving sanitation and access to clean water can significantly reduce disease in densely populated slums.
改善卫生设施和清洁水源的获取条件，可以显著减少人口密集的贫民窟中的疾病。
slum.t: 指居住条件差的城区，不等于所有低收入社区。

e: The sly cat stole a biscuit while I turned away.
我一转身，那只狡猾的猫就偷走了一块饼干。
Sly attempts to hide additional charges can damage consumer trust and harm a company's reputation.
偷偷隐瞒额外费用的做法会损害消费者的信任，并伤及公司的声誉。
sly.t: on the sly是固定短语，意为偷偷地。

e: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。
Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。
small.t: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

e: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
用那个办法修好架子真聪明。
Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。
smart.t: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

e: The smell of fresh bread filled our kitchen.
新鲜面包的香味弥漫在我们的厨房里。
A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。
smell.t: smell作系动词后接形容词，如smell good。

e: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
我在房间另一头挥手时，宝宝笑了。
A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
友善的微笑能让患者在与医护人员讨论自己的顾虑时感到更自在。
smile.t: 对某人微笑用smile at，不用smile to。

e: Thick smog hid the hills beyond our apartment.
浓重的雾霾遮住了我们公寓远处的山丘。
Reducing vehicle emissions can help cities tackle smog and protect residents from respiratory diseases.
减少机动车排放有助于城市治理雾霾，保护居民免受呼吸系统疾病的侵害。
smog.t: 通常不可数；smog指污染性烟雾，不是普通雾。

e: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。
Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。
smoke.t: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

e: My uncle gave up smoking and now enjoys long walks.
我叔叔戒了烟，现在很喜欢长距离散步。
Banning smoking in public buildings can protect workers and visitors from the harmful effects of tobacco smoke.
禁止在公共建筑内吸烟可以保护工作人员和访客免受烟草烟雾的危害。
smoking.t: 表示吸烟活动时不可数；戒烟可用give up smoking。

e: This stone feels smooth and cool in my hand.
这块石头握在手里又光滑又凉。
Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。
smooth.t: 末尾th读浊音/ð/；smoothly常形容事情进展顺利。

e: Someone tried to smuggle rare birds through the airport.
有人试图通过机场偷运珍稀鸟类。
Stronger international cooperation is needed to stop criminal groups that smuggle endangered animals across national borders.
需要加强国际合作，以阻止跨境走私濒危动物的犯罪团伙。
smuggle.t: 常用smuggle sth into/out of某地，表示偷运进出。

e: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。
Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。
snack.t: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

e: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。
Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。
snake.t: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

e: The dry twig snapped when I stepped on it.
我踩到那根干树枝时，它啪的一声断了。
Under constant workplace pressure, employees may snap at colleagues, damaging cooperation and reducing overall team productivity.
在持续的工作压力下，员工可能会对同事厉声说话，损害合作并降低团队整体效率。
snap.t: snap at someone常指厉声说话，也可指猛咬某人。

e: I sneaked downstairs for water while everyone was asleep.
大家都睡着时，我悄悄下楼去喝水。
Some students sneak phones into examinations, highlighting the need for clearer rules and stronger supervision.
一些学生把手机偷偷带进考场，凸显了制定更明确规则和加强监督的必要性。
sneak.t: 过去式常用sneaked；美式英语也常用snuck。

e: One sneaker was hiding under the kitchen chair.
一只运动鞋藏在厨房的椅子下面。
A well-designed sneaker can provide support during exercise, although suitable footwear varies according to the activity.
设计良好的运动鞋能在锻炼时提供支撑，但适合的鞋类因运动项目而异。
sneaker.t: 美式常用 sneakers，英式通常说 trainers。

e: Dust from the old rug made me sneeze.
旧地毯扬起的灰尘让我打了喷嚏。
Covering your mouth and nose when you sneeze helps reduce the spread of respiratory infections.
打喷嚏时遮住口鼻有助于减少呼吸道感染的传播。
sneeze.t: 动词不及物；“打一个喷嚏”可说give a sneeze。

e: The puppy sniffed my shoes before letting me inside.
小狗嗅了嗅我的鞋，才让我进去。
Trained dogs can sniff out certain substances, making them valuable partners in wildlife conservation projects.
经过训练的狗能嗅出某些物质，因此是野生动物保护项目中的宝贵伙伴。
sniff.t: sniff at可表示轻视；sniff out表示嗅出或查出。

e: Her snobbish neighbour refused to visit our small flat.
她那势利的邻居不肯来我们的小公寓做客。
Snobbish attitudes towards vocational training can discourage young people from pursuing valuable practical careers.
对职业培训的轻视态度可能使年轻人不愿从事有价值的技能型职业。
snobbish.t: 重在因身份或品味而看低别人，不一定谄媚。

e: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。
Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。
snow.t: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

e: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that snowy afternoon.
那个下雪的下午，我们待在屋里烤面包。
In snowy regions, reliable public transport requires regular road maintenance and vehicles designed for winter conditions.
在多雪地区，可靠的公共交通需要定期道路养护和适合冬季路况的车辆。
snowy.t: snowy可描述天气，也可指地面等被雪覆盖。

e: The soup was so hot that I had to wait.
汤太烫了，我只好等一会儿。
Public transport is limited in rural areas, so many residents rely on private cars for essential journeys.
农村地区的公共交通有限，因此许多居民依靠私家车进行必要的出行。
so.t: so修饰形容词或副词；such通常修饰名词短语。

e: This so-called waterproof jacket let the rain straight through.
这件号称防水的夹克竟让雨水直接渗了进来。
Consumers should examine whether so-called green products actually reduce environmental harm throughout their life cycle.
消费者应审视所谓的绿色产品是否确实在整个生命周期内减少环境危害。
so-called.t: 置于名词前，常含质疑，但也可中性引出名称。

e: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
午饭前请用肥皂洗手。
Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。
soap.t: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

e: Electricity bills soared during the unusually cold winter.
在那个异常寒冷的冬天，电费猛涨。
Housing prices may soar when population growth exceeds the supply of affordable homes in major cities.
当人口增长超过大城市经济适用住房的供应能力时，房价可能飙升。
soar.t: 表示价格等猛涨时为不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

e: The child began to sob after losing her toy.
孩子丢了玩具后开始抽泣。
Children may sob when separated from caregivers, so schools should provide gentle support during transitions.
儿童与照顾者分开时可能会抽泣，因此学校应在适应阶段给予温和的支持。
My uncle stayed sober and drove everyone home safely.
我叔叔没有喝醉，开车把大家安全送回了家。
A sober assessment of environmental risks is essential before governments approve major construction projects.
政府批准大型建设项目之前，必须冷静评估环境风险。
sober.t: sober up表示醒酒；sober也可形容冷静的判断。

e: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。
soccer.t: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

e: My sociable neighbour invites everyone over for tea.
我那位爱交际的邻居邀请大家去喝茶。
Shared spaces can encourage residents to become more sociable and develop stronger relationships with their neighbours.
公共空间可以鼓励居民更多地与人交往，并与邻居建立更紧密的关系。
sociable.t: sociable指爱交际；social多指社会或社交的。

e: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
我的新工作让我几乎没时间参加社交活动。
Affordable housing policies can reduce social inequality by helping families access safe homes near essential services.
可负担住房政策帮助家庭在基本服务设施附近获得安全住所，从而减少社会不平等。
social.t: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

e: Our history teacher explained socialism during today's lively class discussion.
在今天热烈的课堂讨论中，我们的历史老师讲解了社会主义。
Debates about socialism often focus on public ownership, economic equality, and the appropriate role of government.
关于社会主义的讨论往往聚焦于公有制、经济平等以及政府应发挥的作用。
socialism.t: 通常为不可数名词；socialist可指社会主义者。

e: Our reading group discussed socialist ideas over tea.
我们读书小组边喝茶边讨论社会主义思想。
Socialist policies often seek to reduce economic inequality through public ownership and the redistribution of wealth.
社会主义政策通常力图通过公有制和财富再分配来减少经济不平等。
socialist.t: socialist指社会主义的；social仅指社会的或社交的。

e: Everyone has a part to play in society.
每个人都能在社会中发挥作用。
An ageing society requires accessible healthcare and policies that support older people's independence.
老龄化社会需要便捷可及的医疗服务，以及支持老年人独立生活的政策。
society.t: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。

e: One blue sock was hiding under the bed.
一只蓝袜子藏在床底下。
Choosing durable socks made from recycled materials can help consumers reduce clothing waste over time.
选择用再生材料制作的耐穿袜子，有助于消费者逐渐减少衣物浪费。
sock.t: 一双袜子说a pair of socks，sock为可数名词。

e: I spilled orange soda all over the kitchen floor.
我把橙味汽水洒得厨房地板上到处都是。
Replacing sugary soda with water can help reduce daily sugar intake and support better dental health.
用水代替含糖汽水有助于减少每日糖摄入，并改善牙齿健康。
soda.t: 美式常指汽水；baking soda才是小苏打。

e: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。
A comfortable sofa in a shared lounge can encourage residents to spend more time together.
公共休息室里一张舒适的沙发可以鼓励住户多聚在一起。
sofa.t: 坐在沙发上用on the sofa，不用in。

e: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。
Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。
soft.t: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

e: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
这个软件帮助我在笔记本电脑上编辑照片。
Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.
学校需要可靠的软件和充分的教师培训，才能有效利用数字学习工具。
software.t: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。

e: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
她往花盆里填了土，然后种下种子。
Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.
集约化农业可能损害土壤质量，逐渐降低土地种植作物的能力。
soil.t: 土壤一般不可数；不同土质可用复数soils。

e: We wore special protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.
我们戴着专用防护眼镜观看日食。
Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.
投资太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并为农村社区创造就业机会。
solar.t: solar是形容词，常用于太阳或太阳能相关搭配。

e: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。
Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。
soldier.t: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

e: She is the sole owner of this little bakery.
她是这家小面包店的唯一所有者。
Economic growth should not be the sole measure of a country's progress or public wellbeing.
经济增长不应成为衡量国家进步或公众福祉的唯一标准。
sole.t: 表示“唯一的”时通常放名词前；与 soul 同音。

e: The lake froze solid during the bitterly cold night.
在那个严寒的夜晚，湖面完全冻住了。
Governments need solid evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.
政府在出台可能显著影响公共卫生和家庭开支的政策前，需要可靠的证据。
solid.t: solid作名词指固体；solid evidence表示可靠证据。

e: Neighbours showed solidarity by repairing the damaged playground together.
邻居们一起修复受损的游乐场，体现了团结精神。
Community projects can strengthen social solidarity by bringing residents from different backgrounds together to solve shared problems.
社区项目能让不同背景的居民共同解决问题，从而增强社会凝聚力。
solidarity.t: 常接with，表示与某人或群体团结一致。

e: Leave the melted chocolate to solidify before adding decorations.
等融化的巧克力凝固后再加装饰。
Joint research projects can solidify partnerships between universities and encourage the exchange of specialist knowledge.
联合研究项目能巩固大学之间的合作关系，并促进专业知识的交流。
solidify.t: 既可指液体凝固，也可指关系或地位得到巩固。

e: A solitary walker followed the quiet path through the woods.
一位独行者沿着林间幽静的小路前行。
While solitary study allows deep concentration, collaborative learning helps students develop communication skills and consider alternative perspectives.
独自学习有助于专注，而合作学习能帮助学生培养沟通能力并考虑不同观点。
solitary.t: solitary强调独自，不一定像lonely那样感到寂寞。

e: Everyone fell silent when she began her violin solo.
她开始小提琴独奏时，所有人都安静了下来。
Solo travel can encourage independence by requiring individuals to manage unfamiliar situations without relying on companions.
独自旅行要求人们不依赖同伴处理陌生情况，因此有助于培养独立性。
solo.t: 可作名词、形容词和副词；独奏者用soloist。

e: These soluble tablets disappear quickly in a glass of water.
这些可溶片在一杯水中很快就溶解了。
Water-soluble pollutants can spread through rivers, making contamination difficult to contain once it enters the water supply.
水溶性污染物可沿河流扩散，一旦进入供水系统，污染便难以控制。
soluble.t: 常用be soluble in；水溶性可写water-soluble。

e: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
再加一个架子是解决杂乱问题的简单办法。
Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
投资可再生能源为化石燃料造成的环境问题提供了长期解决方案。
solution.t: 表示“……的解决办法”用solution to，不用solution of。

e: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。
Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。
Careful budgeting kept our small shop solvent this year.
精打细算使我们的小店今年保持了偿债能力。
Businesses must remain solvent during economic downturns while continuing to meet their obligations to employees and suppliers.
经济低迷期间，企业必须保持偿债能力，同时继续履行对员工和供应商的义务。
solvent.t: 形容词指能偿债，不等于盈利；名词指溶剂。

e: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。
Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。
some.t: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

e: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。
Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.
如果学生知道有人会倾听而不评判他们，就更有可能寻求帮助。
somebody.t: 作主语时谓语用单数；回指常用they。

e: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。
Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
如果有信任的人可以倾听他们的困扰，学生求助时可能会更有信心。
someone.t: 作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。

e: There is something soft inside this little box.
这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。
Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。
something.t: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

e: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。
Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.
居家办公有时能提高效率，不过其益处取决于合适的设备和安静的环境。
sometimes.t: sometimes是有时；some time是一段时间。

e: I felt somewhat nervous before my first driving lesson.
第一次上驾驶课之前，我有点紧张。
Although online learning offers flexibility, its effectiveness remains somewhat dependent on students' motivation and access to technology.
尽管在线学习提供了灵活性，其效果仍在一定程度上取决于学生的积极性和技术使用条件。
somewhat.t: 比a bit正式，常用于缓和判断或语气。

e: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。
Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。
somewhere.t: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

e: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。
Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。
son.t: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

e: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。
Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。
soon.t: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

e: This sophisticated camera adjusts its settings automatically in low light.
这台先进的相机会在光线不足时自动调整设置。
Sophisticated monitoring systems allow researchers to detect small changes in air quality across densely populated cities.
先进的监测系统使研究人员能够发现人口密集城市中空气质量的细微变化。
sophisticated.t: 形容设备指精密先进；形容人可指见多识广。

e: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。
Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。
sore.t: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

e: She felt deep sorrow when her closest friend moved away.
最亲密的朋友搬走时，她感到深深的悲伤。
Community support can help people cope with sorrow after the loss of a loved one.
社区支持可以帮助人们应对失去亲人后的悲痛。
sorrow.t: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。

e: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。
Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
尽管企业可能对环境破坏表示歉意，但恢复公众信任需要切实行动。
sorry.t: sorry for doing表示为所做之事道歉。

e: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
你在家听哪种音乐？
Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。
sort.t: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

e: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
在海边散步似乎总能抚慰我的心灵。
Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.
许多文化传统认为，灵魂在肉体死亡后仍然存在。
soul.t: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

e: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。
Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。
sound.t: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

e: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。
soup.t: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

e: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。
Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。
sour.t: go sour可指食物变质，也可指关系变坏。

e: We followed the stream uphill to find its source.
我们沿着小溪向山上走，寻找它的源头。
Researchers should compare several independent sources before drawing conclusions about the effects of social media.
研究人员在对社交媒体的影响下结论之前，应比较多个独立的资料来源。
source.t: 来源常用source of；作动词可用source…from…。

e: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。
Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。
south.t: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

e: Our kitchen window faces southeast and catches the morning sun.
我们厨房的窗户朝东南，早晨能照到阳光。
Population growth in the southeast has increased demand for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
东南部的人口增长增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。
southeast.t: 名词前常用the；副词不用：head southeast。

e: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
我们花了一周探索这座岛的南部海岸。
Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.
随着气温升高加大供水压力，该国南部地区可能面临更持久的干旱。
Our village lies southwest of the nearest town.
我们的村庄位于最近那座城镇的西南方。
The southwest of the country attracts visitors because of its mild climate and varied coastal landscapes.
该国西南部因气候温和、海岸景观多样而吸引游客。
We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。
Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。
souvenir.t: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

e: We sowed carrot seeds in the garden this morning.
今天早上，我们在花园里播下了胡萝卜种子。
Misleading online reports can sow distrust among communities and weaken confidence in public institutions.
误导性的网络报道可能在社区间散布不信任，削弱公众对公共机构的信心。
There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。
Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。
space.t: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

e: We watched the spacecraft launch from our garden.
我们在花园里观看了航天器发射。
Unmanned spacecraft allow scientists to explore distant planets without putting human lives at risk.
无人航天器让科学家能够探索遥远的行星，而不危及人的生命。
The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。
Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.
设计用于长途航行的宇宙飞船需要周密规划，以保护宇航员免受辐射和孤独的影响。
spaceship.t: spaceship可数；spacecraft的单复数形式相同。

e: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
她先用叉子卷起意大利细面，再吃了一口。
Simple meals such as spaghetti with vegetables can help students eat affordably while maintaining a balanced diet.
蔬菜意大利面等简单餐食，可以帮助学生在节省开支的同时保持均衡饮食。
spaghetti.t: 不可数名词；一盘用a plate of spaghetti。

e: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了西班牙。
Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.
西班牙凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和完善的旅游基础设施吸引国际游客。
spain.t: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

e: Our dog has a surprisingly short attention span.
我们家狗狗能集中注意力的时间短得出奇。
The research project will span several decades, allowing scientists to track long-term changes in coastal ecosystems.
该研究项目将持续数十年，使科学家能够追踪沿海生态系统的长期变化。
span.t: span作动词直接接时间或范围，无需加介词。

e: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
晚饭后我和邻居一起练习西班牙语。
Learning Spanish can broaden students' access to literature and improve their opportunities for international employment.
学习西班牙语能拓宽学生接触文学作品的渠道，并增加他们在国际就业市场上的机会。
spanish.t: 首字母大写；一个西班牙人可说a Spanish person。

e: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
我在车里放了一把备用伞。
People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。
spare.t: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。

e: A tiny spark flew out of the fireplace.
壁炉里飞出了一颗小火星。
Investment in public libraries can spark interest in reading and provide valuable learning opportunities for disadvantaged children.
对公共图书馆的投资可以激发阅读兴趣，并为弱势儿童提供宝贵的学习机会。
spark.t: 作动词可直接接interest、debate等，表示“引发”。

e: The tiny crystals sparkle whenever sunlight enters the room.
每当阳光照进房间，那些小水晶就闪闪发亮。
Although the river sparkles in the sunlight, regular testing is necessary to assess its water quality.
尽管河水在阳光下波光粼粼，仍需定期检测以评估水质。
sparkle.t: sparkle强调点点闪光；shine泛指发光。

e: A sparrow landed beside my cup on the balcony.
一只麻雀落在阳台上我的杯子旁边。
Urban gardens provide food and shelter for sparrows, helping maintain bird populations in densely populated areas.
城市花园为麻雀提供食物和栖息处，有助于维持人口密集地区的鸟类数量。
sparrow.t: 可数名词，复数直接加s；不泛指所有小鸟。

e: Building with blocks helps children develop their spatial awareness.
搭积木有助于孩子培养空间意识。
Urban planners examine the spatial distribution of housing to ensure residents can access essential services.
城市规划者研究住房的空间分布，以确保居民能获得基本服务。
spatial.t: spatial指空间关系；spacious指地方宽敞。

e: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
下课后我能和你谈谈吗？
Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。
speak.t: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

e: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。
Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。
speaker.t: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

e: An ancient spear stood behind glass in the museum.
博物馆的玻璃展柜里立着一支古代长矛。
The discovery of a wooden spear provides valuable evidence about the hunting techniques of early human communities.
一支木矛的发现为研究早期人类群体的狩猎技术提供了宝贵证据。
spear.t: spear是长矛，不是枪械；动词可指用叉子戳起食物。

e: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。
Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。
My doctor sent me to a skin specialist.
我的医生让我去看皮肤科专科医生。
Schools should employ a specialist to support children who have difficulties with language development.
学校应聘请专家，为语言发展有困难的儿童提供支持。
specialist.t: 名词后接in表示专长领域；形容词常修饰knowledge。

e: The bakery near our house specializes in fresh sourdough bread.
我们家附近的面包店专做新鲜的酸面包。
Students who specialize too early may miss opportunities to develop knowledge across a broader range of subjects.
过早确定专业方向的学生可能错过拓宽学科知识的机会。
specialize.t: 常用specialize in；英式也常拼作specialise。

e: Baking fruit pies has always been my grandmother's specialty.
烤水果派一直是我祖母的拿手活。
Choosing a medical specialty requires students to consider their interests alongside the healthcare needs of the wider population.
选择医学专科要求学生兼顾自身兴趣与广大民众的医疗需求。
Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
每年夏天都有几种蝴蝶来到我们的花园。
Protecting natural habitats is essential for preventing the extinction of species threatened by human activity.
保护自然栖息地对于防止受人类活动威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。
Is there a specific colour you would prefer?
你有没有特别想要的颜色？
Governments should set specific targets for reducing air pollution so that progress can be measured accurately.
政府应制定具体的空气污染减排目标，以便准确衡量进展。
I bought this small brush specifically for cleaning bottles.
我买这把小刷子是专门用来清洗瓶子的。
Public libraries should offer programmes specifically designed to help older adults develop essential digital skills.
公共图书馆应提供专为老年人设计的课程，帮助他们掌握必备的数字技能。
specifically.t: specifically for强调专门用途；更具体地说用more specifically。

e: Check the specifications before buying a new laptop.
买新笔记本电脑前，先查看规格参数。
Clear building specifications help ensure that new housing meets safety standards and uses energy efficiently.
明确的建筑技术要求有助于确保新住房符合安全标准并高效利用能源。
specification.t: 谈产品各项参数常用复数specifications，可简称specs。

e: Please specify which colour you want for the curtains.
请明确说明你想要哪种颜色的窗帘。
Governments should specify clear safety standards that all manufacturers must meet before selling products to consumers.
政府应明确规定所有制造商向消费者出售产品前必须达到的安全标准。
specify.t: 可接名词、that从句或疑问词引导的从句。

e: The museum keeps this butterfly specimen behind glass.
博物馆将这件蝴蝶标本保存在玻璃罩内。
Researchers examined each plant specimen to assess how prolonged drought had affected its growth.
研究人员检查了每份植物样本，以评估长期干旱对其生长的影响。
specimen.t: specimen多指供研究或检验的样本，不泛指任何例子。

e: We watched a spectacular sunset from the hilltop.
我们在山顶看了一场壮观的日落。
The region's spectacular mountain scenery attracts tourists, creating jobs but also increasing pressure on fragile ecosystems.
该地区壮观的山景吸引着游客，创造了就业机会，但也加重了脆弱生态系统的压力。
spectacular.t: 既可形容壮观景象，也可修饰growth等抽象名词。

e: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
一名观众在围栏附近接住了球。
Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
大型体育赛事吸引成千上万的观众，并能为当地商家带来可观收入。
spectator.t: 常指体育赛事现场观众；演出观众多用audience。

e: Our book club welcomes a wide spectrum of opinions.
我们的读书会欢迎各种不同的观点。
Universities should provide support for students across the entire spectrum of academic abilities and social backgrounds.
大学应为各种学业水平和社会背景的学生提供支持。
We can only speculate about what caused the delay.
我们只能猜测延误的原因。
Researchers speculate that changing work patterns could reduce traffic congestion in major urban centres.
研究人员推测，工作模式的改变可能缓解大城市中心的交通拥堵。
speculate.t: 推测常接about或that从句；投机领域用in。

e: The empty shop has sparked speculation among our neighbours.
那间空置店铺引发了邻居们的种种猜测。
Property speculation can drive housing prices beyond local incomes, making it harder for young adults to buy homes.
房地产投机可能推动房价涨至当地收入难以负担的水平，使年轻人更难买房。
speculation.t: 猜测内容常接about或that从句；也可指金融投机。

e: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。
In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。
speech.t: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

e: The train picked up speed as we left town.
我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。
Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。
speed.t: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

e: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？
A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。
spell.t: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。

e: My sister checks my spelling before I send emails.
我发邮件前，姐姐会帮我检查拼写。
Although digital tools can correct spelling, students still need to develop accurate writing skills.
虽然数字工具可以纠正拼写，学生仍需培养准确书写的能力。
spelling.t: 指拼写能力通常不可数；指具体拼法可数。

e: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。
Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。
She rolled the clay into a smooth sphere.
她把黏土揉成了一个光滑的球体。
Digital technology has expanded the sphere of education beyond classrooms, allowing students to learn almost anywhere.
数字技术将教育领域拓展到课堂之外，让学生几乎可以在任何地方学习。
A spherical lamp hung above the dining table.
餐桌上方挂着一盏球形灯。
Researchers use spherical particles of different sizes to investigate how pollutants move through water filtration systems.
研究人员使用大小不同的球形颗粒，研究污染物如何通过水过滤系统。
spherical.t: spherical指立体球形；circular指平面圆形。

e: This warming spice gives the soup a lovely flavour.
这种带来暖意的香料让汤的味道十分美妙。
The historical spice trade connected distant societies and encouraged the exchange of agricultural knowledge and cooking techniques.
历史上的香料贸易连接了遥远的社会，并促进了农业知识与烹饪技术的交流。
spice.t: spice不一定辣；spice up也可指增添趣味。

e: The noodles were too spicy, so I ordered rice.
面条太辣了，所以我点了米饭。
Traditional spicy dishes can attract visitors who want to experience the distinctive flavours of a region.
传统的辛辣菜肴能吸引想要体验当地独特风味的游客。
spicy.t: spicy指香料味浓或辣；hot也可指温度高。

e: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
一只小蜘蛛在我们窗边结了网。
Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.
虽然许多人害怕蜘蛛，但它们有助于控制花园和农业环境中的昆虫数量。
spider.t: 蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于六条腿的昆虫。

e: I spilled orange juice all over my clean shirt.
我把橙汁洒得干净衬衫上到处都是。
Oil spills can damage marine ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of communities that depend on fishing.
石油泄漏会破坏海洋生态系统，并威胁依赖捕鱼的社区的生计。
spill.t: 过去式和过去分词可用spilled或spilt。

e: The wheel kept spinning after I lifted the bicycle.
我把自行车抬起来后，车轮还在转。
News organisations should examine official claims carefully rather than simply repeat the political spin surrounding them.
新闻机构应仔细审视官方说法，而不是简单重复围绕这些说法的政治性包装。
spin.t: 过去式、过去分词均为 spun；现在分词为 spinning。

e: The orange peel fell in a spiral onto the plate.
橙子皮呈螺旋状落在盘子上。
Without adequate housing policies, rental costs may spiral beyond the reach of many low-income families.
如果缺乏适当的住房政策，租金可能急剧上涨，超出许多低收入家庭的承受范围。
spiral.t: 英式过去式spiralled；美式spiraled，双写规则不同。

e: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。
Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。
spirit.t: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

e: Walking quietly in the forest gives me spiritual comfort.
在森林里静静散步能给我心灵上的慰藉。
Public spaces can support spiritual well-being by offering residents peaceful places for reflection and connection with nature.
公共空间可以为居民提供安静思考和亲近自然的场所，从而促进精神健康。
spiritual.t: 可指心灵层面，不一定涉及宗教。

e: He spat the bitter seed into a tissue.
他把那颗苦涩的种子吐进了纸巾里。
Public health campaigns discourage people from spitting in shared spaces because this behaviour can contribute to disease transmission.
公共卫生宣传劝阻人们在公共场所吐痰，因为这种行为可能传播疾病。
spit.t: 过去式和过去分词英式常用spat，美式也用spit。

e: He hid his sister's favourite toy out of spite.
他出于恶意，把妹妹最喜欢的玩具藏了起来。
In spite of limited funding, the community centre continues to provide valuable support for local families.
尽管资金有限，社区中心仍继续为当地家庭提供宝贵的支持。
spite.t: in spite of后接名词或动名词，不直接接句子。

e: The dog splashed water all over my trousers.
那只狗把水溅得我裤子上到处都是。
Vehicles travelling through flooded streets can splash dirty water onto pedestrians and damage nearby shop displays.
车辆驶过积水街道时，可能把污水溅到行人身上，并损坏附近商店的陈列品。
splash.t: splash out on是英式口语，指大手笔花钱买某物。

e: We had a splendid picnic beside the lake yesterday.
我们昨天在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。
Restoring historic gardens gives urban residents a splendid opportunity to enjoy nature and learn about local heritage.
修复历史花园为城市居民提供了亲近自然、了解当地文化遗产的绝佳机会。
splendid.t: 既可赞事物极好，也可形容景色壮丽。

e: The nurse fitted a splint to my injured finger.
护士给我受伤的手指装上了夹板。
Using a splint to stabilise an injured limb can prevent further damage while patients await medical treatment.
在患者等待医疗救治时，用夹板固定受伤的肢体可以防止进一步损伤。
splint.t: 指固定伤处的夹板；不同于石膏固定用的cast。

e: We split the cake and shared it with our neighbours.
我们把蛋糕切开，分给了邻居。
Schools sometimes split large classes into smaller groups to provide more individual attention and support.
学校有时会把大班分成小组，以提供更多个别关注和支持。
split.t: 过去式和过去分词均为split；现在分词为splitting。

e: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。
Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
规划不当的建设会破坏自然景观，降低其对居民和游客的吸引力。
spoil.t: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

e: A spokesman explained why the swimming pool was closed.
一位男发言人解释了游泳池关闭的原因。
The government spokesman announced that additional funding would support public transport improvements in rural communities.
政府男发言人宣布，将追加资金支持农村地区的公共交通改善。
spokesman.t: 特指男性；不强调性别时用spokesperson。

e: Use a damp sponge to wipe the kitchen table.
用湿海绵擦一下厨房的桌子。
Urban wetlands act like a sponge, absorbing excess rainwater and reducing the risk of flooding.
城市湿地就像海绵，能吸收多余的雨水，降低洪涝风险。
sponge.t: 比喻吸收能力强时，常用like a sponge。

e: Our swimming club needs a sponsor for new equipment.
我们的游泳俱乐部需要赞助者资助购置新器材。
Local businesses can sponsor community sports programmes to improve public health and strengthen relationships with residents.
当地企业可以赞助社区体育项目，以改善公众健康并加强与居民的联系。
sponsor.t: sponsor可作名词或动词；赞助行为用sponsorship。

e: We made a spontaneous trip to the beach yesterday.
昨天我们临时起意，去了一趟海边。
Spontaneous conversations between colleagues can generate creative ideas that formal meetings sometimes fail to produce.
同事间自发的交谈可以激发创意，而正式会议有时反倒做不到。
spontaneous.t: 强调非预先安排，不等于“无意识的”。

e: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
她用木勺搅了搅汤。
Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。
spoon.t: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

e: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
她把一匙蜂蜜搅进茶里。
Adding several spoonfuls of sugar to drinks each day can substantially increase a person's daily calorie intake.
每天往饮料里加几匙糖，会显著增加一个人的每日热量摄入。
spoonful.t: 是名词而非形容词；复数通常为spoonfuls。

e: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。
Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。
sport.t: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

e: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
我叔叔年轻时非常热爱运动。
A successful sportsman can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop confidence through physical activity.
成功的男运动员可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼，并通过体育活动培养自信。
sportsman.t: 特指男性；不强调性别时可用athlete。

e: We found a shady spot beside the river.
我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。
Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
卫星图像帮助研究人员在大面积破坏发生之前发现森林覆盖的变化。
spot.t: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

e: Each employee can bring their spouse to dinner.
每位员工都可以带配偶参加晚宴。
Flexible working arrangements can help employees share childcare responsibilities more equally with their spouses.
灵活的工作安排有助于员工与配偶更平等地分担育儿责任。
spouse.t: 正式用语，指丈夫或妻子，不限定性别。

e: I sprained my ankle while running for the bus.
我跑着赶公交车时扭伤了脚踝。
Athletes who sprain a joint should allow sufficient recovery time before returning to competitive sport.
运动员扭伤关节后，应留出足够的恢复时间再重返竞技运动。
sprain.t: sprain指关节扭伤；strain常指肌肉或肌腱拉伤。

e: After the hike, we sprawled on the soft grass.
徒步结束后，我们四肢舒展地躺在柔软的草地上。
Urban sprawl can increase dependence on private cars and put pressure on surrounding farmland.
城市无序扩张会增加对私家车的依赖，并给周边农田带来压力。
sprawl.t: 人作主语常指摊坐或摊躺；urban sprawl指城市扩张。

e: She spread a blanket under the tree for our picnic.
她在树下铺了一条毯子，供我们野餐用。
The rapid spread of false information online highlights the importance of teaching critical reading skills in schools.
虚假信息在网上迅速传播，凸显了学校教授批判性阅读技能的重要性。
spread.t: 过去式和过去分词均为spread。

e: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
我们每年春天都在花园里种花。
Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。
spring.t: 季节前通常用in；泉和弹簧义均为可数名词。

e: Sprinkle some cinnamon over your porridge before eating.
吃燕麦粥前，在上面撒些肉桂粉。
Rather than adding excessive salt, consumers can sprinkle herbs over meals to enhance flavour more healthily.
消费者可以在饭菜上撒些香草，以更健康的方式增添风味，而不是加入过多盐。
sprinkle.t: 可说sprinkle A over B，也可说sprinkle B with A。

e: Her friend's encouragement spurred her to finish the race.
朋友的鼓励激励她跑完了比赛。
Investment in reliable public transport can spur economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
投资可靠的公共交通可以让劳动者接触到更多就业机会，从而促进经济增长。
spur.t: 常用spur sb to do；过去式spurred双写r。

e: I spied a tiny kitten hiding behind the flowerpot.
我瞥见一只小猫躲在花盆后面。
Many users worry that connected devices could spy on their activities without permission.
许多用户担心联网设备可能未经允许就暗中监视他们的活动。
spy.t: 监视某人用spy on；过去式和过去分词为spied。

e: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
先把纸折成正方形，再剪。
Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。
square.t: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

e: Don't squash the bread under those heavy shopping bags.
别把面包压在那些沉重的购物袋下面。
Playing squash regularly can improve cardiovascular fitness, although beginners should increase the intensity of exercise gradually.
经常打壁球可以增强心肺功能，不过初学者应逐步提高运动强度。
squash.t: 英式英语中还可指需加水稀释的浓缩果汁饮料。

e: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
一只松鼠在我们花园门旁埋了一颗坚果。
Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.
城市公园为松鼠提供食物和栖身之所，但投喂可能改变它们的自然行为。
squirrel.t: 作动词通常用squirrel away，指悄悄储存。

e: She squirted some lemon juice over the grilled fish.
她往烤鱼上挤了些柠檬汁。
Water-saving irrigation systems squirt small amounts of water directly onto roots, reducing waste in dry regions.
节水灌溉系统将少量水直接喷向根部，减少干旱地区的水资源浪费。
squirt.t: 常用squirt液体onto/into某处，强调细流喷出。

e: She stabbed a potato with her fork to test it.
她用叉子戳了戳土豆，看看熟了没有。
Many graduates feel a stab of anxiety when considering their employment prospects in an uncertain economy.
在经济形势不明朗时，许多毕业生想到自己的就业前景便会突然感到焦虑。
stab.t: have a stab at doing表示尝试做某事，较口语化。

e: These wider legs give the table much better stability.
这些更宽的桌腿让桌子稳固了许多。
Economic stability encourages businesses to invest in new projects and gives households greater confidence about their financial future.
经济稳定能鼓励企业投资新项目，也让家庭对未来的财务状况更有信心。
stability.t: 通常不可数；形容词为stable，反义词为instability。

e: We used a wooden block to stabilize the table.
我们用一块木块让桌子保持平稳。
Governments may need to stabilize food prices to protect vulnerable households during periods of economic uncertainty.
在经济不确定时期，政府可能需要稳定食品价格，以保护弱势家庭。
stabilize.t: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。

e: The table feels stable now that we tightened its legs.
我们把桌腿拧紧后，桌子现在感觉稳固了。
A stable income allows families to plan for future expenses and reduces their dependence on emergency financial assistance.
稳定的收入让家庭能够规划未来开支，并减少对紧急经济援助的依赖。
stable.t: 作形容词指稳定；作可数名词指马厩。

e: A stack of clean plates stood beside the sink.
水槽旁放着一摞干净的盘子。
Libraries increasingly store stacks of older journals off site to create more space for collaborative learning.
图书馆越来越多地将成摞的旧期刊存放在馆外，为协作学习腾出更多空间。
stack.t: stacks of表示“大量”，属非正式用法。

e: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。
Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。
stadium.t: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

e: The hotel staff helped us carry our heavy bags.
酒店的工作人员帮我们搬了沉重的行李。
Hospitals need sufficient staff to maintain high standards of care during periods of increased demand.
医院需要充足的人员，才能在需求上升期间保持高水平的护理服务。
staff.t: 单个员工用a member of staff，不说a staff。

e: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。
Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。
stage.t: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。

e: He staggered backwards as the heavy suitcase swung towards him.
沉重的行李箱朝他摆来时，他踉跄着往后退。
Employers could stagger working hours to ease congestion and reduce pressure on public transport.
雇主可以错开工作时间，以缓解拥堵并减轻公共交通的压力。
There is a coffee stain on your white shirt.
你的白衬衫上有一块咖啡渍。
Manufacturers are developing fabrics that resist stains, potentially reducing the water and energy required for washing.
制造商正在开发防污面料，这有望减少洗涤所需的水和能源。
stain.t: 污渍用stain；普通颜色不叫stain，染色剂则可以。

e: She bought a small stake in her sister's bakery.
她购买了姐姐那家面包店的一小部分股份。
Residents have a stake in urban planning because development decisions directly affect their quality of life.
居民与城市规划有切身利益关系，因为开发决策会直接影响他们的生活质量。
stake.t: have a stake in指有利益关系；at stake指面临风险。

e: This bread is stale, so I'll use it for breadcrumbs.
这面包不新鲜了，我就拿它做面包屑吧。
Teaching methods can become stale when educators lack opportunities to exchange ideas and develop new skills.
如果教育工作者缺乏交流想法和培养新技能的机会，教学方法就可能变得陈旧乏味。
stale.t: stale指失去新鲜感；rotten指已腐烂。

e: We bought fresh peaches from a small roadside stall.
我们在路边的一个小摊买了新鲜桃子。
Negotiations may stall if governments cannot agree on how to share the costs of reducing emissions.
如果各国政府无法就如何分担减排成本达成一致，谈判可能会陷入停滞。
stall.t: 作动词可指发动机熄火，也可指谈判等陷入停滞。

e: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。
Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。
stamp.t: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

e: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
请站在车门附近，等公交车停稳。
Local residents took a stand against the proposed road because it would destroy valuable woodland.
当地居民坚决反对这条拟建道路，因为它会破坏珍贵的林地。
stand.t: 过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。

e: The food here is always of a high standard.
这里的食物品质一向很高。
Governments should enforce strict safety standards to ensure that new housing protects residents from avoidable risks.
政府应严格执行安全标准，确保新建住房保护居民免受可避免的风险。
standard.t: 达到标准用meet a standard；生活水平用standard of living。

e: From my standpoint, the smaller flat is more practical.
在我看来，那套较小的公寓更实用。
From an environmental standpoint, investing in public transport is preferable to building more roads for private vehicles.
从环境角度看，投资公共交通比为私家车修建更多道路更可取。
standpoint.t: 常用from a ... standpoint表示“从……角度看”。

e: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。
Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。
star.t: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

e: Mix the corn starch with water before adding it.
先将玉米淀粉和水混合，再加进去。
Foods rich in starch provide energy, but their nutritional value also depends on fibre content and processing methods.
富含淀粉的食物提供能量，但其营养价值也取决于纤维含量和加工方式。
starch.t: 作“淀粉”通常不可数；starchy意为富含淀粉的。

e: The cat stared at a bird outside the window.
猫盯着窗外的一只鸟。
Children who stare at screens for long periods may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
长时间盯着屏幕的儿童可能较少有机会进行身体活动。
stare.t: stare at强调长时间盯看；glance at指瞥一眼。

e: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
我们一到家就开始做晚饭。
Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。
start.t: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

e: The sudden knock startled me while I was cooking.
我做饭时，突然的敲门声吓了我一跳。
Loud construction noises can startle nearby wildlife and disrupt their feeding patterns during the breeding season.
繁殖季节，巨大的施工噪声会惊吓附近的野生动物，扰乱它们的觅食规律。
startle.t: 强调突然受惊，不等于长期感到害怕。

e: Volunteers brought food to animals at risk of starvation.
志愿者给面临饿死危险的动物送来了食物。
Prolonged drought can lead to widespread starvation when communities lack reliable food reserves and emergency support.
当社区缺乏可靠的粮食储备和紧急援助时，长期干旱可能导致大范围的严重饥饿。
starvation.t: 比hunger严重，指长期缺食造成的极度饥饿或死亡。

e: Without regular feeding, these rescued animals could starve.
如果不定期喂食，这些获救的动物可能会饿死。
When drought destroys crops, rural families may starve unless emergency food supplies reach them quickly.
当干旱毁坏庄稼时，如果紧急食品不能及时送达，农村家庭可能会挨饿。
starve.t: 日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。

e: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。
The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.
报告指出，可靠的公共交通对于减少对私家车的依赖至关重要。
state.t: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

e: Her statement about the broken window surprised everyone.
她关于那扇破窗的说法让所有人都很惊讶。
The council issued a statement explaining how the proposed transport scheme would benefit residents with limited mobility.
市议会发表声明，解释拟议的交通方案将如何惠及行动不便的居民。
statement.t: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

e: The retired statesman spoke calmly to the gathered crowd.
这位退休的资深政治家平静地向聚集的人群讲话。
A respected statesman can help resolve international disputes by encouraging dialogue and building trust between governments.
一位受尊敬的资深政治家可以通过鼓励对话、建立政府间信任，帮助解决国际争端。
statesman.t: 通常含褒义，不宜译作贬义的“政客”；女性用 stateswoman。

e: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
电视画面停住不动了，但声音还在继续。
Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
工资多年来一直没有变化，而大城市的住房成本却持续上涨。
static.t: static强调不动或不变；静电用static electricity。

e: We hurried to the station with our heavy suitcases.
我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。
Local authorities should station trained staff at busy transport hubs to assist passengers with limited mobility.
地方政府应在繁忙的交通枢纽安排受过培训的工作人员，帮助行动不便的乘客。
station.t: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。

e: Our bus remained stationary while passengers climbed aboard.
乘客上车时，我们的公交车一直停着没动。
Stationary vehicles with running engines contribute to urban air pollution without providing any transport benefit.
停着却未熄火的车辆加剧了城市空气污染，却没有发挥任何运输作用。
stationary.t: stationary指静止的；stationery指文具，读音相同。

e: I bought some stationery for my new evening class.
我为新报的夜校课程买了些文具。
Providing basic stationery can help disadvantaged students participate more fully in classroom activities and complete assignments.
提供基本文具可以帮助弱势学生更充分地参与课堂活动并完成作业。
stationery.t: 不可数；勿与stationary（静止的）混淆。

e: That surprising statistic made us check the survey again.
那项令人惊讶的统计数据让我们再次核查了调查结果。
A single statistic rarely captures the full impact of unemployment on families and their communities.
单项统计数据很难完整反映失业对家庭及其社区的影响。
statistic.t: statistics表数据用复数谓语，表统计学用单数谓语。

e: These statistics show how much water our household uses.
这些统计数据显示了我们家的用水量。
Official statistics indicate that access to higher education has improved significantly in rural areas.
官方统计数据表明，农村地区接受高等教育的机会已显著增加。
statistics.t: 指数据时谓语用复数；指统计学时谓语用单数。

e: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。
Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。
statue.t: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

e: Her new role gave her higher status at work.
新职位提高了她在工作中的地位。
Access to quality healthcare should depend on medical need rather than a person's economic status.
能否获得优质医疗服务应取决于医疗需求，而非个人的经济地位。
status.t: 既可指社会地位，也可指当前状况，注意语境。

e: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。
Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。
stay.t: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

e: Keep a steady pace as you climb the hill.
上山时保持平稳的步速。
Steady investment in public transport can improve urban mobility and reduce traffic congestion over time.
持续稳定地投资公共交通，可以逐步改善城市出行并缓解交通拥堵。
steady.t: steady作形容词；修饰动词通常用steadily。

e: She served the steak with potatoes and green beans.
她端上牛排，配了土豆和四季豆。
Replacing beef steak with plant proteins occasionally can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
偶尔用植物蛋白代替牛排，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。
steak.t: steak与stake同音；单说steak通常指牛排。

e: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。
Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。
steal.t: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

e: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
我揭开盖子时，汤里升起了热气。
Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.
一些发电站利用热量产生蒸汽，推动涡轮机发电。
steam.t: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

e: Put the dumplings in the steamer for ten minutes.
把饺子放进蒸锅里蒸十分钟。
The arrival of the steamer transformed river trade by allowing goods to travel more reliably over long distances.
蒸汽轮船的出现使货物能够更可靠地进行长距离运输，从而改变了内河贸易。
steamer.t: 既可指蒸食物的器具，也可指蒸汽动力船。

e: The new bridge has a frame made of steel.
这座新桥的框架是钢制的。
Recycling steel can reduce demand for raw materials and lower energy consumption in the construction industry.
回收钢材可以减少建筑业对原材料的需求，并降低能源消耗。
steel.t: steel是钢，steal是偷；二者读音相同。

e: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
我们推着自行车爬上了陡坡。
A steep rise in housing costs can force young workers to move away from major cities.
住房成本急剧上涨可能迫使年轻劳动者离开大城市。
steep.t: steep既形容坡陡，也形容价格高或变化剧烈。

e: She carefully steered the boat away from the rocks.
她小心地驾驶小船，避开了岩石。
Governments can steer investment towards renewable energy by offering financial incentives and establishing clear environmental standards.
政府可以通过提供经济激励和制定明确的环境标准，引导资金投向可再生能源。
steer.t: steer clear of表示避开某人或某事。

e: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
她先修剪了玫瑰的花茎，再给花瓶加水。
Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
许多城市交通问题源于规划不善，而不只是道路空间不足。
Take one step forward and close the door.
向前迈一步，把门关上。
Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。
step.t: take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。

e: My grandmother challenges the stereotype that older people dislike technology.
我的祖母打破了老年人不喜欢科技的刻板印象。
Schools should challenge gender stereotypes so that all students feel free to pursue their interests.
学校应挑战性别刻板印象，让所有学生都能自由追求自己的兴趣。
stereotype.t: 常指对某类人的简单化看法，不等同于事实。

e: Dad gave us a stern look across the table.
爸爸隔着桌子严厉地看了我们一眼。
Schools should combine stern warnings about bullying with practical support for students who experience it.
学校既应严正警告欺凌行为，也应为遭受欺凌的学生提供实际支持。
stern.t: 形容词指态度严厉；作名词指船尾，与bow相对。

e: We shared a bowl of vegetable stew after our walk.
散步后，我们一起吃了一碗炖蔬菜。
Traditional stews can provide affordable, nutritious meals while making effective use of locally grown vegetables.
传统炖菜可以充分利用本地种植的蔬菜，提供经济实惠又营养丰富的餐食。
stew.t: stew既可指炖菜，也可作动词表示慢炖。

e: A steward helped us find our seats before the concert.
音乐会开始前，一位工作人员帮我们找到了座位。
Local communities can act as stewards of natural habitats when they receive adequate funding and decision-making powers.
当地社区若获得充足资金和决策权，就能成为自然栖息地的守护者。
steward.t: 不只指乘务员；a steward of也可指资源守护者。

e: My grandmother worked as a stewardess before becoming a teacher.
我祖母当教师之前做过空姐。
The replacement of stewardess with flight attendant reflects a broader shift towards gender-neutral language in professional settings.
用flight attendant替代stewardess，体现了职业场合用语向性别中立转变的更广泛趋势。
stewardess.t: 较旧且限定女性；现代通常用flight attendant。

e: The dog brought a stick back to me.
那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。
Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。
stick.t: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

e: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。
Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.
食品包装上常有黏性残留物，必须先清除才能有效回收材料。
sticky.t: sticky weather指湿热天气；sticky situation指困境。

e: My legs stiffen after sitting on the bus for hours.
在公交车上坐几个小时后，我的双腿就会僵硬。
Public opposition may stiffen if the government approves construction without consulting residents about environmental risks.
如果政府不就环境风险征询居民意见便批准施工，公众的反对可能会更强烈。
stiffen.t: 可及物也可不及物：stiffen muscles或muscles stiffen。

e: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。
Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。
still.t: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

e: These colourful puzzles stimulate my daughter's curiosity every morning.
这些色彩鲜艳的拼图每天早上都能激发我女儿的好奇心。
Lower borrowing costs can stimulate economic growth by encouraging businesses to invest in new equipment.
降低借贷成本可以鼓励企业投资新设备，从而促进经济增长。
stimulate.t: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。

e: The prize provided a stimulus for her daily practice.
这个奖项激励她每天练习。
Investment in renewable energy can provide a powerful stimulus to economic growth while reducing emissions.
投资可再生能源可以在减少排放的同时，有力地促进经济增长。
stimulus.t: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。

e: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
我浇花时，一只蜜蜂蜇了我的脚踝。
Harsh criticism can sting young learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
严厉的批评会伤害年幼学习者的感情，使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。
sting.t: 过去式、过去分词均为stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

e: The rental rules stipulate that pets must stay downstairs.
租赁规定明确要求宠物必须待在楼下。
Employment contracts should stipulate working hours clearly to prevent disputes between employers and their staff.
劳动合同应明确规定工作时间，以防止雇主与员工发生争议。
stipulate.t: 正式用词，常用于合同；可接名词或that从句。

e: Stir the soup gently so it does not stick.
轻轻搅拌汤，免得粘锅。
Documentaries about endangered animals can stir public concern and encourage stronger support for wildlife conservation.
关于濒危动物的纪录片能够唤起公众的关注，促使人们更加支持野生动物保护。
stir.t: 过去式stirred、现在分词stirring均双写r。

e: A few neat stitches fixed the hole in my sleeve.
整齐地缝上几针，我袖子上的破洞就补好了。
Teaching students to stitch torn clothing could reduce textile waste and encourage more sustainable consumption habits.
教学生缝补破损衣物可以减少纺织品浪费，并鼓励更可持续的消费习惯。
stitch.t: get a stitch指运动时岔气，不是“缝一针”。

e: The shop has fresh stock arriving early tomorrow morning.
这家店明天一早会有新货到店。
Small retailers often struggle to maintain sufficient stock when transport disruptions delay deliveries from major suppliers.
当运输中断导致主要供应商延迟交货时，小型零售商往往难以维持充足库存。
stock.t: 库存通常不可数；表示不同公司的股票时可用stocks。

e: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。
Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。
stomach.t: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

e: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。
Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。
stone.t: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

e: She pulled up a stool beside the kitchen counter.
她把一张凳子拉到厨房台面旁。
Doctors may examine a stool sample to identify infections that cannot be diagnosed through symptoms alone.
医生可能会检查粪便样本，以识别仅凭症状无法确诊的感染。
stool.t: 医疗语境中指大便，可用单数或复数，并非只用复数。

e: She stooped to pick up the fallen orange.
她弯腰捡起掉落的橙子。
Companies should not stoop to misleading advertising merely to increase sales in an increasingly competitive market.
企业不应仅为在竞争日益激烈的市场中提高销量，就不择手段地发布误导性广告。
stoop.t: stoop to doing表示不惜做卑劣之事，to为介词。

e: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
雨越下越大，我们便停下了脚步。
Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。
stop.t: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

e: These boxes provide useful storage for all my winter clothes.
这些箱子很适合存放我所有的冬装。
Improved energy storage could make renewable electricity more reliable when sunlight and wind are unavailable.
改进储能技术可以在缺少阳光和风力时，让可再生电力的供应更可靠。
storage.t: storage通常不可数；一间储藏室用a storeroom。

e: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。
Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。
store.t: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

e: Their new house has two storeys and a small garden.
他们的新房有两层，还带一个小花园。
Buildings with many storeys can accommodate more residents without requiring additional land in crowded cities.
在拥挤的城市中，多层建筑无需增加用地就能容纳更多居民。
We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。
storm.t: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

e: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
奶奶给我们讲了一个她童年的趣事。
Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
分享个人经历可以帮助学生从更有人情味的角度理解历史事件。
story.t: 楼层英式写storey，美式写story；高度不固定。

e: A pot of soup is bubbling on the stove.
一锅汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地煮着。
Replacing traditional indoor stoves with cleaner models can reduce household air pollution and improve respiratory health.
用更清洁的炉具替换传统室内炉灶，可以减少家庭空气污染并改善呼吸系统健康。
stove.t: stove用于烹饪或取暖；oven专指烤箱。

e: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
用尺子画一条直线。
Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。
The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。
Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.
政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。
straightforward.t: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。

e: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
我搬那个沉重的箱子时拉伤了背部。
Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.
人口快速增长给公共服务带来巨大压力，尤其是大城市的住房和医疗服务。
strain.t: strain可指拉伤；sprain主要指关节扭伤。

e: Our ferry crossed the narrow strait before sunset.
我们的渡轮在日落前穿过了狭窄的海峡。
Restrictions on shipping through a major strait can disrupt international trade and increase transport costs.
限制船只通过重要海峡可能扰乱国际贸易并增加运输成本。
strait.t: 表示困境通常用复数straits，如in dire straits。

e: A strand of hair fell across her face.
一缕头发垂到了她的脸上。
Improving public transport is one strand of a broader strategy to reduce urban air pollution.
改善公共交通是减少城市空气污染这一整体策略的一个方面。
strand.t: 一缕头发用a strand of hair；滞留常用be stranded。

e: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。
Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。
strange.t: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

e: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。
Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。
stranger.t: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

e: The strap on my backpack broke near the bus stop.
快到公交站时，我背包的肩带断了。
Passengers should strap their luggage securely to prevent injuries when vehicles stop suddenly or travel over uneven roads.
乘客应把行李绑牢，以免车辆急停或驶过不平路面时造成伤害。
strap.t: strap作动词时，过去式为strapped，现在分词为strapping。

e: We made a strategic decision to save before moving.
我们从长远考虑，决定先攒钱再搬家。
Strategic investment in public transport can reduce congestion and support economic growth over the long term.
对公共交通进行战略性投资，可以缓解拥堵并支持长期经济增长。
strategic.t: strategic重整体长远规划，tactical重具体战术。

e: Our strategy was to save a little every week.
我们的策略是每周存一点钱。
An effective transport strategy should improve public services while reducing dependence on private cars.
有效的交通策略应在改善公共服务的同时减少对私家车的依赖。
strategy.t: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。

e: The farmer spread fresh straw across the barn floor.
农民在谷仓地上铺了一层新鲜的麦秆。
Replacing plastic straws with reusable alternatives can reduce waste, although wider changes in consumption remain necessary.
用可重复使用的替代品取代塑料吸管能减少废物，但仍需更广泛地改变消费方式。
straw.t: 作稻草时不可数，作吸管时可数；hay指干草饲料。

e: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。
Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。
We crossed the shallow stream on flat stones.
我们踩着扁平的石头穿过了那条浅溪。
Many students now stream educational videos at home, making reliable internet access increasingly important for learning.
许多学生如今在家在线观看视频课程，因此可靠的网络连接对学习越来越重要。
stream.t: a stream of可指接连不断的人或事物。

e: We streamlined our morning routine to leave home earlier.
我们简化了早晨的日常安排，以便早点出门。
Hospitals can streamline appointment systems to reduce waiting times and improve access to essential care.
医院可以优化预约系统，缩短等待时间，让人们更容易获得必要的医疗服务。
streamline.t: 通常作动词；“流线型的”用 streamlined。

e: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
我们穿过街道来到面包店。
Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.
沿繁忙街道植树可以改善空气质量，让城市街区更适宜步行。
street.t: street多指城镇中两旁有建筑的道路。

e: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
我使出全身力气才提起那个手提箱。
Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.
学校应帮助学生发现自己的长处，而不是仅凭笔试评判所有人。
strength.t: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

e: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
散一小会儿步有助于我缓解工作压力。
Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
学校应教给学生实用的方法，帮助他们应对考试及其他紧张时期的压力。
stress.t: 人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。

e: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
我们的教练对准时到场要求很严格。
Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.
严格的环境法规可以促使制造商采用更清洁的技术，减少有害工业排放。
strict.t: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

e: Leila strode across the platform to catch her train.
莱拉大步穿过站台去赶火车。
Many countries have made significant strides in improving access to primary education over recent decades.
近几十年来，许多国家在扩大初等教育机会方面取得了显著进展。
stride.t: 过去式strode，过去分词stridden；进展常用strides。

e: Arguments over money caused constant strife in the family.
关于钱的争吵让这家人纷争不断。
Economic inequality can fuel social strife when communities feel excluded from opportunities for a better life.
当一些群体觉得自己被排除在改善生活的机会之外时，经济不平等可能加剧社会冲突。
strife.t: 不可数名词，语气正式，比一般争论更严重。

e: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。
Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。
strike.t: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

e: Her bright scarf makes a striking contrast with her coat.
她鲜艳的围巾与外套形成了鲜明对比。
The survey revealed striking differences in access to public transport between urban and rural communities.
调查显示，城乡社区在公共交通便利程度上存在显著差异。
striking.t: 表示醒目或显著，不一定表示令人震惊。

e: I tied the parcel with a piece of string.
我用一根细绳把包裹绑好了。
A string of successful conservation projects has demonstrated the value of involving local communities in environmental protection.
一系列成功的自然保护项目证明了让当地社区参与环境保护的价值。
string.t: 绳线通常不可数；琴弦及a string of中的string可数。

e: Cut the paper into strips for our craft project.
把纸剪成条，用于我们的手工制作。
Planting strips of wildflowers beside farmland can provide habitats for insects and support local biodiversity.
在农田旁种植带状野花，可以为昆虫提供栖息地，并维护当地生物多样性。
strip.t: strip的过去式为stripped；剥夺用strip sb of sth。

e: I strive to practise the piano every day.
我努力做到每天练钢琴。
Governments should strive to provide affordable housing without reducing the quality of public services.
政府应努力提供可负担住房，同时不降低公共服务质量。
