strive.t: 常用strive to do或strive for；过去式常为strove。

e: The cat purred while I stroked its soft fur.
我轻抚猫咪柔软的毛，它发出了呼噜声。
Recognising the early symptoms of a stroke can help patients receive treatment before serious brain damage occurs.
识别中风的早期症状，有助于患者在出现严重脑损伤前接受治疗。
stroke.t: 中风用have a stroke，勿与心脏病发作混淆。

e: We strolled along the river after our evening meal.
晚饭后，我们沿着河边悠闲地散步。
Accessible urban parks allow residents to stroll outdoors, supporting both physical health and mental wellbeing.
交通便利的城市公园让居民能够在户外散步，有益于身心健康。
stroll.t: 强调悠闲、不赶时间；名词常搭配take或go for。

e: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。
There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。
strong.t: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

e: The model shows the structure of a wooden bridge.
这个模型展示了一座木桥的结构。
A clear essay structure helps readers follow complex arguments and understand the writer's main conclusions.
清晰的文章结构有助于读者理解复杂的论证，把握作者的主要结论。
structure.t: structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。

e: I struggled to carry the heavy bags up the stairs.
我费力地把那些沉重的袋子提上楼梯。
Many young adults struggle to find affordable housing in cities where wages have not kept pace with rents.
在工资涨幅赶不上房租的城市，许多年轻人很难找到负担得起的住房。
struggle.t: struggle to do表示做某事很吃力，不保证成功。

e: My stubborn brother refused to wear a coat outside.
我那固执的弟弟不肯穿外套出门。
Stubborn resistance to change can prevent organisations from adopting more efficient and environmentally responsible practices.
顽固地抵制变革可能使机构无法采用更高效、更环保的做法。
stubborn.t: 形容人多含贬义；也可形容顽渍或难治的病。

e: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。
Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。
student.t: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

e: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
那位艺术家邀请我们参观她楼上明亮的工作室。
Public funding for affordable studio spaces can help emerging artists contribute to a city's cultural life.
为价格可负担的工作室提供公共资金，能帮助新兴艺术家丰富城市文化生活。
studio.t: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

e: My studious roommate spends most evenings in the library.
我那位勤奋好学的室友大多数晚上都在图书馆度过。
Studious pupils benefit from quiet learning environments, but they also need opportunities for physical activity.
勤奋好学的学生受益于安静的学习环境，但他们也需要参加体育活动的机会。
studious.t: 形容人多指勤学；studious avoidance指刻意回避。

e: I study English on the bus every morning.
我每天早上在公交车上学英语。
A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。
study.t: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

e: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
请把你的东西从厨房餐桌上拿走。
Consumers often buy stuff they rarely use, contributing to household waste and unnecessary resource consumption.
消费者经常购买很少使用的东西，造成家庭浪费和不必要的资源消耗。
stuff.t: 名词stuff不可数且偏口语；正式写作宜用具体名词。

e: I stumbled over a loose stone on the garden path.
我在花园小路上被一块松动的石头绊了一下。
Students may stumble over unfamiliar words during presentations, but regular practice can improve their confidence.
学生做展示时可能会在不熟悉的词上卡壳，但经常练习能增强他们的信心。
stumble.t: stumble不一定摔倒；stumble across指偶然发现。

e: We sat on a tree stump to eat lunch.
我们坐在一个树桩上吃午饭。
Removing tree stumps can disturb forest soils and destroy habitats used by insects and other small organisms.
清除树桩可能扰动森林土壤，破坏昆虫和其他小型生物的栖息地。
stump.t: be stumped by表示被难倒，并非被绊倒。

e: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
把伞留在家里真是太傻了。
Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.
说学生愚蠢会损害他们的信心，使他们不敢在课堂上提问。
stupid.t: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

e: These sturdy boots keep my feet dry on muddy walks.
穿着这双结实的靴子走泥路，我的双脚也能保持干爽。
Schools in earthquake-prone regions need sturdy buildings that can protect students during periods of intense shaking.
地震多发地区的学校需要坚固的建筑，以便在剧烈震动时保护学生。
sturdy.t: 常形容鞋、家具、建筑结实，也可形容人强健。

e: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。
Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。
style.t: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

e: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。
Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.
价格实惠且设计时尚的家具，可以鼓励年轻消费者为家中选用再生材料。
stylish.t: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

e: We subdivided the drawer with small wooden dividers.
我们用小木隔板把抽屉进一步分隔开了。
Researchers often subdivide survey participants into age groups to identify differences in attitudes towards public transport.
研究人员常将调查参与者按年龄细分，以识别他们对公共交通的态度差异。
subdivide.t: 常用subdivide A into B，表示把A细分为B。

e: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。
Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。
subject.t: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

e: Taste is subjective, so choose whichever colour you prefer.
审美是主观的，所以选你喜欢的颜色就好。
Although student feedback is valuable, subjective opinions should not be the sole basis for evaluating teaching quality.
虽然学生反馈很有价值，但主观意见不应成为评估教学质量的唯一依据。
subjective.t: subjective强调个人感受；objective强调客观事实。

e: The film used subliminal images that viewers barely noticed.
影片使用了观众几乎未察觉的潜意识图像。
Researchers continue to investigate whether subliminal cues can influence consumer choices under ordinary shopping conditions.
研究人员仍在探究，在日常购物环境中，潜意识线索是否会影响消费者的选择。
subliminal.t: 指低于意识觉察阈限，并非泛指无意识行为。

e: Submerge the dirty jar in warm water before washing it.
清洗脏罐子前，先把它浸没在温水中。
Rising sea levels could submerge low-lying coastal settlements, forcing residents to relocate and placing pressure on nearby cities.
海平面上升可能淹没地势低洼的沿海聚居区，迫使居民迁移，并给附近城市带来压力。
submerge.t: 可及物或不及物；强调进入水面或液面以下。

e: Please check your application carefully before submission tomorrow morning.
请在明早提交前仔细检查你的申请。
Online submission of assignments can reduce paper consumption and allow teachers to provide feedback more efficiently.
在线提交作业可以减少纸张消耗，并让教师更高效地提供反馈。
submission.t: 表示提交行为通常不可数；一份提交材料可数。

e: Please submit your application before the end of Friday.
请在周五结束前提交申请。
Researchers must submit their findings for independent review before these can be published in reputable academic journals.
研究人员必须先提交研究结果接受独立评审，之后才能在有良好声誉的学术期刊上发表。
submit.t: 过去式 submitted；submit sth to sb 表示向某人提交。

e: She accepted a subordinate role on the project.
她接受了在这个项目中担任辅助角色。
In effective organisations, subordinate staff should feel comfortable raising concerns with senior managers without fear.
在运作良好的组织中，下级员工应能放心地向高级管理人员提出疑虑。
subordinate.t: 表示“从属于”用subordinate to，不用than。

e: We subscribe to a magazine full of easy recipes.
我们订阅了一本介绍简单食谱的杂志。
Many educators subscribe to the view that practical experience should complement theoretical learning in higher education.
许多教育工作者赞同这样的观点：高等教育应将实践经验与理论学习相结合。
subscribe.t: 订阅和赞同都常用subscribe to，to是介词。

e: I cancelled my magazine subscription before moving abroad.
我在搬到国外之前取消了杂志订阅。
Subscription services can widen access to educational resources, although recurring fees may exclude lower-income households.
订阅服务可以扩大教育资源的获取渠道，但持续收费可能将低收入家庭排除在外。
A government subsidy helped us install solar panels at home.
政府补贴帮助我们在家里安装了太阳能板。
Targeted subsidies for public transport can make commuting more affordable while encouraging people to use their cars less.
针对公共交通的定向补贴能降低通勤费用，同时鼓励人们减少开车。
subsidy.t: 可数名词，复数为subsidies；常与for搭配。

e: A sticky substance had leaked onto the kitchen floor.
一种黏糊糊的物质漏到了厨房地板上。
Factories must prevent harmful substances from entering rivers, as contaminated water threatens both wildlife and human health.
工厂必须防止有害物质进入河流，因为受污染的水会威胁野生动物和人类健康。
substance.t: 表示物质种类时可数；表示实质或根据时通常不可数。

e: She kept the receipts to substantiate her insurance claim.
她保留了收据，以证明保险索赔有据可依。
Researchers must substantiate claims about new treatments with reliable evidence from carefully designed clinical trials.
研究人员必须用精心设计的临床试验所提供的可靠证据，来证实有关新疗法的论断。
substantiate.t: 正式及物动词；后接claim等，强调拿出证据。

e: Yoghurt makes a good substitute for cream in this soup.
做这道汤时，酸奶可以很好地代替奶油。
Online lessons can support independent learning, but they are not always an adequate substitute for classroom interaction.
线上课程能支持自主学习，但并不总能充分替代课堂互动。
substitute.t: substitute A for B＝用A代替B，勿颠倒。

e: The soup has a subtle hint of lemon.
这汤带有一丝淡淡的柠檬味。
Advertising can exert a subtle influence on consumers by associating products with desirable lifestyles.
广告将产品与令人向往的生活方式联系起来，从而潜移默化地影响消费者。
subtle.t: b不发音；常形容难以察觉的差别或影响。

e: Subtract the delivery charge to find the original price.
减去运费，就能算出原价。
Researchers subtract production costs from total revenue to calculate the profit generated by each farming method.
研究人员从总收入中减去生产成本，计算每种耕作方式带来的利润。
subtract.t: subtract A from B 表示用B减去A。

e: We practised subtraction by taking buttons out of a bowl.
我们通过从碗里拿走纽扣来练习减法。
A secure understanding of subtraction helps children develop the numerical skills needed for everyday financial decisions.
扎实理解减法有助于儿童培养日常财务决策所需的计算能力。
subtraction.t: subtract A from B表示B减A，注意顺序。

e: They moved to a quiet suburb near the river.
他们搬到了河边一处安静的近郊住宅区。
Reliable public transport can help residents of distant suburbs reach employment opportunities in the city centre.
可靠的公共交通可以帮助远郊居民前往市中心就业。
suburb.t: 常用in the suburbs；suburb不等于乡村。

e: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。
Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。
subway.t: 美式指地铁；英式常指地下人行通道。

e: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。
Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。
succeed.t: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

e: The school concert was a success despite the rain.
尽管下了雨，学校音乐会还是很成功。
Long-term success in education depends not only on funding but also on the quality of teaching.
教育的长期成功不仅取决于资金投入，也取决于教学质量。
success.t: 泛指成功时不可数；a success指成功的人或事。

e: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。
Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。
successful.t: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

e: Heavy rain kept us indoors for three successive days.
大雨连续三天让我们只能待在室内。
Successive governments have invested in public transport, but rural communities still lack reliable bus services.
历届政府都投资了公共交通，但农村社区仍缺乏可靠的公交服务。
The retiring coach introduced her successor to the team.
即将退休的教练向队员们介绍了她的接任者。
A new leader should give their successor enough guidance to ensure that essential public services continue smoothly.
新任领导者应为自己的接任者提供充分指导，确保基本公共服务平稳运行。
successor.t: 用successor to sb；不专指财产继承人。

e: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。
Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。
such.t: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

e: The baby sucked her thumb and slowly fell asleep.
宝宝吮着拇指，慢慢睡着了。
Modern ventilation systems suck polluted air out of buildings, helping to maintain a healthier indoor environment.
现代通风系统将污浊空气从建筑内抽出，有助于维持更健康的室内环境。
suck.t: 表示“很糟糕”时属非正式用语，不宜用于学术写作。

e: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。
A sudden rise in food prices can place considerable pressure on families with low incomes.
食品价格突然上涨会给低收入家庭带来相当大的压力。
sudden.t: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

e: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。
When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。
suddenly.t: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

e: Our neighbour plans to sue the builder over faulty repairs.
我们的邻居打算因维修质量问题起诉那名建筑工人。
Consumers should have the right to sue companies that knowingly sell unsafe products or conceal serious defects.
消费者应有权起诉明知产品不安全仍销售，或隐瞒严重缺陷的公司。
sue.t: sue someone for something：因某事起诉某人。

e: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
我不吃午饭时就会头痛。
Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。
suffer.t: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

e: The medicine eased her suffering and helped her sleep.
药物减轻了她的痛苦，让她得以入睡。
Improving access to clean water can reduce human suffering in communities affected by prolonged drought.
改善清洁用水的获取条件，可以减轻长期受干旱影响的社区居民的苦难。
suffering.t: 泛指痛苦时通常不可数；sufferings指种种苦难。

e: We have sufficient food for everyone at the picnic.
我们准备了足够的食物，供参加野餐的每个人享用。
Without sufficient funding, local authorities may struggle to maintain essential services for their growing populations.
如果资金不足，地方政府可能难以为不断增长的人口维持基本服务。
sufficient.t: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

e: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。
Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。
sugar.t: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

e: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。
Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
suggest.t: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

e: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。
The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。
suggestion.t: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

e: Our local centre offers free workshops on suicide prevention.
我们当地的中心提供免费的自杀预防讲习班。
Suicide prevention requires accessible mental health services, supportive communities, and responsible reporting in the media.
自杀预防需要便捷可及的心理健康服务、相互支持的社区以及负责任的媒体报道。
suicide.t: 中性表达常用die by suicide，避免污名化。

e: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
明天把预约时间提前一点会更适合你吗？
Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
弹性工作时间适合需要兼顾工作职责与家庭责任的员工。
suit.t: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。

e: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。
Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。
suitable.t: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。

e: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。
Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。
suitcase.t: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。

e: Our hotel suite has a balcony overlooking the sea.
我们住的酒店套房有一个面朝大海的阳台。
The university provides a software suite that enables students to analyse data and prepare research presentations.
该大学提供一套软件，帮助学生分析数据并制作研究报告演示文稿。
suite.t: 读音同sweet；suit意为西装，读音不同。

e: The guide showed us yellow sulphur near the volcano.
导游给我们看了火山附近黄色的硫磺。
Burning fuels containing sulphur releases gases that contribute to acid rain and damage natural ecosystems.
燃烧含硫燃料会释放促成酸雨的气体，破坏自然生态系统。
sulphur.t: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

e: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
她为买一辆新自行车攒了一小笔钱。
Governments invest large sums in public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
政府在公共交通上投入巨资，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
sum.t: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

e: Could you summarize the story before we discuss it?
我们讨论之前，你能概括一下这个故事吗？
Students should learn to summarize research findings accurately rather than reproduce every detail from their sources.
学生应学会准确概括研究结果，而不是复述资料中的每个细节。
summarize.t: 英式也常拼作summarise；总结时保留要点。

e: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
你能简要说说这次会议的内容吗？
A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。
summary.t: a summary of后接概括对象；in summary用于总结。

e: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。
Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。
summer.t: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

e: We reached the snowy summit just before sunrise.
我们在日出前刚好登上了白雪覆盖的山顶。
At the climate summit, national leaders discussed practical measures to reduce emissions and support vulnerable communities.
在气候峰会上，各国领导人讨论了减少排放和支持脆弱社区的实际措施。
summit.t: 山顶常用the summit of；峰会可用a summit。

e: The manager summoned everyone to her office after lunch.
午饭后，经理把所有人召集到她的办公室。
Governments must summon the political will to address environmental problems despite opposition from powerful industries.
尽管遭到强势行业的反对，政府仍须拿出解决环境问题的政治决心。
summon.t: summon sb to某处；summon up courage指鼓起勇气。

e: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。
Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。
sun.t: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

e: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。
Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。
sunday.t: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

e: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。
Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。
sunglasses.t: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

e: Warm sunlight streamed through the window onto my desk.
温暖的阳光透过窗户洒在我的书桌上。
Designing classrooms to receive more natural sunlight may improve students' comfort and reduce electricity use.
让教室获得更多自然光的设计可能提高学生的舒适度，并减少用电。
sunlight.t: 不可数名词；in direct sunlight表示在阳光直射下。

e: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。
Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。
sunny.t: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

e: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
我们早早醒来，观看湖上的日出。
Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。
sunrise.t: 在日出时用at sunrise；日落是sunset。

e: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
昨天我们在日落前刚好赶到了海滩。
Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。
sunset.t: 表示在日落时用at sunset，通常不加冠词。

e: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。
Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。
sunshine.t: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

e: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
我们在花园里玩游戏，度过了一个特别愉快的下午。
Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.
尽管用户可能形容某款应用特别有帮助，研究人员仍需客观证据来评估其教育价值。
super.t: 口语色彩强；正式写作宜用excellent或very。

e: We enjoyed a superb meal overlooking the quiet harbour.
我们一边俯瞰宁静的港湾，一边享用了一顿极棒的饭菜。
The museum offers superb educational facilities, allowing visitors of all ages to explore scientific ideas through practical activities.
这家博物馆提供一流的教育设施，让各年龄段的参观者通过实践活动探索科学概念。
superb.t: 本身已含程度很高之意，通常不说very superb。

e: These boots offer superior grip on wet paths.
这双靴子在湿滑小路上的防滑性能更好。
Public transport can provide a superior alternative to private cars when services are frequent and reliable.
当班次密集且服务可靠时，公共交通可以成为比私家车更好的出行选择。
superior.t: 比较时用superior to，不用superior than。

e: The newer camera showed its superiority in low light.
这台较新的相机在弱光下展现了优势。
The technological superiority of larger firms can make it difficult for small businesses to compete effectively.
大公司的技术优势可能使小企业难以有效参与竞争。
superiority.t: 表示相对优势用superiority over，不用than。

e: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。
Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。
supermarket.t: 在超市购物常说shop at a supermarket。

e: This new timetable supersedes the one on our fridge.
这份新时刻表取代了我们冰箱上的旧时刻表。
Digital payment systems may eventually supersede cash in many settings, although accessibility concerns must first be addressed.
数字支付系统最终可能在许多场景中取代现金，但必须先解决使用便利性方面的问题。
supersede.t: 注意拼写结尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被动式。

e: We heard a loud boom as the supersonic aircraft passed.
超音速飞机飞过时，我们听到了一声巨响。
Supersonic passenger aircraft could shorten international journeys, but their noise and fuel consumption remain major concerns.
超音速客机可以缩短国际旅程，但其噪声和燃油消耗仍是主要问题。
supersonic.t: 指速度超过声速；“超声波的”通常用ultrasonic。

e: My uncle avoids walking under ladders because of superstition.
我叔叔因为迷信，不愿从梯子下面走过。
Science education can help students distinguish evidence-based explanations from superstition while respecting different cultural traditions.
科学教育能帮助学生区分有证据支持的解释与迷信，同时尊重不同的文化传统。
superstition.t: 泛指迷信用不可数；某种迷信观念可数。

e: My superstitious cousin always carries a lucky stone.
我那迷信的表亲总是带着一块幸运石。
Superstitious beliefs may influence financial decisions when people rely on lucky objects rather than reliable evidence.
当人们依赖幸运物而非可靠证据时，迷信观念可能影响财务决策。
superstitious.t: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。

e: An adult must supervise the children near the pool.
孩子们在泳池附近时，必须有成人照看。
Experienced nurses should supervise new staff to ensure that patients receive safe and effective care.
经验丰富的护士应指导新员工，确保患者获得安全有效的护理。
supervise.t: 及物动词，直接接人或活动：supervise staff。

e: My supervisor showed me how to use the equipment.
我的主管教我如何使用这些设备。
A supportive supervisor can help new employees develop confidence and adapt to unfamiliar workplace expectations.
支持员工的主管能帮助新员工建立信心，并适应不熟悉的工作要求。
supervisor.t: 职场中指主管；英国大学中也常指研究导师。

e: We had soup and fresh bread for supper.
我们晚饭喝了汤，吃了新鲜面包。
Sharing supper regularly can help families maintain close relationships despite increasingly demanding work schedules.
尽管工作安排日益繁忙，经常共进晚餐仍有助于家人维持亲密关系。
supper.t: 常指较随意的晚饭，也可指睡前便餐。

e: Our bakery gets fresh flour from a local supplier.
我们面包店从一家本地供应商那里购买新鲜面粉。
Businesses should assess each supplier carefully to ensure that materials are produced under fair working conditions.
企业应仔细评估每一家供应商，确保原材料在公平的劳动条件下生产。
supplier.t: supplier of后接所供物品；supply为其动词形式。

e: A nearby farm supplies fresh eggs to our shop.
附近一家农场给我们的商店供应新鲜鸡蛋。
Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.
随着人口增长和气候变化给资源带来越来越大的压力，城市必须确保可靠的供水。
supply.t: supply A with B＝supply B to A；物资常用supplies。

e: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。
Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
support.t: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

e: My supportive sister helped me practise before the interview.
面试前，支持我的姐姐帮我做了练习。
A supportive classroom environment encourages students to ask questions without worrying about making mistakes.
充满支持的课堂环境能鼓励学生提问，而不必担心犯错。
supportive.t: 常用be supportive of表示支持某人或某事。

e: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。
Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。
suppose.t: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

e: I tried to suppress a sneeze during the concert.
音乐会期间，我努力忍住了一个喷嚏。
Attempts to suppress scientific findings can undermine public trust and delay effective responses to environmental problems.
试图隐瞒科学发现会损害公众信任，并延误对环境问题的有效应对。
suppress.t: 及物动词，直接接情绪、反应、活动或信息。

e: His suppression of laughter failed when the puppy sneezed.
小狗一打喷嚏，他就再也忍不住笑了。
The suppression of public debate can weaken trust in institutions and prevent communities from addressing serious problems.
压制公共讨论会削弱人们对机构的信任，并妨碍社区解决严重问题。
suppression.t: 通常不可数；动词为suppress，注意双写pp和ss。

e: The council has supreme authority over the island.
该委员会对这座岛拥有最高权力。
In many countries, the supreme court can review whether new legislation complies with the constitution.
在许多国家，最高法院可以审查新法律是否符合宪法。
supreme.t: 本身含“最高”之意，通常不用比较级或最高级。

e: Are you sure you left your keys here?
你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？
Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。
sure.t: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

e: My cousin learned to surf during our beach holiday.
我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。
Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。
surf.t: surf the internet指上网浏览，不一定有明确搜索目标。

e: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
开始准备午饭前，先擦一下厨房台面。
Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.
深色路面白天吸收热量，导致城市地区气温升高。
surface.t: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

e: The surgeon explained the operation before I went home.
在我回家前，外科医生向我解释了手术过程。
Rural hospitals often struggle to recruit experienced surgeons, which can delay essential treatment for local residents.
乡村医院往往难以招到经验丰富的外科医生，这可能导致当地居民无法及时获得必要治疗。
surgeon.t: surgeon指外科医生；surgery可指外科手术。

e: My uncle is recovering well after knee surgery.
我叔叔做完膝关节手术后恢复得很好。
Advances in medical technology have made many types of surgery safer and reduced patients' recovery times.
医疗技术的进步提高了多种手术的安全性，并缩短了患者的康复时间。
surgery.t: 手术义通常不可数；英式英语中诊所义可数。

e: Seeing wet umbrellas, I surmised that it was raining.
看到湿漉漉的雨伞，我猜外面正在下雨。
Researchers surmise that flexible schedules improve employee wellbeing, although stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.
研究人员推测弹性工作时间能改善员工身心状况，但仍需更有力的证据加以确认。
surmise.t: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

e: Your homemade cakes surpass anything sold at our local bakery.
你自制的蛋糕比我们附近面包店卖的任何蛋糕都好。
Demand for renewable energy may surpass current forecasts as governments introduce stronger measures to reduce carbon emissions.
随着各国政府采取更有力的减碳措施，可再生能源需求可能超过目前的预测。
surpass.t: 及物动词，直接接宾语，不加than。

e: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。
The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。
surprise.t: 人感到惊讶用surprised；事物令人惊讶用surprising。

e: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。
Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。
surprised.t: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

e: The soldiers surrendered and walked forward with empty hands.
士兵们投降了，空着双手向前走来。
Users should not have to surrender control of their personal information to access essential online services.
用户不应为了使用必要的在线服务而被迫放弃对个人信息的控制权。
surrender.t: surrender to sb指向某人投降；交出物品直接接宾语。

e: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
高大的树木环绕着小屋，为窗户遮阴。
Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。
surround.t: 常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。

e: We ate lunch in the peaceful surroundings of the garden.
我们在花园宁静的环境中吃了午饭。
Students may concentrate better in pleasant surroundings, especially when classrooms offer natural light and views of greenery.
学生在舒适的环境中可能更容易集中注意力，尤其当教室采光自然且窗外有绿植时。
surroundings.t: 始终用复数形式，作主语时谓语也用复数。

e: I completed a short survey about our local library.
我填写了一份关于本地图书馆的简短问卷。
A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.
最近一项调查表明，如果有更安全的路线，许多通勤者会更经常骑自行车。
survey.t: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在末音节。

e: The lost hikers carried blankets and other survival equipment.
迷路的徒步者带着毯子和其他求生装备。
Protecting natural habitats is essential for the survival of species threatened by climate change.
保护自然栖息地对于受气候变化威胁的物种生存至关重要。
Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。
Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。
survive.t: 表示从事故中幸存，直接说survive an accident。

e: Rescuers pulled a survivor from the flooded house.
救援人员从被淹的房屋中救出了一名幸存者。
Every disaster survivor should have access to safe housing, medical treatment, and long-term psychological support.
每位灾难幸存者都应能获得安全住所、医疗服务和长期心理支持。
These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
这些幼苗特别容易遭受霜冻损害。
Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
儿童可能更容易受到网络广告影响，因为他们缺乏评估商业宣传的经验。
I suspect the cat knocked the cup off the table.
我怀疑是猫把杯子从桌上碰掉了。
Researchers suspect that prolonged screen use may affect sleep quality, although further evidence is needed.
研究人员推测，长时间使用屏幕可能影响睡眠质量，不过仍需更多证据。
suspect.t: 动词重音在后；名词、形容词读/ˈsʌspekt/。

e: The storm caused the suspension of all ferry services.
暴风雨导致所有渡轮服务暂停。
The temporary suspension of construction work allowed researchers to assess the project's impact on local wildlife.
建筑工程的暂时停工让研究人员得以评估该项目对当地野生动物的影响。
suspension.t: 表示暂时中止；车辆语境中指悬架。

e: I had a suspicion that someone had moved my keys.
我怀疑有人动过我的钥匙。
A lack of transparency can increase public suspicion of how government contracts are awarded.
缺乏透明度会加深公众对政府合同授予方式的怀疑。
I noticed a suspicious charge on my bank statement.
我发现银行账单上有一笔可疑的扣款。
Consumers are increasingly suspicious of environmental claims that companies make without providing clear evidence to support them.
消费者越来越怀疑企业那些缺乏明确证据支持的环保声明。
suspicious.t: 事物可疑用suspicious；怀疑某事用suspicious of。

e: She chooses sustainable products with little or no plastic packaging.
她选择塑料包装很少或不用塑料包装的环保产品。
Cities should promote sustainable transport by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling infrastructure.
城市应投资建设可靠的公交服务和安全的骑行设施，推动可持续交通。
sustainable.t: renewable强调可再生；sustainable强调可持续。

e: Please swallow your food before you start talking again.
请先把食物咽下去再说话。
Consumers should not simply swallow advertising claims without examining the evidence behind promises of better health.
消费者不应不加审查就轻信广告中改善健康的承诺，而应考察背后的证据。
swallow.t: swallow your pride指放下自尊，接受不情愿的事。

e: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。
Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。
swan.t: 可数名词，复数swans；幼天鹅称cygnet。

e: A swarm of bees gathered on the apple tree.
一群蜜蜂聚集在苹果树上。
Visitors swarm into coastal towns during summer, increasing demand for public transport and waste collection services.
游客在夏季涌入沿海城镇，增加了对公共交通和垃圾收集服务的需求。
swarm.t: be swarming with表示某处挤满人或昆虫。

e: The branches swayed gently as we ate outside.
我们在户外吃饭时，树枝轻轻摇曳。
Emotional advertising can sway consumers' decisions even when competing products offer better value for money.
即使竞争产品更划算，情感广告仍可能左右消费者的决定。
sway.t: sway既可指身体摇摆，也可指影响观点或决定。

e: Please don't swear when the game goes wrong.
玩游戏不顺利时，请不要说脏话。
Witnesses must swear to tell the truth before giving evidence in many legal systems.
在许多法律体系中，证人作证前必须宣誓如实陈述。
swear.t: 过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。

e: Sweat ran down my face during the steep climb.
爬那段陡坡时，汗水顺着我的脸流下来。
People who exercise in hot weather lose water through sweat and should drink regularly.
在炎热天气里锻炼的人会因出汗而流失水分，应定时饮水。
sweat.t: 汗水通常不可数；出一身汗可说a sweat。

e: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。
Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。
sweater.t: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

e: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
请在客人到来前把厨房地板扫干净。
Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。
sweep.t: 过去式、过去分词均为 swept。

e: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。
Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。
sweet.t: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

e: My ankle began to swell after I twisted it.
我扭伤脚踝后，脚踝开始肿起来。
Seasonal tourism can swell the population of coastal towns, placing additional pressure on local water supplies.
季节性旅游会使沿海城镇人口增加，给当地供水带来额外压力。
Her swift reaction stopped the glass from falling.
她反应敏捷，接住了快要掉下去的玻璃杯。
A swift response to disease outbreaks can reduce pressure on hospitals and protect vulnerable communities.
迅速应对疾病暴发可以减轻医院压力，并保护脆弱群体。
We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。
Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。
We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。
Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.
经常游泳可以增强体质，同时对关节造成的压力相对较小。
swimming.t: 表示运动时不可数；去游泳用go swimming。

e: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
她走在街上，包随着步伐轻轻摆动。
A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。
swing.t: 过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。

e: Dry leaves swirled around my feet in the wind.
干枯的树叶在风中绕着我的脚打转。
Dust can swirl through urban streets during construction, reducing air quality and causing discomfort for nearby residents.
施工时，灰尘可能在城市街道中盘旋，降低空气质量，并让附近居民感到不适。
swirl.t: 可作及物或不及物动词，强调流动中的旋转。

e: We enjoyed Swiss cheese during our picnic by the lake.
我们在湖边野餐时品尝了瑞士奶酪。
Swiss railways demonstrate how reliable public transport can connect remote mountain communities and support sustainable tourism.
瑞士铁路展示了可靠的公共交通如何连接偏远山区社区并支持可持续旅游。
swiss.t: 首字母须大写；the Swiss统称瑞士人，不加s。

e: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
电灯开关就在厨房门后。
Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.
政府可以提供经济支持，鼓励家庭改用可再生能源。
switch.t: switch on/off表示开关设备；switch to表示改用。

e: We travelled through Switzerland by train during our holiday.
假期里，我们乘火车游览了瑞士。
Switzerland demonstrates how reliable rail networks can support tourism while reducing dependence on private cars.
瑞士展示了可靠的铁路网络如何在支持旅游业的同时减少对私家车的依赖。
switzerland.t: Switzerland 是瑞士，Sweden 是瑞典；瑞士的用 Swiss。

e: An ancient sword lay inside the museum's glass case.
一把古剑陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。
The discovery of a decorated sword provides evidence of advanced metalworking skills in this ancient society.
一把装饰精美的剑的发现，为这个古代社会拥有先进金属加工技术提供了证据。
sword.t: w不发音；双刃剑可比喻既有利又有弊的事物。

e: For my grandparents, this old house is a symbol of hope.
对我的祖父母来说，这座老房子是希望的象征。
Public parks can become a symbol of a city's commitment to environmental protection and residents' quality of life.
公共公园可以成为城市致力于环境保护和提升居民生活质量的象征。
symbol.t: “……的象征”用 a symbol of，不用 symbol for。

e: The butterfly's open wings show beautiful symmetry in the sunlight.
阳光下，蝴蝶展开的双翅呈现出优美的对称性。
Architects often use symmetry to create buildings that appear balanced and visually pleasing to visitors.
建筑师常利用对称性，使建筑在参观者眼中显得平衡而美观。
symmetry.t: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是symmetrical。

e: My manager was sympathetic when I explained my difficulties.
我说明困难后，经理表示理解。
Employers who are sympathetic to carers' needs can improve staff wellbeing by offering flexible working arrangements.
体谅照护者需求的雇主可以通过提供灵活的工作安排来改善员工福祉。
sympathetic.t: 常接to或towards；不表示“讨人喜欢的”。

e: I sympathize with you; losing a pet is painful.
我很理解你的感受；失去宠物确实令人难过。
Many residents sympathize with workers demanding better conditions, although they find the transport strike inconvenient.
许多居民支持工人改善工作条件的诉求，尽管他们觉得交通罢工带来了不便。
sympathize.t: 不直接接宾语：用 sympathize with；英式也拼 sympathise。

e: We listened to a symphony while cooking dinner.
我们做晚饭时听了一首交响曲。
Performing a symphony requires close cooperation among musicians, demonstrating the importance of teamwork in the arts.
演奏交响曲需要音乐家之间密切合作，体现了团队协作在艺术中的重要性。
symphony.t: symphony指交响曲；交响乐团用symphony orchestra。

e: Leila met several researchers at a symposium yesterday.
莱拉昨天在一场专题研讨会上结识了几位研究人员。
The international symposium brought together scientists to discuss practical solutions to urban air pollution.
这场国际专题研讨会汇聚了科学家，共同讨论解决城市空气污染的可行办法。
A sore throat was her first symptom of illness.
喉咙痛是她生病后出现的第一个症状。
High staff turnover can be a symptom of poor management rather than a shortage of skilled workers.
员工流动率高可能反映管理不善，而非技术工人短缺。
symptom.t: 常用a symptom of；症状缓解用relieve symptoms。

e: The doctor explained how the syndrome affects sleep.
医生解释了这种综合征如何影响睡眠。
Early recognition of a syndrome can help healthcare professionals provide appropriate support and manage symptoms more effectively.
及早识别综合征，有助于医疗人员提供适当支持，并更有效地控制症状。
syndrome.t: 指一组共同出现的症状，不等同于单一症状symptom。

e: Her room is a synthesis of old and modern styles.
她的房间融合了古典与现代风格。
A synthesis of findings from several studies provides stronger evidence for the benefits of regular exercise.
综合多项研究的结果，能为经常锻炼的益处提供更有力的证据。
She poured a little syrup over her warm pancakes.
她在热乎乎的煎饼上浇了一点糖浆。
Fruit preserved in syrup often contains more added sugar than fresh fruit, which may concern health-conscious consumers.
糖浆保存的水果通常比新鲜水果含有更多添加糖，这可能让注重健康的消费者担忧。
syrup.t: 通常不可数；止咳糖浆说cough syrup。

e: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。
An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。
system.t: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

e: Her systematic packing made everything easy to find later.
她收拾行李很有条理，之后什么都很容易找到。
A systematic review of existing research can help governments develop more effective public health policies.
对现有研究进行系统综述，有助于政府制定更有效的公共卫生政策。
systematic.t: systematic指有条理；systemic指系统整体的。

e: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。
Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。
t-shirt.t: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

e: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。
The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。
table.t: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

e: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
我用平板电脑看烹饪视频。
Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
为每名学生配备平板电脑可能有助于获取学习资源，但教师仍需接受适当培训。
tablet.t: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

e: Discussing salaries remains a taboo in our office.
在我们办公室，讨论薪资仍是禁忌。
Public education can challenge the taboo surrounding mental illness and encourage more people to seek support.
公众教育可以挑战围绕精神疾病的禁忌，鼓励更多人寻求支持。
taboo.t: 名词指禁忌；形容词可说a taboo subject。

e: I used a tack to secure the loose fabric.
我用一枚大头短钉固定住松开的布料。
When public campaigns fail to change behaviour, policymakers may need to take a different tack.
当公共宣传活动无法改变行为时，政策制定者可能需要换一种方法。
tack.t: 方法用tack；步入正轨用on track，勿混。

e: Let's tackle the messy kitchen before our guests arrive.
趁客人还没到，我们先收拾这乱糟糟的厨房吧。
Governments need to tackle housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving access to public transport.
政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通的可及性来应对住房短缺。
tackle.t: tackle直接接问题，不加with；强调着手应对。

e: Her tactic was to practise before everyone else arrived.
她的策略是在其他人到达之前先练习。
Offering cheaper public transport is one tactic cities can use to discourage unnecessary car journeys.
提供更便宜的公共交通是城市减少不必要驾车出行的一种策略。
tactic.t: strategy指整体战略，tactic指具体手段。

e: Our coach changed tactics halfway through the football match.
足球比赛进行到一半时，我们的教练改变了战术。
Companies increasingly use digital marketing tactics to attract younger consumers and compete in crowded markets.
企业越来越多地采用数字营销策略来吸引年轻消费者，并在竞争激烈的市场中争得优势。
tactics.t: strategy侧重整体战略，tactics侧重具体手段。

e: I checked the tag before washing my new jumper.
洗新毛衣前，我查看了标签。
Researchers tag marine animals to track their movements and identify habitats that require stronger environmental protection.
研究人员给海洋动物加上追踪标记，以追踪其活动并确定需要加强环境保护的栖息地。
tag.t: 动词过去式tagged；tag along意为跟着去。

e: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。
Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。
tail.t: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

e: The tailor shortened my trousers while I waited nearby.
我在旁边等着，裁缝把我的裤子改短了。
Teachers should tailor their lessons to students' abilities rather than follow a single approach for everyone.
教师应根据学生的能力调整课程，而不是对所有人采用同一种方法。
tailor.t: tailor A to B表示“根据B调整或定制A”。

e: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。
Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。
take.t: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

e: Grandfather told us a tale about a clever fox.
祖父给我们讲了一个聪明狐狸的故事。
Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.
传统故事既能传承文化价值观，也能通过令人难忘的角色帮助儿童探索复杂情感。
tale.t: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。

e: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
我的表亲画动物很有天赋。
Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。
talent.t: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

e: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。
Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。
talented.t: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

e: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。
Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。
talk.t: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

e: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。
Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。
tall.t: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

e: The tame rabbit ate directly from my hand.
那只温顺的兔子直接吃我手里的食物。
Even tame animals require careful handling, especially when young children are learning to interact with them.
即使是驯服的动物也需要谨慎对待，尤其是在幼儿学习与它们互动时。
tame.t: tame指不怕人或被驯服，不等于天生无害。

e: His summer tan had faded by the middle of winter.
到了隆冬，他夏天晒出的棕褐肤色已经褪去。
Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.
虽然晒成棕褐色有时被认为很有吸引力，但长时间日晒会增加皮肤受损的风险。
tan.t: tan不只指晒黑；作形容词也可描述鞋包的浅褐色。

e: My headphones were buried in a tangle of cables.
我的耳机埋在一团缠结的线缆里。
Small businesses often face a tangle of regulations that makes expansion costly and time-consuming.
小企业常面临错综复杂的法规，使业务扩张既费钱又费时。
tangle.t: a tangle of既可指实物缠结，也可指复杂困局。

e: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
鱼游到了水族箱里的一块石头后面。
Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.
安装雨水储水箱能让家庭浇灌花园时不必完全依赖经过处理的饮用水。
tank.t: fish tank是水族箱；汽车的油箱用fuel tank。

e: We watched a huge tanker sail into the harbour.
我们看着一艘巨大的油轮驶入港口。
An accident involving an oil tanker can cause lasting damage to coastal ecosystems.
涉及油轮的事故可能对沿海生态系统造成持久损害。
tanker.t: tank可指储罐；tanker指运输液体等的船或车辆。

e: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
刷牙时请关上水龙头。
Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。
tap.t: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

e: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
我用一条胶带封好了包裹。
Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。
tape.t: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

e: My savings target is enough for a new bicycle.
我的储蓄目标是攒够买一辆新自行车的钱。
Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
政府应制定切实可行的减排目标，并定期评估实现目标的进展。
target.t: 表示达成目标用meet或reach a target。

e: The new tariff made imported cheese much more expensive.
新关税使进口奶酪贵了很多。
Although tariffs may protect domestic manufacturers, they can also raise consumer prices and provoke trade disputes.
关税虽然可能保护国内制造商，但也可能推高消费价格并引发贸易争端。
tariff.t: 关税用tariff on goods；复数tariffs常指多项关税。

e: My first task today is to water the plants.
我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。
Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。
task.t: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。

e: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。
Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。
taste.t: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

e: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
这道美味的汤很适合寒冷的夜晚。
School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。
The tax on my monthly salary has gone up.
我每月工资要缴的税增加了。
Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。
tax.t: tax可作名词或动词；taxing常指费力的、累人的。

e: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。
Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。
taxi.t: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

e: As a taxpayer, I want cleaner streets and safer parks.
作为纳税人，我希望街道更干净，公园更安全。
Public infrastructure projects should deliver lasting benefits to the taxpayers who finance them.
公共基础设施项目应为出资的纳税人带来持久的益处。
taxpayer.t: 通常指纳税的个人，也可指纳税机构。

e: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。
In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。
tea.t: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。

e: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。
Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。
teach.t: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

e: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。
A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。
teacher.t: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

e: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。
Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。
team.t: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

e: Good teamwork helped us finish painting before lunch.
良好的团队合作让我们在午饭前刷完了漆。
Group projects can develop teamwork skills that students will need in their future careers.
小组项目可以培养学生未来工作所需的团队合作能力。
teamwork.t: 不可数名词；强调团队成员共同协作。

e: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
小心别把纸袋撕破了。
Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。
tear.t: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

e: My cousins always tease me about my enormous backpack.
表亲们总拿我的超大背包打趣。
Schools should teach children that teasing classmates about their appearance can seriously damage their confidence.
学校应教导孩子，取笑同学的外貌可能严重损害他们的自信心。
tease.t: 常用tease sb about sth；可亲昵，也可伤人。

e: We called an engineer to solve the technical problem.
我们请了一位工程师来解决这个技术问题。
Schools should teach technical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for a changing workplace.
学校应在教授文化课程的同时传授技术技能，帮助学生适应不断变化的职场。
technical.t: technical强调技术或专业知识，不等于高科技。

e: The technician replaced a broken part in our washing machine.
技师更换了我们洗衣机里一个损坏的零件。
Laboratory technicians play an essential role in medical research by preparing samples and maintaining specialist equipment.
实验室技术员通过准备样本和维护专业设备，在医学研究中发挥重要作用。
technician.t: technician 侧重设备操作维护，不等同于 engineer。

e: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。
Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。
My grandfather enjoys learning about the latest technological advances.
我祖父喜欢了解最新的科技进展。
Technological innovation can improve agricultural productivity while reducing the amount of water required for irrigation.
技术创新能够提高农业生产力，同时减少灌溉所需的水量。
technological.t: technological侧重科技发展，technical侧重具体技术。

e: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。
Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。
technology.t: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

e: Sorting all these old receipts is a tedious job.
整理这些旧收据是一件单调乏味的差事。
Automation can free employees from tedious tasks, allowing them to focus on more creative and rewarding work.
自动化可以让员工摆脱单调的任务，专注于更有创意和成就感的工作。
tedious.t: 常形容因耗时长或反复重复而乏味的任务。

e: The pond was teeming with tiny fish this morning.
今天早上，池塘里满是小鱼。
Healthy coral reefs teem with marine life, making their protection essential for maintaining ocean biodiversity.
健康的珊瑚礁生活着大量海洋生物，因此保护珊瑚礁对维持海洋生物多样性至关重要。
teem.t: 常用teem with，表示充满生物、人或活动。

e: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。
Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。
teenager.t: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

e: Telecommunication keeps our family connected despite the ocean between us.
虽然我们一家人远隔重洋，远程通信仍让我们保持联系。
Investment in telecommunication infrastructure can improve rural access to education, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
投资电信基础设施可以改善农村地区获取教育、医疗和就业机会的条件。
telecommunication.t: 谈电信行业或技术时，通常用复数telecommunications。

e: Grandmother kept the telegram announcing her brother's safe arrival.
祖母保存着那封告知她哥哥平安抵达的电报。
Before telephone services became widely available, sending a telegram was an important way to communicate urgent news.
在电话服务广泛普及之前，发电报是传递紧急消息的重要方式。
telegram.t: telegram是电报消息；telegraph指电报通信系统。

e: The museum guide demonstrated how the old telegraph worked.
博物馆讲解员演示了这台老式电报机的工作原理。
The telegraph transformed international communication by allowing information to travel much faster than physical mail.
电报使信息传递远快于实物邮件，从而改变了国际通信。
telegraph.t: telegraph 指通信系统或设备；telegram 指电报消息。

e: The telephone rang just as I opened the door.
我刚打开门，电话就响了。
Telephone consultations can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who live far from medical centres.
电话问诊可以让远离医疗中心的农村居民更方便地获得医疗服务。
telephone.t: telephone并非美式专用；日常通常简称phone。

e: We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.
我们在阳台上用望远镜观察月亮。
Space telescopes allow scientists to study distant galaxies without interference from the Earth's atmosphere.
太空望远镜让科学家能够不受地球大气干扰地研究遥远的星系。
telescope.t: 观星常用telescope；双筒望远镜通常叫binoculars。

e: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
晚饭后我们在电视上看了一档野生动物节目。
Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.
教育类电视节目可以让儿童接触难以在课堂上演示的科学概念。
television.t: watch television不加冠词；指一台电视机用a television。

e: Please tell me what happened at school today.
请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。
Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。
tell.t: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

e: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
抽屉又卡住了，他大发脾气。
Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
政府应认真考虑新技术可能带来的社会后果，避免一味热衷于推广。
temper.t: lose your temper 是发脾气；动词常用 temper A with B。

e: Our new puppy has a gentle temperament and rarely barks.
我们新养的小狗性情温顺，很少吠叫。
A calm temperament helps healthcare professionals communicate effectively with patients during stressful situations in busy hospitals.
在繁忙医院的紧张情境下，沉着的性情有助于医护人员与患者有效沟通。
temperament.t: temperament指惯常性情；temper常指脾气，尤指怒气。

e: We enjoy walking outdoors in this temperate climate.
这里气候温和，我们喜欢在户外散步。
Temperate regions may experience significant changes in rainfall patterns as global temperatures continue to rise.
随着全球气温持续上升，温带地区的降雨模式可能发生显著变化。
temperate.t: 气候义指不太冷也不太热；不等于热带的。

e: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。
Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。
temperature.t: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

e: We removed our shoes before entering the temple.
我们进入寺庙前脱了鞋。
Restoring an ancient temple can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in history and architecture.
修复古庙既可以保护当地遗产，也能吸引对历史和建筑感兴趣的游客。
temple.t: 表示太阳穴时，常用复数temples指两侧。

e: The drummer increased the tempo, and everyone danced faster.
鼓手加快了节奏，大家也跳得更快了。
The tempo of urban life has accelerated as digital services make daily tasks increasingly immediate.
随着数字服务让日常事务的处理越来越即时，城市生活节奏也加快了。
tempo.t: 指音乐的快慢，不等于表示节奏型的rhythm。

e: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
新书桌送来之前，先用这张临时桌子就行。
Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.
在家庭等待合适的永久住房期间，临时住处提供了必要的栖身之所。
temporary.t: 强调持续时间有限，反义词为permanent。

e: The fresh pastries tempted me to enter the bakery.
新鲜的酥点诱使我走进了面包店。
Heavy discounts may tempt consumers to purchase products they neither need nor originally intended to buy.
大幅折扣可能诱使消费者购买既不需要、也原本无意购买的产品。
tempt.t: 常用tempt sb to do或tempt sb into doing。

e: I resisted the temptation to eat another slice of cake.
我忍住了再吃一块蛋糕的诱惑。
Students may face the temptation to copy online material rather than develop their own ideas.
学生可能会受到诱惑，抄袭网上的材料，而不是形成自己的观点。
temptation.t: 常用the temptation to do，表示想做某事的诱惑。

e: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
我们核实后，他的借口就再也站不住脚了。
The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
经济增长总能改善公众福祉这一假设，已不能在所有情境下成立。
tenable.t: 常形容论点或立场站得住脚，不等于舒适。

e: The new tenant brought plants for the balcony.
新房客带来了几盆植物，准备放在阳台上。
Clear rental agreements protect both the tenant and the landlord by defining their responsibilities.
明确的租赁协议通过界定双方责任，保障房客和房东的权益。
tenant.t: tenant是租客，landlord是房东，二者是对应角色。

e: I tend to feel sleepy after a big lunch.
我午饭吃得多之后往往会犯困。
People tend to use public transport more frequently when services are reliable, affordable, and easy to access.
当公共交通可靠、价格合理且乘坐方便时，人们往往会更频繁地使用它。
tend.t: tend to do表示往往会；tend to someone表示照料。

e: The carrots were tender enough to mash with a fork.
胡萝卜很软嫩，用叉子就能压成泥。
Slow cooking makes tougher cuts of meat tender, allowing households to use less expensive ingredients.
慢炖能使较韧的肉块变嫩，让家庭可以选用价格较低的食材。
tender.t: 形容食物指嫩；形容身体部位可指一碰就疼。

e: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。
Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。
tennis.t: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

e: She looked tense while waiting outside the interview room.
她在面试室外等候时显得很紧张。
A tense working environment can reduce productivity and discourage employees from sharing creative ideas.
紧张的工作环境可能降低生产效率，并使员工不愿分享创新想法。
tense.t: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

e: Tension grew between the neighbours over the shared driveway.
邻居们因共用车道问题，关系越来越紧张。
Competition for limited water supplies can increase tension between farming communities and nearby cities.
争夺有限的水资源可能加剧农业社区与附近城市之间的紧张关系。
tension.t: 关系紧张常用tension between；多方矛盾可用复数。

e: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。
Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。
The octopus wrapped a tentacle around a small shell.
章鱼用一条触手缠住了一枚小贝壳。
Each tentacle helps the octopus explore its surroundings and capture food in complex marine habitats.
每条触手都帮助章鱼探索周围环境，并在复杂的海洋栖息地中捕食。
tentacle.t: 章鱼、水母的触手用tentacle；昆虫触角用antenna。

e: We made tentative plans to visit the coast next weekend.
我们暂定下周末去海边游玩。
Researchers have drawn tentative conclusions, but further studies are needed before the treatment can be widely recommended.
研究人员得出了初步结论，但在广泛推荐这种疗法之前，还需要进一步研究。
tentative.t: 既可指计划“暂定”，也可指动作“试探性”。

e: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。
The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。
term.t: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

e: Our bus stopped outside the airport terminal before sunrise.
日出前，我们的巴士停在了机场航站楼外。
A new passenger terminal could ease overcrowding, but its construction may disrupt nearby communities.
新建客运站可能缓解拥挤，但施工可能干扰附近社区。
terminal.t: terminal illness指致命且无法治愈的疾病。

e: We decided to terminate our gym membership last month.
我们上个月决定终止健身房会员资格。
Employers should not terminate contracts without providing clear reasons and allowing workers sufficient time to respond.
雇主终止合同时，应提供明确理由，并给予员工充足的回应时间。
terminate.t: 正式用词；可及物或不及物，列车终到用at。

e: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
我们在俯瞰花园的露台上吃了早餐。
Farmers maintain each terrace carefully to reduce soil erosion and grow crops on steep mountain slopes.
农民精心维护每一级梯田，以减少水土流失，并在陡峭的山坡上种植作物。
terrace.t: 露台通常是较大的室外平台，不等同于balcony。

e: Unlike fish, terrestrial animals spend their lives on land.
与鱼类不同，陆生动物在陆地上生活。
Protecting terrestrial habitats is essential because many species cannot survive outside their original ecosystems.
保护陆地栖息地至关重要，因为许多物种离开原有生态系统就无法生存。
The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
汤很难喝，于是我做了个三明治。
Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
垃圾管理不善可能给公共健康带来严重后果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。
terrible.t: terrible是形容词；表示“非常”通常用terribly。

e: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。
Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
社区花园为居民提供了极好的机会，让他们在户外锻炼的同时建立更紧密的社会联系。
terrific.t: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

e: Sudden thunder can terrify our dog during summer storms.
夏季暴风雨中突如其来的雷声会让我们家的狗非常害怕。
Extreme weather events can terrify young children, making clear explanations and reassurance from adults especially important.
极端天气事件可能让幼童十分恐惧，因此成人的清楚解释和安慰尤为重要。
terrify.t: 及物动词；terrified形容人，terrifying形容吓人的事物。

e: The island became part of the country's territory.
这座岛成为了该国领土的一部分。
As cities expand into wildlife territory, conflicts between humans and native animals may become more frequent.
随着城市扩张侵入野生动物的领地，人类与本土动物之间的冲突可能更加频繁。
territory.t: 领土义可不可数；一块辖区可用a territory。

e: She woke in terror after dreaming about a falling lift.
她梦见电梯坠落，惊恐地醒了过来。
Responsible news reporting should inform the public about threats without spreading unnecessary terror among communities.
负责任的新闻报道应向公众说明威胁，同时避免在社区中传播不必要的恐慌。
terror.t: 表示强烈恐惧，程度比fear深；通常不可数。

e: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
我明天在学校有拼写测验。
Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。
test.t: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

e: She agreed to testify about the accident she witnessed.
她同意就自己目睹的事故作证。
Residents were invited to testify in court about the effects of industrial pollution on their health.
居民受邀出庭，就工业污染对其健康的影响作证。
testify.t: testify that接从句；testify to接名词或动名词。

e: The text on this menu is too small.
这份菜单上的字太小了。
Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。
text.t: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

e: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
我把科学课本落在厨房桌上了。
Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。
textbook.t: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

e: The market stall sells colourful textiles for making curtains.
这个市场摊位出售用来做窗帘的彩色织物。
The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.
纺织业可以采用更清洁的生产方式并有效处理废水，从而减少水污染。
textile.t: 表示各类纺织品时常用复数textiles。

e: This blanket has a soft texture that feels lovely.
这条毯子质地柔软，摸起来很舒服。
The texture of recycled materials can influence whether consumers find sustainable products attractive.
再生材料的质地会影响消费者是否觉得可持续产品有吸引力。
texture.t: 既可描述材料的触感，也可描述食物的口感。

e: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
晚饭我们一起吃了一道美味的泰式咖喱。
Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.
泰国菜吸引着国际游客，也为当地餐馆和烹饪学校提供了宝贵的机会。
thai.t: Thai首字母始终大写；泰国是Thailand。

e: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
我的新背包比旧的轻。
Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。
than.t: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

e: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
谢谢你帮我把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼。
Public expressions of thanks can help volunteers feel valued and encourage continued participation in community projects.
公开表达感谢能让志愿者感到受重视，并鼓励他们持续参与社区项目。
thanks.t: thanks for后接名词或动名词；thanks to表示多亏。

e: They held a small thanksgiving ceremony after the harvest.
收获后，他们举行了一场小型感恩仪式。
In some countries, Thanksgiving brings families together and encourages reflection on the importance of community support.
在一些国家，感恩节让家人团聚，也促使人们思考社区互助的重要性。
thanksgiving.t: 指节日时首字母大写；泛指感恩时用小写。

e: Could you pass me that bowl beside the window?
你能把窗边的那个碗递给我吗？
Research suggests that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
研究表明，能够接触绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
that.t: 作指示词时复数为those；引导宾语从句常可省略。

e: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。
Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。
theatre.t: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

e: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。
Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.
有些家庭拥有自己的住房，另一些则因房价仍超出承受能力而租房居住。
theirs.t: theirs独立使用，后不接名词，也不加撇号。

e: We chose a seaside theme for the birthday party.
我们为生日聚会选了一个海滨主题。
The relationship between economic growth and environmental protection is a central theme in contemporary public debate.
经济增长与环境保护之间的关系是当代公共讨论的核心主题。
theme.t: theme侧重贯穿作品的思想；topic多指讨论话题。

e: My theory is that the cat knocked the cup over.
我猜是猫把杯子碰倒了。
Students benefit from courses that connect scientific theory with practical experiments and problems from everyday life.
将科学理论与实践实验及日常问题相结合的课程能让学生受益。
theory.t: in theory意为“理论上”，常与in practice对比。

e: After her injury, regular therapy helped her walk comfortably again.
受伤后，定期治疗帮助她重新自如地行走。
Schools that provide access to psychological therapy may better support students experiencing persistent anxiety.
提供心理治疗服务的学校可能更好地支持长期感到焦虑的学生。
therapy.t: 泛指治疗通常不可数；具体疗法可用复数。

e: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。
There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。
there.t: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

e: The shop opened in spring and closed shortly thereafter.
这家店春天开业，不久后就关门了。
The city introduced stricter vehicle standards, and air quality improved steadily in the years thereafter.
该市实施了更严格的车辆标准，此后几年空气质量持续改善。
thereafter.t: 正式用语，指前文时间点之后；日常常用after that。

e: She sealed the jar tightly, thereby keeping the biscuits fresh.
她把罐子封得严严实实，从而让饼干保持新鲜。
Cities can expand public transport networks, thereby reducing traffic congestion and improving air quality for residents.
城市可以扩展公共交通网络，从而缓解交通拥堵并改善居民呼吸的空气质量。
thereby.t: 常用逗号加thereby doing，说明前述行为的结果。

e: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。
Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。
therefore.t: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

e: We discussed dinner plans, or rather the lack thereof.
我们讨论了晚餐安排，确切说，是根本没有安排这回事。
Access to public transport, or the lack thereof, strongly influences employment opportunities in rural communities.
能否使用公共交通，会显著影响农村社区居民的就业机会。
thereof.t: 意为of that，常见于法律文体，不等于therefore。

e: Our thermal camera shows where heat escapes the house.
我们的热成像相机能显示房屋哪些地方在散热。
Improving thermal insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and make homes more comfortable during winter.
改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，让住宅在冬季更加舒适。
thermal.t: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

e: She placed the thermometer gently under her son's tongue.
她轻轻地把体温计放在儿子的舌下。
Accurate thermometers help researchers monitor temperature changes in natural habitats affected by global warming.
精确的温度计帮助研究人员监测受全球变暖影响的自然栖息地的温度变化。
thermometer.t: 重音在第二音节；测体温常用take someone's temperature。

e: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。
These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。
these.t: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

e: Leila spent the weekend checking references for her thesis.
莱拉整个周末都在核对学位论文的参考文献。
His thesis examines how access to public transport influences employment opportunities in disadvantaged urban communities.
他的学位论文探讨了公共交通的可及性如何影响城市弱势社区的就业机会。
thesis.t: 复数是theses；既可指学位论文，也可指核心论点。

e: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。
When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。
She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。
Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。
thick.t: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

e: My thighs ached after cycling up the steep hill.
骑车爬上陡坡后，我的大腿酸痛。
Regular cycling strengthens the thigh muscles and can improve overall fitness without excessive joint strain.
经常骑自行车能增强大腿肌肉、改善整体体能，又不会给关节带来过大负担。
thigh.t: 指髋部到膝盖之间；小腿通常用lower leg。

e: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。
Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。
thin.t: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

e: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？
One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。
thing.t: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

e: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。
Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。
think.t: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

e: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。
Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。
Cool water relieved my thirst after the long walk.
走了很长一段路后，凉水缓解了我的口渴。
Schools should nurture children's thirst for knowledge rather than focus exclusively on examination results.
学校应培养孩子们的求知欲，而不是只关注考试成绩。
thirst.t: 口渴常说be thirsty；thirst for表示对……的渴望。

e: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。
Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。
thirsty.t: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。

e: The soup needs another thirty minutes on the stove.
这锅汤还需要在炉子上再煮三十分钟。
The survey found that thirty per cent of residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
调查发现，百分之三十的居民在短途出行时更愿意骑车而不是开车。
thirty.t: thirty重音在前；thirteen重音通常在后。

e: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。
Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。
though.t: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

e: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。
Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。
thought.t: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

e: It was thoughtful of you to bring an umbrella.
你带了伞来，真是考虑周到。
Thoughtful urban planning can create public spaces that meet the needs of residents with limited mobility.
周到的城市规划能够打造满足行动不便居民需求的公共空间。
thoughtful.t: 体贴用thoughtful of someone；thoughtful不一定表示忧虑。

e: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
维修费总共将近一千美元。
Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.
连接郊区社区与市中心的新自行车道已让数千名居民受益。
thousand.t: 具体数词后不加s；泛指数千用thousands of。

e: I need some blue thread to mend this shirt.
我需要一些蓝线来补这件衬衫。
Clear transitions help readers follow the thread of an argument in a complex academic essay.
清晰的过渡能帮助读者理解复杂学术文章中的论证思路。
thread.t: lose the thread指跟不上谈话或文章的思路。

e: The rising river poses a threat to our village.
不断上涨的河水对我们村庄构成威胁。
Habitat destruction remains a major threat to biodiversity, particularly in regions experiencing rapid agricultural expansion.
栖息地破坏仍是生物多样性面临的重大威胁，在农业迅速扩张的地区尤其如此。
threat.t: 名词用 threat；动词用 threaten。

e: They threatened to cancel our booking unless we paid today.
他们威胁说，如果我们今天不付款，就取消我们的预订。
Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities by increasing the frequency of flooding and damaging essential infrastructure.
海平面上升增加了洪水发生的频率，并破坏重要基础设施，危及沿海社区。
threaten.t: threaten to do指威胁要做；threaten sth可指危及某物。

e: My brother has a much higher pain threshold than me.
我哥哥比我耐疼得多。
Raising the income threshold for financial assistance would allow more low-paid workers to receive support.
提高经济援助的收入门槛，将使更多低薪劳动者能够获得支持。
threshold.t: on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。

e: Her thrift helped her save enough for a bicycle.
她勤俭节约，终于攒够了买自行车的钱。
Teaching thrift in schools can help young people manage limited incomes and avoid unnecessary debt.
在学校培养节俭意识可以帮助年轻人管理有限的收入，避免不必要的债务。
thrift.t: thrift 是名词；形容词“节俭的”是 thrifty。

e: I felt a real thrill when the kite finally flew.
风筝终于飞起来时，我感到一阵真正的兴奋。
The thrill of discovery can motivate students to explore scientific questions beyond the classroom.
发现新事物带来的兴奋感可以激励学生在课堂之外探索科学问题。
thrill.t: thrilled表示人很兴奋；thrilling表示事物令人兴奋。

e: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。
A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。
thriller.t: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

e: These herbs thrive on our sunny kitchen windowsill.
这些香草在我们厨房阳光充足的窗台上长得很旺。
Small businesses are more likely to thrive when local governments provide reliable infrastructure and accessible financial support.
地方政府提供可靠的基础设施和便利的资金支持时，小企业更有可能蓬勃发展。
thrive.t: 不及物动词；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

e: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。
Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。
throat.t: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

e: The queen sat on a throne beside the window.
女王坐在窗边的王座上。
Her accession to the throne marked a significant change in the country's political relationship with its neighbours.
她登基标志着该国与邻国的政治关系发生了重大变化。
throne.t: the throne可指王位，不一定指实体座椅。

e: We pushed through the throng to reach the exit.
我们挤过人群，来到出口。
Throngs of visitors can place considerable pressure on historic sites during the peak tourist season.
在旅游旺季，大批游客可能给历史遗址带来相当大的压力。
throng.t: 偏书面；a throng of后接复数名词。

e: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。
Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。
through.t: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

e: The smell of fresh bread spread throughout the house.
新鲜面包的香味飘满了整栋房子。
Reliable internet access throughout rural areas is essential for reducing inequalities in education and employment.
在农村地区全面提供可靠的互联网接入，对减少教育和就业方面的不平等至关重要。
throughout.t: throughout强调整个范围或全程，不只是某一点。

e: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。
Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。
throw.t: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

e: He thrust his hands deep into his coat pockets.
他猛地把双手插进大衣口袋深处。
The main thrust of the proposal is to improve public transport rather than build additional roads.
这项提案的重点是改善公共交通，而非增建道路。
thrust.t: 过去式和过去分词均为thrust；要旨常用the thrust of。

e: I accidentally hit my thumb while hanging a picture.
挂画时，我不小心砸到了拇指。
Many readers thumb through printed magazines before deciding which articles deserve their full attention.
许多读者会先快速翻阅纸质杂志，再决定仔细阅读哪些文章。
thumb.t: b不发音；thumb through表示快速翻阅。

e: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。
Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。
thunder.t: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

e: We stayed indoors while the thunderstorm shook the windows.
雷雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
Severe thunderstorms can disrupt transport networks and cause sudden flooding, particularly in cities with inadequate drainage.
强雷暴会扰乱交通网络并引发突发洪水，排水设施不足的城市尤其如此。
We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。
The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。
thursday.t: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

e: The road was flooded; thus, we took another route.
道路被淹了，因此我们改走了另一条路。
Improved public transport can reduce dependence on private cars, thus lowering emissions and easing urban congestion.
改善公共交通可以减少对私家车的依赖，从而降低排放并缓解城市拥堵。
thus.t: thus是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立句。

e: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
那只旧钟在我的床边轻轻地滴答作响。
Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。
I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。
Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。
ticket.t: 英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

e: The kitten's whiskers tickled my wrist as it sniffed.
小猫凑过来闻时，胡须弄得我的手腕痒痒的。
Humorous advertisements often tickle viewers while making ordinary household products seem more appealing to potential buyers.
幽默广告常常逗乐观众，同时让普通家居用品对潜在买家更有吸引力。
tickle.t: tickle指挠痒；scratch多指用指甲抓挠。

e: At low tide, we walked across the exposed sand.
退潮时，我们走过露出的沙地。
Coastal planners must consider how rising sea levels and high tides could threaten homes and transport infrastructure.
沿海规划者必须考虑海平面上升和高潮位可能如何威胁住宅及交通基础设施。
tide.t: tide是海水的周期性涨落，wave是单个波浪。

e: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。
Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。
tidy.t: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

e: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。
Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。
tie.t: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

e: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。
Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。
tiger.t: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

e: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。
Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。
tight.t: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。

e: Please tighten the lid before you shake the bottle.
请先拧紧瓶盖，再摇瓶子。
Governments should tighten safety regulations to ensure that all new housing meets acceptable standards of construction.
政府应加强安全监管，确保所有新建住房达到合格的建筑标准。
tighten.t: 可及物也可不及物：tighten a rope；the rope tightens。

e: One blue tile has cracked beside the kitchen sink.
厨房水槽旁的一块蓝色瓷砖裂了。
Using locally produced roof tiles can reduce transport emissions and support traditional industries in rural areas.
使用本地生产的屋顶瓦片可以减少运输排放，并支持农村地区的传统产业。
tile.t: 可数名词；作动词时直接接要铺砖的表面。

e: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。
Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。
till.t: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

e: The carpenter stacked the timber beside the workshop.
木匠把木料堆在了工坊旁边。
Using responsibly sourced timber in construction can reduce environmental damage while supporting sustainable forest management.
在建筑中使用来源负责任的木材，既能减少环境破坏，也能支持可持续森林管理。
timber.t: 指木材时通常不可数；美式英语常用lumber指加工木料。

e: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
晚饭前我们还有时间散步。
Schools should give students enough time to explore creative activities alongside their preparation for formal examinations.
学校应在学生准备正式考试的同时，给予他们足够的时间探索创意活动。
time.t: 时间通常不可数；表示次数时可数，如three times。

e: I checked the timetable before leaving for the station.
去车站前，我查看了时刻表。
A flexible school timetable can help students balance academic subjects with physical activity and creative learning.
灵活的学校课程表有助于学生兼顾文化课、体育活动和创造性学习。
There is a tin of beans in the cupboard.
橱柜里有一罐豆子。
Reusing a metal tin for storage can reduce household waste and the need for new containers.
重复利用金属罐储物，可以减少生活垃圾以及对新容器的需求。
tin.t: 罐子义可数，英式常用tin，美式常用can；锡不可数。

e: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。
Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。
tiny.t: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

e: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。
Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。
tip.t: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

e: Long walks tire my grandfather, so we stop often.
长时间走路会让爷爷疲倦，所以我们经常停下来。
Students may tire of repetitive exercises unless teachers introduce varied activities that encourage active participation.
学生可能会厌倦重复的练习，除非教师引入多样化活动，鼓励他们积极参与。
tire.t: 动词英美均用tire；轮胎的英式拼写为tyre。

e: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
散步后我累得不想做饭。
Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。
tired.t: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

e: Sorting these tiny screws is such a tiresome job.
把这些小螺丝分类真是件烦人的差事。
Repeated administrative checks can become tiresome for teachers and reduce the time available for lesson preparation.
反复的行政检查会让教师感到厌烦，并压缩备课时间。
She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。
Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。
tissue.t: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

e: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。
An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。
title.t: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

e: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
我趁烤面包片还热着，在上面抹了黄油。
A simple breakfast of toast and fruit can help students maintain their energy during morning lessons.
一顿由烤面包片和水果组成的简单早餐，有助于学生在上午上课时保持精力。
toast.t: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。

e: The farmer hung tobacco leaves inside a wooden barn.
农民把烟叶挂在木制谷仓里。
Higher taxes on tobacco products can discourage smoking and generate revenue for public health programmes.
提高烟草制品税可以抑制吸烟，并为公共卫生项目筹集资金。
tobacco.t: 通常为不可数名词；一片烟叶用a tobacco leaf。

e: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。
Today, many universities offer flexible courses that allow students to combine employment with further education.
如今，许多大学开设灵活的课程，让学生能够兼顾工作和继续教育。
today.t: today既可指今天，也可泛指当今；前面不用on。

e: There is a little sand stuck between my toes.
我的脚趾缝里沾了一点沙子。
Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.
穿限制脚趾活动的鞋子可能影响平衡，长此以往还可能导致足部问题。
toe.t: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

e: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。
Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。
