voice.t: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

e: Fuel prices have been unusually volatile this month.
这个月燃油价格波动异常剧烈。
Volatile food prices make it difficult for low-income households to plan their spending and maintain a balanced diet.
食品价格波动不定，使低收入家庭难以规划开支并维持均衡饮食。
volatile.t: 既可描述市场波动，也可指情绪易变或物质易挥发。

e: We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
我们望着湖对岸的火山，看蒸汽从山中升起。
Although an active volcano can threaten nearby communities, volcanic soils often provide valuable land for agriculture.
虽然活火山会威胁附近社区，但火山土壤往往能为农业提供宝贵的土地。
We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。
Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。
volleyball.t: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。

e: This small battery supplies just one and a half volts.
这节小电池只能提供一点五伏的电压。
Engineers measure electrical potential difference in volts when designing safe and efficient systems for homes and factories.
工程师为住宅和工厂设计安全高效的系统时，用伏特来计量电势差。
volt.t: 伏特衡量电压；瓦特 watt 衡量功率。

e: Please turn the volume down while the baby sleeps.
宝宝睡觉时请把音量调低。
The growing volume of household waste highlights the need for better recycling facilities in urban areas.
不断增加的生活垃圾量凸显了城市地区改善回收设施的必要性。
volume.t: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

e: Joining the weekend walking group is completely voluntary.
参加周末步行小组完全出于自愿。
Voluntary work can help young people develop practical skills while contributing to their local communities.
志愿工作既能帮助年轻人培养实用技能，也能让他们为当地社区作贡献。
A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。
Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。
volunteer.t: 自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。

e: The rough boat ride made several passengers vomit.
船在航行中剧烈颠簸，导致几位乘客呕吐。
Patients who vomit repeatedly may become dehydrated and should seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
反复呕吐的患者可能出现脱水，若症状持续，应咨询医生。
vomit.t: 名词指呕吐物；呕吐这一过程常用vomiting。

e: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
我们投票决定在公园里野餐。
Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.
允许居民就地方项目投票，可能提高公众参与社区发展的积极性。
vote.t: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

e: She made a vow to visit her grandmother weekly.
她郑重承诺每周都去看望祖母。
Local leaders vowed to protect public parks despite growing pressure to develop more housing.
尽管增加住房建设的压力越来越大，当地领导人仍承诺保护公共公园。
vow.t: 动词常用vow to do或vow that从句。

e: Our teacher stretched the vowel sound as we listened.
老师把元音拉长，让我们仔细听。
Recognising differences between vowel sounds can help language learners understand unfamiliar accents and communicate more clearly.
辨别元音之间的差异有助于语言学习者理解陌生口音，并更清晰地交流。
vowel.t: a或an的选择看后接词的首音是否为元音，不看字母。

e: His vulgar joke made everyone at dinner uncomfortable.
他的粗俗笑话让餐桌上的每个人都感到不自在。
Some viewers argue that vulgar humour on television can encourage disrespectful behaviour among younger audiences.
一些观众认为，电视上的粗俗幽默可能会助长年轻观众不尊重他人的行为。
vulgar.t: 现代常用义带贬义，不宜用来表示“普通的”。

e: Young plants are vulnerable to frost on cold nights.
幼苗在寒冷的夜晚容易遭受霜冻。
Local authorities should provide additional support for vulnerable residents during periods of extreme heat.
在极端高温期间，地方政府应为易受影响的居民提供额外支持。
vulnerable.t: 常用 vulnerable to，to 后接名词。

e: The puppy wagged its tail when I came home.
我回家时，小狗摇起了尾巴。
Although dogs often wag their tails during friendly encounters, this movement does not always indicate happiness.
虽然狗在友好互动时经常摇尾巴，但这一动作并不总是表示开心。
wag.t: 过去式wagged，现在分词wagging，均双写g。

e: The café pays a decent wage for weekend work.
这家咖啡馆给周末上班的员工支付不错的工资。
Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。
wage.t: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

e: The horse pulled a wagon loaded with fresh apples.
马拉着一辆装满新鲜苹果的货车。
Before modern roads developed, farmers relied on horse-drawn wagons to transport their produce to regional markets.
在现代道路发展起来之前，农民依靠马拉货车将农产品运到地区市场。
wagon.t: 英国英语也写作waggon；铁路义主要用于英式英语。

e: These trousers fit perfectly around my waist now.
这条裤子的腰围现在正好适合我。
Measuring waist size can help health professionals assess certain risks associated with excess body fat.
测量腰围能帮助医护人员评估与体脂过多相关的某些风险。
waist.t: waist指腰，与表示浪费的waste同音。

e: Please wait here while I find my keys.
请在这里等一下，我去找钥匙。
Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
由于当地医疗服务有限，农村地区的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受专科治疗。
wait.t: 等人用wait for someone；等着做用wait to do。

e: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。
A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。
waiter.t: waiter传统上指男服务员；server更不强调性别。

e: The waitress brought us warm bread and fresh soup.
女服务员给我们端来了温热的面包和新鲜的汤。
Working as a waitress can help students develop communication skills while earning money to support their studies.
当餐厅服务员能帮助学生培养沟通能力，同时赚钱支付学习费用。
waitress.t: waitress特指女性；server可不区分性别。

e: Please wake me before you leave for work.
请在你出门上班前叫醒我。
People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。
wake.t: 过去式woke，过去分词woken；常与up连用。

e: Birdsong wakened me before the sun came up.
太阳还没升起，鸟鸣就把我唤醒了。
Residents living near airports may be wakened repeatedly by aircraft noise, which can affect their overall health.
住在机场附近的居民可能反复被飞机噪声吵醒，进而影响整体健康。
waken.t: 比wake少见、较书面；过去式和过去分词均为wakened。

e: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。
Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
安全的人行道和宜人的公共空间能鼓励居民短途出行时步行而不开车。
walk.t: 字母l不发音；walk the dog意为遛狗。

e: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
我们在厨房墙上挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.
覆盖植物的绿墙可以改善空气质量，并减少拥挤城区的热量。
wall.t: 图片挂在墙上用on；嵌在墙内用in。

e: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。
As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。
wallet.t: wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

e: She cracked a walnut and shared the kernel with me.
她敲开一个核桃，把核桃仁分给了我一些。
Growing walnut trees can provide farmers with additional income while increasing tree cover in rural areas.
种植核桃树既能为农民增加收入，又能提高农村地区的树木覆盖率。
walnut.t: 指核桃或树时可数，指核桃木材时不可数。

e: We wandered through the market and bought some peaches.
我们在市场里闲逛，买了些桃子。
Visitors who wander beyond popular tourist areas often discover local businesses that benefit from additional spending.
走出热门旅游区随意逛逛的游客，常能发现一些因额外消费而受益的当地商家。
wander.t: wander指漫游；wonder指想知道，注意拼写。

e: My enthusiasm waned after another hour in the queue.
又排了一个小时的队后，我的热情消退了。
Public support for environmental policies may wane if their financial costs are distributed unfairly.
如果环保政策的经济成本分担不公，公众对这些政策的支持可能会减弱。
wane.t: 动词通常不及物；on the wane表示正在衰退。

e: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。
Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。
want.t: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

e: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。
War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。
war.t: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

e: A nurse brought fresh blankets into the children's ward.
一名护士把干净的毯子送进了儿科病房。
Expanding hospital wards alone will not improve healthcare unless sufficient trained staff are also available.
如果没有足够的专业医护人员，仅扩建医院病区并不能改善医疗服务。
ward.t: 作动词通常用ward off，表示抵挡、避开。

e: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
她的冬季外套占了衣柜的大部分空间。
Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
减少衣物数量并选择耐穿的服装，可以降低时尚消费对环境的影响。
wardrobe.t: 既指衣柜，也可指某人拥有的全部衣物。

e: The potter displayed her glazed ware on wooden shelves.
那位陶艺师把自己的上釉陶器摆在木架上。
Local markets allow craftspeople to sell their wares directly, supporting traditional skills and small businesses.
当地市场让手艺人能够直接出售商品，从而支持传统技艺和小企业的发展。
ware.t: 指待售商品通常用wares；ware常见于复合词。

e: The warehouse behind the station stores furniture and kitchen equipment.
车站后面的仓库存放着家具和厨房设备。
Locating a warehouse near major transport routes can reduce delivery costs and improve supply chain efficiency.
将仓库设在主要运输线路附近可以降低配送成本，提高供应链效率。
warehouse.t: 指储存货物的大型建筑；动词用法较正式。

e: The museum shows how warfare changed over centuries.
这座博物馆展示了几个世纪以来作战方式的变化。
Modern warfare can damage essential infrastructure, leaving communities without reliable access to water and electricity.
现代战争可能破坏重要基础设施，使社区无法稳定获得水电供应。
warfare.t: 不可数，强调作战活动或方式；war可指一场战争。

e: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。
A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
学校的热情欢迎能帮助新生获得归属感，并建立自信。
warm.t: warm比hot温度低；warm to某人指渐渐喜欢对方。

e: We enjoyed the warmth of the fire after our walk.
散步回来后，我们享受着炉火的温暖。
The warmth of community relationships can help older residents feel supported and reduce their sense of isolation.
社区人际关系中的温情能让老年居民感受到支持，减少他们的孤独感。
warmth.t: 通常不可数；既指温度舒适，也指待人亲切。

e: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
如果锅太烫，请提醒我。
Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
科学家警告说，栖息地持续减少可能使更多物种面临灭绝风险。
warn.t: warn后可接that从句；warn sb not to do表示告诫。

e: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
听到向导提醒岩石湿滑后，我们折返了。
Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。
warning.t: warning是名词，也可作warn的现在分词。

e: The officers obtained a warrant before searching the apartment.
警员在搜查这套公寓前取得了搜查令。
The potential environmental risks warrant further investigation before the government approves construction of the new industrial facility.
在政府批准建设新的工业设施之前，潜在的环境风险值得进一步调查。
warrant.t: 动词常指值得或有必要，如warrant attention。

e: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。
Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。
wash.t: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。

e: There is a washroom just beside the lifts.
电梯旁边就有一间洗手间。
Every public library should provide an accessible washroom to accommodate visitors with a range of mobility needs.
每座公共图书馆都应配备无障碍洗手间，以满足行动能力各异的访客的需求。
washroom.t: 主要用于北美，尤其加拿大；英国常说toilet。

e: A wasp landed on the edge of my glass.
一只黄蜂落在了我的杯口上。
Although wasps are often considered pests, many species help control insects that damage agricultural crops.
虽然黄蜂常被视为害虫，但许多种类能帮助控制危害农作物的昆虫。
wasp.t: wasp是黄蜂，bee是蜜蜂；两者不是同一种昆虫。

e: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。
Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。
waste.t: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

e: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。
Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。
watch.t: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

e: Please water the plants before we leave today.
今天出门前请给植物浇水。
Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
获得清洁的饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共健康至关重要。
water.t: 表示水通常不可数：a glass of water是一杯水。

e: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。
Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。
waterfall.t: 可数名词：一处瀑布用a waterfall。

e: We walked along the waterfront after an early dinner.
我们早早吃完晚饭后沿着水岸散步。
Redeveloping the waterfront can create attractive public spaces, provided that existing residents are not forced to leave.
滨水区改造可以创造宜人的公共空间，前提是不迫使原有居民搬离。
waterfront.t: 指城镇临水地带，不一定是沙滩或海边。

e: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。
Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。
watermelon.t: 整个西瓜可数；指切开的瓜肉时常不可数。

e: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
暴风雨中，我的防水夹克让我没有淋湿。
Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.
户外工作者需要防水衣物，以便在潮湿天气作业时保持舒适并得到保护。
waterproof.t: water-resistant仅指有一定抗水能力，防水程度较弱。

e: This watertight box keeps my camera dry during boat trips.
这个密封防水盒让我乘船出游时相机也能保持干燥。
Governments need watertight regulations to prevent companies from avoiding responsibility for environmental damage caused by their operations.
政府需要严密的法规，防止企业逃避其经营活动造成的环境损害责任。
watertight.t: 既指不漏水，也可形容论证或协议严密。

e: This small lamp uses only five watts of power.
这盏小灯的功率只有五瓦。
Comparing the watts required by different appliances helps consumers choose models that use less electricity.
比较不同电器所需的瓦数，有助于消费者选择更省电的型号。
watt.t: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。

e: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。
Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。
wave.t: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

e: Warm wax dripped from the candle onto the table.
温热的蜡从蜡烛上滴到了桌子上。
A thin layer of wax can protect fresh fruit and reduce moisture loss during transport.
一层薄蜡可以保护新鲜水果，并减少运输过程中的水分流失。
wax.t: wax作蜡时通常不可数；月亮渐盈与wane相反。

e: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。
Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。
way.t: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

e: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。
Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。
weak.t: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

e: Too little sleep can weaken your ability to concentrate.
睡眠不足会削弱你的专注能力。
Persistent unemployment can weaken local economies by reducing household spending and discouraging business investment.
持续失业会减少家庭支出并抑制企业投资，从而削弱地方经济。
weaken.t: 既可及物也可不及物：使变弱或自身变弱。

e: My main weakness in cooking is getting the timing right.
我做饭的主要短板是掌握不好时间。
The recent transport disruption exposed a serious weakness in the city's emergency planning system.
最近的交通中断暴露了该市应急规划体系中的一个严重弱点。
weakness.t: 弱点通常可数；虚弱不可数；偏爱用a weakness for。

e: His wealth allowed him to buy a spacious house.
他的财富使他能够买下一栋宽敞的房子。
A fairer distribution of wealth could improve access to education and reduce inequality across society.
更公平地分配财富可以改善受教育机会，并减少社会不平等。
wealth.t: wealth通常不可数；a wealth of表示大量有价值的事物。

e: A wealthy neighbour donated new equipment to our playground.
一位富裕的邻居为我们的游乐场捐赠了新设备。
Wealthy countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
富裕国家可以通过投资较贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。
wealthy.t: the wealthy指富人群体；wealthy本身是形容词。

e: The museum displays an ancient weapon behind thick glass.
博物馆将一件古代兵器陈列在厚玻璃后。
Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.
更严格地管控武器销售可能有助于政府改善公共安全并减少暴力犯罪。
weapon.t: 可数名词；武器的总称也可用weaponry。

e: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。
Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。
wear.t: wear强调穿戴状态，put on强调动作；过去式wore。

e: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
日落前，疲惫的徒步者们在溪边休息。
Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
通勤路途漫长的人到家后往往疲惫不堪，无力锻炼或好好陪伴家人。
weary.t: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

e: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
就在我们野餐前，天气转晴了。
Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.
极端天气会扰乱粮食生产，并推高弱势社区基本商品的价格。
weather.t: 表示天气时不可数；climate指长期气候特征。

e: My aunt taught me to weave a small basket.
姑姑教我编了一个小篮子。
Effective documentaries weave personal stories into broader discussions of social change and public policy.
优秀的纪录片将个人故事融入对社会变迁和公共政策的更广泛讨论中。
weave.t: 编织义过去式 wove，过去分词 woven。

e: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
我在网上找到了一份简单的汤谱。
Although the web provides convenient access to information, students must learn to evaluate the reliability of online sources.
虽然万维网让获取信息更方便，但学生必须学会评估网络来源的可靠性。
web.t: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

e: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
我在博物馆的网站上查到了开放时间。
A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.
设计良好的政府网站能让偏远地区的居民更便捷地获取公共服务。
website.t: 在网站上用on a website；webpage指单个网页。

e: Their wedding took place in a small garden.
他们的婚礼在一个小花园里举行。
Wedding traditions often reflect cultural values, although many couples now choose simpler and less expensive celebrations.
婚礼习俗往往反映文化价值观，不过如今许多新人选择更简单、费用更低的庆祝方式。
He slid a wooden wedge under the heavy door.
他把一个木楔塞到沉重的门下面。
Disagreements over resource allocation can drive a wedge between neighbouring communities and weaken regional cooperation.
资源分配上的分歧可能导致相邻社区失和，并削弱区域合作。
wedge.t: drive a wedge between 比喻挑起隔阂或分裂。

e: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。
The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。
wednesday.t: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

e: A stubborn weed has grown between the paving stones.
铺路石的缝隙间长出了一株顽强的杂草。
Farmers can control weeds without chemicals by rotating crops and covering exposed soil with organic material.
农民可以通过轮作和用有机材料覆盖裸露土壤，在不使用化学药剂的情况下控制杂草。
weed.t: weed out可比喻剔除不合适的人或事物。

e: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。
The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。
Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。
weekday.t: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

e: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。
Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。
weekend.t: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

e: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
我们每周的购物之行通常以去面包店收尾。
Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。
weekly.t: 既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。

e: He began to weep when his lost dog returned.
走失的狗回来时，他流下了眼泪。
Emotional scenes in films can make audiences weep while encouraging greater empathy for people facing difficult circumstances.
电影中的感人场景能够使观众落泪，同时增进他们对身处困境者的共情。
weep.t: 过去式和过去分词均为wept；比cry更书面。

e: Please weigh these apples before putting them in the bag.
请先称一下这些苹果，再装进袋子。
Governments must weigh the economic benefits of tourism against its potential damage to local ecosystems.
政府必须权衡旅游业的经济收益与其可能对当地生态系统造成的损害。
weigh.t: weigh是动词，weight是名词；表示重多少不用被动语态。

e: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。
Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。
weight.t: weight是名词；weigh是动词：How much does it weigh?

e: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
邻居们走到外面，欢迎我们回家。
Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。
welcome.t: be welcome to do表示可随意做；You're welcome用于回应感谢。

e: Wearing a protective mask, she welded the metal frame.
她戴着防护面罩，焊接了那个金属框架。
Workers who weld steel structures need proper training and protective equipment to reduce workplace injuries.
焊接钢结构的工人需要接受适当培训并配备防护装备，以减少工伤。
weld.t: weld A to B表示把A焊接到B上。

e: The shelter puts the welfare of its animals first.
这家收容所把动物的健康和幸福放在首位。
Governments should protect children's welfare by ensuring access to nutritious food and safe housing.
政府应确保儿童获得营养食物和安全住房，以保障他们的福祉。
welfare.t: 不可数名词；作前置修饰语时也仍是名词。

e: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
暑假期间，我们参观了一座著名的城堡。
Well-known tourist destinations often face overcrowding, which can damage historic sites and reduce residents' quality of life.
著名旅游目的地常面临过度拥挤的问题，这可能损坏历史遗迹并降低居民的生活质量。
well-known.t: 名词前通常加连字符；表语位置通常写well known。

e: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
我们厨房的窗户朝西，能照到傍晚的阳光。
Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
对该国西部的投资可以缩小地区差距，并创造就业机会。
west.t: 方位一般小写；the West指西方国家时大写。

e: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。
Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。
western.t: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

e: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。
Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。
A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。
Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。
whale.t: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼；复数通常为whales。

e: The harbour museum has an exhibition about whaling.
港口博物馆有一个关于捕鲸的展览。
Commercial whaling has contributed to declining whale populations, prompting international efforts to protect these marine mammals.
商业捕鲸导致鲸类数量下降，促使国际社会努力保护这些海洋哺乳动物。
whaling.t: 不可数名词；谈捕鲸禁令用ban on whaling。

e: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
今晚晚餐你想吃什么都可以选。
Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.
无论背景如何，学生都应平等地获得优质教育和适当的学习支持。
whatever.t: whatever不限范围；whichever常指限定范围内任选。

e: Golden wheat swayed in the field behind our house.
我们屋后的田野里，金黄的小麦随风摇曳。
Prolonged droughts can reduce wheat harvests, raising food prices and threatening food security in vulnerable regions.
长期干旱会导致小麦减产，推高食品价格，并威胁脆弱地区的粮食安全。
wheat.t: wheat通常不可数；一粒小麦用a grain of wheat。

e: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
我的自行车前轮需要更换。
Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。
wheel.t: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

e: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。
Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。
wheelchair.t: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

e: When does the next bus leave for town?
下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？
When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.
当城市投资建设可靠的公共交通时，居民就更可能不开私家车出行。
when.t: 表将来的时间从句中，when后通常用一般现在时。

e: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
每当我煮汤时，我的猫就守在炉子旁边。
Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.
每当城市扩张时，规划者都应考虑新开发项目将如何影响现有社区和当地野生动物。
whenever.t: 引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时，不用will。

e: We have an arrangement whereby we share the cooking.
我们有个安排，轮流负责做饭。
Schools could introduce a system whereby older students provide academic support to younger pupils after lessons.
学校可以引入一种制度，让高年级学生在课后为低年级学生提供学业帮助。
whereby.t: 正式关系副词，常接在system等词后，相当于by which。

e: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
你觉得哪里最舒服，就可以坐在哪里。
Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。
wherever.t: 表示“无论哪里”时，相当于no matter where。

e: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？
Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。
which.t: which常用于限定范围内的选择；what范围更开放。

e: An old leather whip hung beside the stable door.
马厩门旁挂着一根旧皮鞭。
During practical lessons, culinary students learn to whip cream and prepare healthier alternatives to commercial desserts.
在实操课上，烹饪专业学生学习打发奶油，并制作比市售甜点更健康的替代品。
whip.t: whip cream是打发奶油；双写p加-ed或-ing。

e: Dry leaves whirled around us in the wind.
干枯的树叶在风中绕着我们打转。
As urban life accelerates, many workers become caught in a whirl of meetings and deadlines.
随着城市生活节奏加快，许多上班族陷入接连不断的会议和截止期限之中。
whirl.t: give it a whirl是口语，意为“试一试”。

e: The guide showed us barrels used for ageing whisky.
导游向我们展示了用于陈酿威士忌的木桶。
Traditional whisky production attracts tourists to rural areas and supports employment in farming, manufacturing, and hospitality.
传统威士忌生产吸引游客前往乡村地区，并带动农业、制造业和酒店餐饮业的就业。
whisky.t: 苏格兰酒常拼whisky，爱尔兰和美国酒常拼whiskey。

e: Please whisper while the baby sleeps in the next room.
宝宝在隔壁睡觉，请小声说话。
Students may whisper during individual tasks because they need reassurance rather than because they intend to disrupt lessons.
学生在独立完成任务时低声交谈，可能是为了寻求确认，而非有意扰乱课堂。
whisper.t: 对某人低语用whisper to someone；低声说用in a whisper。

e: My brother whistles cheerful tunes while washing the dishes.
我哥哥洗碗时会吹欢快的小曲。
Lifeguards use whistles to attract swimmers' attention quickly when dangerous conditions develop near the shore.
岸边出现危险情况时，救生员用哨子迅速引起游泳者的注意。
whistle.t: whistle中的t不发音；吹哨子用blow a whistle。

e: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。
Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。
Whoever finishes first can choose the next game.
谁先完成，谁就可以选择下一个游戏。
Public libraries should welcome whoever needs access to reliable information, regardless of their income or educational background.
公共图书馆应欢迎任何需要获取可靠信息的人，不论其收入或教育背景如何。
whoever.t: 可引导名词性或让步从句；并非所有场合都能换成no matter who。

e: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。
Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。
whole.t: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。

e: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？
Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。
whose.t: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

e: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？
Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。
why.t: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

e: The wicked queen locked every garden gate in the kingdom.
邪恶的王后锁上了王国里所有花园的大门。
Traditional stories often contrast wicked characters with kind heroes to help children understand the consequences of moral choices.
传统故事常将邪恶角色与善良主人公作对比，帮助儿童理解道德选择的后果。
wicked.t: 通常比bad语气强；形容笑容时可指淘气而非邪恶。

e: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。
Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。
wide.t: wide表示张开程度；widely常表示广泛地。

e: This fruit is widely available in local shops.
这种水果在当地商店里随处可买到。
Although online learning is widely accepted, access to reliable internet connections still varies considerably between regions.
尽管在线学习已被广泛接受，各地区获得稳定网络连接的条件仍有很大差异。
widely.t: widely指范围广；wide还可表示充分张开。

e: The widow next door invited us over for tea.
住在隔壁的那位丧偶女士邀请我们去喝茶。
A widow living alone may benefit from community programmes that offer companionship and practical support.
独居的丧偶女性可能受益于提供陪伴和实际帮助的社区项目。
widow.t: widow指丧偶女性；丧偶男性用widower。

e: Check the width of the sofa before buying it.
买沙发前先确认一下它的宽度。
Increasing the width of pavements can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make walking more comfortable.
加宽人行道可以方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让步行更舒适。
His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。
A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。
wife.t: 复数为wives；spouse指配偶，不限定性别。

e: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。
Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。
wild.t: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

e: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。
Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。
wildlife.t: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

e: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
我愿意这周末帮你搬家。
Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。
willing.t: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。

e: My neighbour willingly watered the plants while I was away.
我不在家时，邻居欣然帮我给植物浇水。
Residents are more likely to participate willingly in recycling schemes when collection services are convenient and reliable.
当回收服务便利且可靠时，居民更可能自愿参与回收计划。
willingly.t: 强调自愿而非被迫；不等于单纯“开心地”。

e: Her willingness to help made the move much easier.
她乐意帮忙，让这次搬家轻松了许多。
Students' willingness to ask questions often increases when teachers create a supportive classroom environment.
教师营造支持性的课堂环境时，学生提问的意愿往往会增强。
willingness.t: 不可数名词，常接to do表示做某事的意愿。

e: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。
To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。
win.t: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

e: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。
Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。
Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。
window.t: 电脑窗口也叫window；机会之窗强调时机有限。

e: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
一路上，大雨不断拍打着汽车的挡风玻璃。
A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.
受损的挡风玻璃会影响视野，因此定期检查车辆对维护道路安全至关重要。
windscreen.t: 英式英语用windscreen，美式英语通常用windshield。

e: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。
Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。
windy.t: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

e: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
这家餐馆在这款蘑菇酱里加了少量葡萄酒。
Climate change is affecting wine production as rising temperatures alter grape quality and harvest times.
气候变化正在影响葡萄酒生产，因为气温上升改变了葡萄品质和采收时间。
wine.t: 泛指葡萄酒时不可数；多种葡萄酒可用wines。

e: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。
The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。
wing.t: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

e: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
姐姐隔着餐桌朝我眨了一只眼。
A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.
友善的眨眼可能传达彼此的默契，但其含义在不同文化间可能有很大差异。
wink.t: wink常指单眼示意；blink指自然眨眼。

e: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。
Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。
winner.t: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

e: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。
Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。
winter.t: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

e: Please wipe the table before you put the plates down.
请先擦一下桌子，再摆盘子。
Schools should encourage pupils to wipe shared equipment after use to help maintain a hygienic learning environment.
学校应鼓励学生在使用共用设备后进行擦拭，以帮助保持卫生的学习环境。
wipe.t: wipe侧重擦拭；wipe out可表示彻底消除。

e: A thin wire connects the lamp to its battery.
一根细电线将灯与电池连接起来。
Older buildings often need new electrical wire to meet modern safety standards and support increased energy use.
老建筑往往需要更换电线，以符合现代安全标准并满足增长的用电需求。
wire.t: wire可指单根金属丝；cable通常更粗或由多股组成。

e: My grandmother shared her wisdom while we cooked together.
我和祖母一起做饭时，她分享了自己的人生智慧。
The wisdom of expanding road networks is increasingly questioned as cities seek more sustainable transport solutions.
随着城市寻求更可持续的交通方案，扩建道路网络是否明智越来越受到质疑。
wisdom.t: 不可数；knowledge重知识，wisdom重判断与运用。

e: Taking a warm coat was a wise decision today.
今天带上一件暖和的外套是个明智的决定。
It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.
政府投资预防性医疗，而非仅仅依靠医院治疗，会是明智之举。
wise.t: wise强调判断明智；clever更强调聪明、学得快。

e: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
要是我们的公寓有个更大的厨房就好了。
Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。
wish.t: wish后用过去式表现在的遗憾；过去完成式表过去的遗憾。

e: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。
Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。
with.t: with后接名词或代词宾格，如with me。

e: I need to withdraw some cash before the market closes.
我需要在市场关门前取些现金。
Governments may withdraw financial support from industries that repeatedly fail to meet environmental standards.
政府可能会撤回对屡次未能达到环境标准的行业的财政支持。
withdraw.t: 过去式withdrew，过去分词withdrawn；退出用from。

e: The flowers withered after a week without water.
这些花一周没浇水，都枯萎了。
Without sustained investment, local industries may wither, leaving young people with few employment opportunities.
没有持续投资，当地产业可能衰退，导致年轻人就业机会寥寥。
wither.t: 植物枯萎或事业衰退均可用，常与away连用。

e: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
你的包裹应该会在接下来的三天内送达。
Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.
地方政府应确保居民区步行可达的范围内有基本服务设施。
within.t: within强调不超出某范围；within a week指一周内。

e: I left the house without my keys this morning.
今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。
Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。
without.t: without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

e: These boots can withstand rain, mud, and rough paths.
这双靴子经得起雨水、泥泞和崎岖道路的考验。
Coastal infrastructure must be designed to withstand stronger storms as climate change increases the frequency of extreme weather.
随着气候变化使极端天气更加频繁，沿海基础设施的设计必须能抵御更强的风暴。
withstand.t: 过去式和过去分词均为withstood；后直接接宾语。

e: A grey wolf stood silently at the forest edge.
一只灰狼静静地站在森林边缘。
Protecting wolf populations can help restore ecological balance by controlling the numbers of deer in forest habitats.
保护狼群有助于控制森林栖息地中的鹿群数量，从而恢复生态平衡。
wolf.t: 复数为wolves；动词常用wolf down，表示快速吃下。

e: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。
Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
确保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善几代人的健康状况和经济机会。
woman.t: 复数women读/ˈwɪmɪn/，注意首音节变化。

e: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。
wonder.t: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

e: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。
Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。
wonderful.t: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

e: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
这把小椅子完全由实木制成。
Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。
wood.t: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

e: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
她用木勺慢慢搅拌汤。
Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。
wooden.t: wooden指木制；woody多指木质或像木头的。

e: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
这条羊毛围巾让我的脖子在刮风的早晨保持温暖。
Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.
羊毛具有天然保温性能，因此适合用来制作寒冷气候下穿着的衣物。
wool.t: 通常不可数；一团毛线说a ball of wool。

e: I pulled on thick woollen socks before going outside.
出门前，我穿上了厚厚的羊毛袜。
Although woollen clothing provides excellent insulation, its environmental impact depends partly on farming practices and manufacturing methods.
虽然羊毛衣物保暖性能优良，但其环境影响部分取决于养殖方式和制造方法。
I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。
Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。
word.t: keep your word指守信，其中word不用复数。

e: My brother is a workaholic who rarely takes holidays.
我哥哥是个工作狂，几乎不休假。
A workaholic may achieve short-term career success while neglecting personal relationships and long-term health.
工作狂可能取得短期的职业成功，却忽视了人际关系和长期健康。
workaholic.t: 强调工作过度、难以停下，不等于单纯勤奋。

e: A worker in orange overalls repaired the broken fence.
一名穿橙色工作服的工人修好了破损的围栏。
Employers should provide every worker with appropriate training and equipment to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
雇主应为每位员工提供适当的培训和设备，以降低工伤风险。
worker.t: 不只指体力劳动者，也可指医护等职业工作者。

e: Our workplace has a quiet room for lunch breaks.
我们的工作场所有一间安静的房间，供午休使用。
Creating an inclusive workplace helps employees feel valued and encourages cooperation among people from different backgrounds.
营造包容的工作环境有助于员工感到受重视，并促进不同背景的人之间的合作。
workplace.t: 泛指办公室、工厂等工作场所，不等于单指办公室。

e: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。
Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。
workshop.t: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。

e: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
她梦想乘火车环游世界。
Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。
world.t: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。

e: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。
Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.
全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。
worldwide.t: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：sell worldwide。

e: A worm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
一条蚯蚓从花园湿润的泥土里蠕动着钻了出来。
Worms improve soil quality by breaking down organic matter and allowing air to circulate underground.
蚯蚓通过分解有机物并使空气在地下流通来改善土壤质量。
She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。
Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。
worried.t: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

e: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
猫待在外面时，我会担心她。
Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。
worry.t: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

e: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。
Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。
They gather for worship in a small village chapel.
他们聚在村里的一座小教堂做礼拜。
Historic places of worship often serve as important centres of community life and cultural heritage.
历史悠久的宗教场所往往是社区生活与文化传承的重要中心。
That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。
The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。
worst.t: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。

e: This old bicycle is still worth fifty pounds.
这辆旧自行车仍然值五十英镑。
Investing in public transport is worth the initial expense because it can reduce congestion and pollution.
投资公共交通值得付出前期费用，因为这能减少拥堵和污染。
worth.t: 表示值得做用be worth doing，不用worth to do。

e: Without its missing parts, this old machine is worthless.
缺了那些零件，这台旧机器就毫无用处。
Digital skills can quickly become worthless if training focuses only on tools that are soon outdated.
如果培训只关注很快就会过时的工具，数字技能可能迅速失去价值。
worthless.t: worthless指无价值；priceless反而指极珍贵。

e: Your thoughtful suggestion is worthy of serious consideration.
你这个深思熟虑的建议值得认真考虑。
Community projects that improve access to education are worthy of sustained public investment.
改善教育机会的社区项目值得获得持续的公共投资。
worthy.t: 常用 worthy of；worth 后可直接接名词或动名词。

e: The nurse gently cleaned the wound on my knee.
护士轻轻清洗了我膝盖上的伤口。
Access to clean water and basic medical supplies is essential for treating wounds and preventing infection.
获得清洁用水和基本医疗用品，对处理伤口和预防感染至关重要。
She wrapped the birthday present in bright yellow paper.
她用鲜黄色的纸包好了生日礼物。
Retailers could reduce packaging waste by encouraging customers to wrap gifts in reusable fabric.
零售商可以鼓励顾客用可重复使用的布料包装礼物，以减少包装废弃物。
wrap.t: 用wrap A in B表示用材料B包住A。

e: She hung a wreath of leaves on the door.
她在门上挂了一个叶子编成的花环。
Laying a wreath at a memorial allows communities to express shared grief and honour the past.
在纪念碑前敬献花圈，让社区成员能够表达共同的哀思并缅怀过去。
Divers found a shipwreck beside the wreck of a submarine.
潜水员在一艘潜艇残骸旁发现了一艘沉船。
Poorly planned construction can wreck historic neighbourhoods and permanently reduce their cultural value for future generations.
规划不当的建设会毁坏历史街区，并永久削弱其对后代的文化价值。
wreck.t: wreck可指一艘失事船；wreckage泛指残骸。

e: She tightened the loose bolt with a wrench.
她用扳手拧紧了松动的螺栓。
Leaving a close community can be a real wrench for students who move abroad for university.
对赴海外上大学的学生来说，离开关系紧密的社区可能十分难舍。
wrench.t: 扳手在英式英语中常叫spanner；wrench也可作动词。

e: I felt wretched after spending the night coughing.
咳嗽了一整晚后，我感到十分难受。
Families living in wretched housing conditions face greater risks of respiratory illness and other health problems.
居住条件恶劣的家庭面临更高的呼吸系统疾病及其他健康问题风险。
wretched.t: 开头w不发音；词尾-ed在此读/ɪd/。

e: She wore a silver bracelet around her wrist.
她的手腕上戴着一条银手链。
Office workers should adjust their keyboards to reduce pressure on their wrists during prolonged computer use.
办公室员工应调整键盘位置，减轻长时间使用电脑时手腕承受的压力。
wrist.t: 开头的w不发音；手腕是wrist，脚踝是ankle。

e: Please write your address on this small card.
请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。
Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。
The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。
A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。
writer.t: writer范围较广；author常指某部作品的作者。

e: I do most of my writing before breakfast.
我的写作大多在早餐前完成。
Regular writing practice helps students organise complex ideas and communicate their arguments more clearly.
经常练习写作有助于学生组织复杂的想法，并更清楚地表达论点。
writing.t: writing通常不可数；也是write的现在分词，需去e。

e: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。
It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。
wrong.t: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

e: We watched a white yacht sail across the bay.
我们看着一艘白色帆船驶过海湾。
The growing popularity of yacht tourism can generate income for coastal communities but may damage marine habitats.
游艇旅游日益流行，能为沿海社区创造收入，但也可能破坏海洋栖息地。
yacht.t: ch不发音；通常指休闲或竞赛用船。

e: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。
Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。
yard.t: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

e: She chose soft blue yarn for the baby's blanket.
她挑了柔软的蓝色毛线来织婴儿毯。
Using yarn made from recycled materials can reduce waste in the textile industry.
使用再生材料制成的纱线可以减少纺织业的废弃物。
yarn.t: 作“纱线”通常不可数；作“故事”可数。

e: I yawned twice while waiting for the kettle to boil.
等水壶里的水烧开时，我打了两次哈欠。
Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.
经常在早课上打哈欠的学生，可能夜间睡眠不足。
yawn.t: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

e: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。
A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。
year.t: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

e: Add the yeast once the water feels slightly warm.
等水摸起来微温时加入酵母。
Scientists use yeast to study basic cellular processes because it grows quickly under controlled laboratory conditions.
科学家利用酵母研究基本细胞过程，因为它在受控实验室条件下生长迅速。
yeast.t: 烘焙中通常作不可数名词；不是baking powder。

e: We yelled with excitement when our team finally scored.
我们的球队终于得分时，我们兴奋地大喊起来。
Coaches who yell at young athletes may undermine their confidence rather than improve their performance.
对年轻运动员大吼大叫的教练可能会打击他们的信心，而不是提高他们的表现。
yell.t: yell at常带怒气；yell to侧重喊给对方听。

e: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。
Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。
yellow.t: 可作动词表示变黄；不要用它描述人的种族。

e: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
我昨天把雨伞落在公交车上了。
The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.
昨天发布的交通调查表明，在市中心通勤的人越来越倾向于骑车而非开车。
yesterday.t: yesterday前通常不用介词，常与一般过去时连用。

e: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。
Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。
yet.t: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

e: Our apple tree yielded three baskets of fruit.
我们的苹果树结出了三篮果实。
Investment in agricultural research can yield substantial benefits for food security without expanding farmland.
对农业研究的投资可以在不扩大耕地的情况下，为粮食安全带来显著益处。
yield.t: yield results指产生结果；yield to指向……让步。

e: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
我每天早上都往酸奶里拌入新鲜浆果。
Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。
yogurt.t: 英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。

e: The farmer placed a wooden yoke across the oxen's necks.
农夫把木轭架在两头牛的脖子上。
Many communities struggled for generations to free themselves from the yoke of colonial rule.
许多群体为摆脱殖民统治的枷锁，进行了数代人的抗争。
yoke.t: 与 yolk（蛋黄）同音；比喻义常指压迫的枷锁。

e: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。
Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。
young.t: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

e: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
一个开朗的孩子帮我捡起了那些苹果。
Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
社区体育项目让青少年有机会培养团队协作能力，并在校外建立友谊。
youngster.t: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。

e: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。
Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。
your.t: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

e: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。
Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。
yourself.t: 对应单数you；对多人说“你们自己”用yourselves。

e: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。
Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。
youth.t: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

e: She tackled the garden cleanup with remarkable zeal.
她以极大的热情投入到花园清理工作中。
Volunteers' zeal can strengthen community projects, but sustained progress also requires reliable funding and professional support.
志愿者的热忱能推动社区项目，但持续进展也需要稳定的资金和专业支持。
zeal.t: 不可数名词；常用zeal for表示对某事的热情。

e: A zealous volunteer cleaned the entire beach before lunch.
一位热忱的志愿者午饭前就清理了整片海滩。
Zealous campaigners can raise public awareness, but lasting environmental progress also requires effective government policies.
热心的倡导者能够提高公众意识，但持久的环境改善还需要有效的政府政策。
zealous.t: 语气比enthusiastic强，有时暗示热心得过头。

e: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。
Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。
zebra.t: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。

e: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。
Achieving zero carbon emissions will require substantial investment in renewable energy, public transport, and more efficient buildings.
实现零碳排放需要对可再生能源、公共交通和能效更高的建筑进行大量投资。
zero.t: 读电话号码时零也常读作oh；温度用zero。

e: These pumpkin seeds contain zinc and make a tasty snack.
这些南瓜籽含有锌，吃起来也是美味的零食。
Zinc coatings protect steel from corrosion, extending the lifespan of structures exposed to rain and moisture.
锌涂层能保护钢材免受腐蚀，延长暴露于雨水和潮气中的结构的使用寿命。
zinc.t: 锌是化学元素，符号Zn；作物质名通常不可数。

e: My jacket zipper got stuck halfway up this morning.
今天早上，我夹克的拉链拉到一半卡住了。
Designing clothing with replaceable buttons and zippers could extend its lifespan and reduce household textile waste.
采用可更换纽扣和拉链的服装设计，可以延长衣物寿命并减少家庭纺织品废弃物。
zipper.t: zipper主要用于美式英语，英式英语通常用zip。

e: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。
Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。
zone.t: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。
